Join a team that shares your calling

At MultiCare, you’re more than a job title — you’re part of a collaborative team of physicians and advanced practice providers committed to patient-centered care. Here, your voice matters. You’ll have the support, resources and flexibility to practice at the top of your license, collaborate with experienced colleagues and make a meaningful impact. Build a long-term career in a system that grows with you, in a community that supports your life beyond work.

FTE: 0.7, Shift: Day, Schedule: Variable

Position Summary

Provides outpatient psychiatric consultation services including, but not limited to diagnostic, medication management, and therapeutic intervention recommendations. Supports various clinical teams which could include integrated mental health therapists, collaborative care teams, primary care providers, allied support staff and others. Other role responsibilities include providing the care team with educational support on diagnosing/ managing behavioral health conditions and providing diagnostic clarifying one-time psychiatric evaluations.

Responsibilities

  • Provides psychiatric evaluations when required to clarify treatment recommendations.
  • Provide regularly scheduled caseload consultation to Integrated Mental Health Therapist.
  • Completes all required documentation within timeframes specified in the MultiCare Health System Ambulatory Electronic Health Record Completion policy.
  • Demonstrates a positive attitude and efforts toward meeting the needs of internal and external customers.
  • Uses English effectively to send and receive messages, oral and written, in a clear, positive, prompt, and appropriate manner.
  • Attend and participate in team meetings and other agency meetings as requested.
  • Provides back-up coverage for absent medical staff as needed.
  • Works with Integrated Mental Health Therapist to oversee the status and population health of their assigned patient caseload.
  • Requires adherence to practice standards, agency standards, contracts, and Washington Administrative Codes.
  • May supervise graduate medical students (nurse practitioner students, residents).
  • Expert knowledge of psychotropic medications.
  • Experience in community mental health.
  • Able to effectively partner with severely and persistently mentally ill patients.
  • Basic computer and keyboard skills.
  • Excellent assessment, evaluation, and clinical skills.
  • Requires the ability to sit for prolonged periods.
  • Requires the willingness and ability to work varied hours when necessary.
  • Demonstrate effective de-escalation skills.  

Requirements

  • Meets state of Washington licensure requirements by the time of employment.
  • Advanced Reg Nurse Practitioner with prescriptive authority license - Washington Department of Health. 
  • American Nurses Credentialing Center Board Certification as a Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (Across the Lifespan) Certification (PMHNP-BC™) or if one of the following active certifications (available for renewal only).
  • Adult Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner Certification (PMHNP-BC).
  • Child/Adolescent Psychiatric-Mental Health Clinical Nurse Specialist Certification (PMHCNS-BC) preferred.
  • Current Health Care Provider level BLS certification such as American Heart Association or American Red Cross.
  • DEA, NPI & prescriptive authority.

Why MultiCare?

Rooted in the local community

Partnering with patients, families and neighbors across the Pacific Northwest for more than 140 years.

Growth and education

Leadership development, mentorship and continued professional growth opportunities across a collaborative, integrated health system.

Well-being and support

Flexible scheduling, generous time off and MultiCare’s Physician & APP Well-Being Program support your well-being and help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Living our values

Respect, integrity, kindness and collaboration guide how we care for patients, communities and each other.

Belonging for all

A culture where providers feel heard, respected and part of the team from day one, supported by Resource Groups and outreach programs.

Pacific Northwest lifestyle

Work and live where natural beauty, adventure and strong community connections are part of everyday life.

Pay and Benefit Expectations

We provide a comprehensive benefits package, including competitive salary, medical, dental and retirement benefits and paid time off. As required by various pay transparency laws, we share a competitive range of compensation for candidates hired into each position. The pay scale is $139,400.00 - $145,860.00 USD. However, pay is influenced by factors specific to applicants, including but not limited to: skill set, level of experience, and certification(s) and/or education. If this position is associated with a union contract, pay will be reflective of the appropriate step on the pay scale to which the applicant’s years of experience align.

Associated benefit information can be viewed here.

raw.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) who is passionate about expanding access to high-quality, caregiver-mediated ABA services. This role focuses on delivering parent-implemented interventions through telehealth, equipping caregivers with the skills and confidence to support meaningful progress in their child’s natural environment.

This BCBA will partner closely with families to model, coach, and reinforce evidence-based strategies in real time. The role may also contribute to innovative service delivery models, including digital tools and asynchronous supports, to enhance caregiver engagement and continuity of care.

This position is ideal for a BCBA who values a collaborative, family-centered approach, is skilled in translating clinical concepts into practical strategies, and thrives in a flexible, tech-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct behavioral and functional analytic assessments with a focus on identifying caregiver strengths, needs, and opportunities for intervention within daily routines

  • Develop and oversee individualized, caregiver-mediated ABA treatment plans that prioritize functional, meaningful outcomes and natural environment teaching

  • Coach, model, and provide real-time feedback to caregivers to support effective implementation of intervention strategies

  • Collaborate with families to set meaningful, achievable goals and build caregiver competence and confidence in supporting their child’s development

  • Monitor client and caregiver progress, adjust treatment plans, and ensure data-driven decision-making using caregiver-collected and session-based data

  • Translate clinical concepts into clear, practical guidance that can be consistently implemented by caregivers in everyday settings

  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of services, caregiver progress, and client outcomes

  • Plan for generalization, maintenance, and appropriate discharge by ensuring caregivers can independently implement key strategies

  • Ensure compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations, as well as organizational policies and procedures

General Requirements

  • Strong knowledge and experience in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and Autism Spectrum Disorder

  • Demonstrated ability to provide clinical supervision and mentorship

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and concisely in a chat-based format

  • Strong interpersonal, coaching, and relationship-building skills

  • High level of organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Proficiency with technology, including data systems, telehealth platforms, and digital tools

  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and ethical standards

  • Located in NM, AZ, TX, FL, GA, ID, NC, NV, UT, OK, or CO

  • Ability to work within the hours of 9am-6pm MT

  • Bilingual English/Spanish

Education and Experience

  • Active BCBA certification

  • Master’s degree in Psychology, Applied Behavior Analysis, or a related field

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience working with a pediatric population

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience conducting functional assessments and developing and overseeing behavior intervention plans

  • At least 1 year of telehealth supervision experience

Compensation: Compensation for this role is hourly W2, with rates determined based on factors such as experience, geographic location, and language capabilities. On average, compensation for this position is equivalent to approximately $100,000 annually, though individual compensation will vary based on qualifications and other factors.

About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

// At Masabi, we're powering the journeys of millions by making public transport payments simple, accessible, and seamless.

We're looking for Backend Developers to help build and evolve the services at the heart of our Justride platform. You'll work on cloud-native, event-driven systems that run at scale for transit agencies around the world, from fare and ticketing logic to the APIs and integrations that connect riders, operators and partners.

As part of a cross-functional team, you'll work closely with engineers, testers and product partners to take features from idea to production. What you build will shape the experience of riders every day.

Location_

// This is a fully remote contract role for people based in Romania

Responsibilities_

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs that power core parts of the Justride platform

  • Contribute to the design of scalable, secure and resilient distributed systems

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver features from concept through to production

  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and contribute to code reviews and shared engineering standards

  • Build and support integrations with internal services and third-party systems

  • Monitor and improve the performance, reliability and observability of the services you own

  • Contribute to technical discussions and help shape solutions and best practices

  • Take ownership of your work and support team outcomes

About You_

  • Clear, confident communication in written and spoken English

  • Solid commercial experience building backend systems in Java or Kotlin

  • Understanding of distributed systems and how to build for scale and reliability

  • Comfortable designing and working with REST APIs and service-based or event-driven architectures

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, ideally AWS

  • A thoughtful approach to code quality, testing and maintainability

  • Collaborative and team-oriented, happy to share knowledge and learn from others

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset

  • Able to explain technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues

We don't expect you to tick every box. What matters most is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the motivation to take ownership of your work.

What You'll Learn_

  • How a global fare payment platform works at scale, used by transit agencies and millions of riders

  • Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture, Kafka, AWS and infrastructure as code

  • How to deliver in a cross-functional, international team where developers help shape the technical direction

Our Stack_

  • Java/Kotlin (nice to have)

  • Event-driven architecture, RESTful APIs

  • AWS (DynamoDB, S3, SQS, EC2, ECS etc.)

  • Kafka

  • Terraform

  • Grafana

  • Gradle, Maven, Git

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Investing.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Investing areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Poland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Poland.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
Role Title: Military Writing Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (US Only)

micro1 is engaging Military Writing Specialists to support a unique project, leveraging expertise in military writing and reporting. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Contributors will use their background in Department of War (Department of Defense) documentation to generate, review, and evaluate a wide range of reports, summaries, and status updates reflective of authentic military processes. Your input will help develop benchmarks and grading guidelines that will teach AI to understand and replicate effective, compliant government communication.

Scope of Work

  1. Create realistic military and federal status reports, summaries, and executive updates based on prompts and supplied artifacts.
  2. Develop “golden responses” that demonstrate high-quality, standards-aligned reporting for use in AI model training.
  3. Draft grading rubrics and guidelines that reflect best practices in federal and military writing assessment.
  4. Evaluate AI-generated reports, providing detailed feedback in both written and verbal form.
  5. Share context on stylistic differences and individual approaches to common military documents (e.g., WARs, SITREPs, AARs, executive summaries).
  6. Produce supporting documents such as decision briefs, memoranda, and action officer updates when required.
  7. Collaborate with other subject matter experts to ensure diversity of reporting styles and adherence to branch-specific terminology.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Former U.S. Department of War (Department of Defense) professional with at least 3 years of relevant experience.
  2. Experience producing templated and standard reports such as Weekly Activity Reports (WARs), Situation Reports (SITREPs), After-Action Reviews, or similar artifacts.
  3. Expertise spanning two or more branches of the U.S. military is a plus; a diverse background across roles is highly valued.
  4. Proven proficiency in written and verbal communication, particularly in conveying technical or operational subject matter.
  5. Demonstrated ability to craft, grade, and review back office documents, PowerPoints, memos, and spreadsheets for military or federal purposes.
  6. US-based contributor with broad familiarity with federal documentation standards and compliance best practices.
  7. Comfortable collaborating remotely and sharing insights on nuanced, highly procedural reporting tasks.

raw.description:
We are ZimVie, a global life sciences leader focused on restoring daily life by advancing clinical technology to improve patients’ smiles, function, and confidence. Our company is founded on a legacy of trusted brands, products, and clinical evidence made possible through an inclusive and collaborative culture that empowers our team members to bring their whole selves – their best selves – to work every day to accomplish our Mission. Together, our dedicated, diverse global team is shaping an exciting future for ZimVie — we hope you’ll consider being a part of it!

Job Summary

The Corporate Sales Manager, Government Accounts is responsible for developing, managing, and expanding strategic relationships within federal government healthcare organizations, including the Department of Defense (DoD), Veterans Health Administration (VA), and military treatment facilities. This role works in conjunction with the Vice President, Strategic Markets to execute the organization's government account strategy and drive profitable revenue growth across the full ZimVie Dental portfolio.

The Corporate Sales Manager serves as the primary commercial liaison for assigned government accounts, collaborating closely with Territory Managers, Regional Managers, MedEd, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to increase market penetration, enhance customer engagement, and maximize contract utilization. The position is responsible for identifying growth opportunities, supporting government contracting activities, and developing long-term strategic partnerships that advance organizational objectives.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Meet or exceed established sales objectives, revenue targets, market share goals, and strategic account performance metrics for assigned government accounts.
  • Develop and execute strategic business plans for federal government healthcare organizations, including the Department of Defense, Veterans Affairs, military treatment facilities, and any other government healthcare systems.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key government stakeholders, procurement personnel, clinicians, healthcare administrators, and purchasing decision-makers.
  • Partner with the VP, Strategic Markets to support the development and execution of the organization's government account strategy.
  • Lead account planning efforts to identify growth opportunities, competitive threats, contract utilization opportunities, and customer development initiatives.
  • Coordinate and support negotiations, renewals, implementations, and management of government contracts and purchasing agreements.
  • Collaborate with Territory Managers, Regional Managers, and other field-based team members to drive product adoption and account growth.
  • Partner with Marketing, MedEd, Product Management, and other commercial teams to execute customer programs and strategic initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of government procurement processes, purchasing mechanisms, and contracting vehicles relevant to the dental market.
  • Analyze customer utilization, purchasing trends, competitive activity, and account performance to identify opportunities for revenue growth and market expansion.
  • Support customer training, educational programs, and clinical initiatives designed to increase engagement and utilization of ZimVie products and services.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, account plans, opportunity pipelines, and customer records within CRM systems.
  • Represent the organization at government healthcare conferences, military events, trade shows, and customer meetings.
  • Ensure compliance with all company policies, government contracting requirements, ethical standards, and applicable regulations.
  • Travel as necessary to support customer relationships, account development activities, and business objectives.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and may not necessarily comprise all of the "essential functions" for purposes of the ADA.

Expected Areas of Competence (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)

  • Demonstrated success managing strategic accounts, national accounts, government accounts, or complex healthcare customers.
  • Knowledge of Department of Defense, Veterans Affairs, and government procurement environments strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of the dental implant market, oral healthcare industry, and competitive landscape.
  • Ability to develop and execute strategic account plans that drive measurable business results.
  • Strong relationship-building and consultative selling skills.
  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate across multiple organizational levels and functions.
  • Effective negotiation and contract management capabilities.
  • Strong financial acumen, including pricing analysis, forecasting, business planning, and profitability considerations.
  • Ability to analyze market data, customer trends, and competitive intelligence to develop actionable business strategies.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills with the ability to engage clinical, operational, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, and project management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and competing demands in a dynamic business environment.
  • High degree of accountability, integrity, professionalism, and customer focus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Salesforce, CRM systems, and business analytics tools.
  • Ability to travel overnight and work flexible schedules as business needs require.

Education/Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Life Sciences, or a related field required.
  • Minimum of five to seven years of progressively responsible experience in sales, strategic account management, national accounts, government accounts, healthcare sales, or business development.
  • Experience working within medical device, dental, healthcare, government, or related industries preferred.
  • Experience supporting government contracts, federal procurement processes, GSA schedules, DOD, VA, or similar government healthcare organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success achieving sales growth, business development objectives, and strategic account expansion.
  • Experience working effectively within a matrixed, cross-functional commercial organization.

Travel Requirements

Up to 50%

raw.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Senior Data/ETL Engineer to sustain SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), develop approved integrations, and maintain reliable data pipelines supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Data/ETL Engineer to sustain SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), develop approved integrations, and maintain reliable data pipelines supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This position will implement raw, standardized, and curated data layers using SQL, Python, APIs, and incremental loading techniques. The engineer will reconcile data, manage schema changes, maintain lineage, and troubleshoot complex pipeline failures to support accurate and timely mission analysis, AI capabilities, and reporting.

The Senior Data/ETL Engineer will work with the Lead Data/ETL Engineer, database administrators, data governance personnel, AI/ML engineers, BI developers, testers, and Government stakeholders to maintain secure, traceable, and supportable data integrations.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Data/ETL Engineer will:

  • Sustain, troubleshoot, and optimize SSIS packages, configurations, schedules, and dependencies.
  • Develop and maintain approved integrations between source systems, databases, APIs, analytical environments, and reporting platforms.
  • Write SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation routines.
  • Develop Python scripts for data ingestion, processing, validation, orchestration, and operational automation.
  • Implement raw, standardized, and curated data layers with documented transformation rules.
  • Build and maintain incremental loads, including checkpoints and tracking of previously processed data.
  • Implement API authentication, pagination, retry handling, logging, and error processing.
  • Reconcile source and target data using record counts, totals, completeness checks, and business rules.
  • Manage schema changes and assess their effects on pipelines, datasets, integrations, and reporting outputs.
  • Maintain source-to-target mappings, identifier mappings, metadata, and data lineage.
  • Implement controls for duplicate, missing, invalid, or failed records and support controlled reprocessing.
  • Monitor pipeline execution, data freshness, processing performance, and operational errors.
  • Investigate complex failures involving SSIS, SQL, APIs, source data, transformations, and downstream dependencies.
  • Implement approved corrections and validate successful processing and reconciliation.
  • Coordinate changes with database, application, governance, AI/ML, BI, and testing teams.
  • Support automated regression testing, data-quality checks, defect resolution, and release validation.
  • Maintain version-controlled code, deployment instructions, rollback procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Provide technical status, troubleshooting findings, risks, and improvement recommendations to the technical lead and Government stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of eight years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Experience maintaining and supporting SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Experience building or supporting API integrations.
  • Experience implementing incremental data loads.
  • Experience performing data reconciliation and managing schema changes.
  • Experience documenting and maintaining data lineage.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex data pipelines.
  • Ability to implement raw, standardized, and curated data layers.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or another approved IAT Level II certification when applicable to assigned duties.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Relevant data engineering or cloud platform certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense data environments.
  • Experience with enterprise data warehouses, analytical datasets, BI platforms, or AI-ready data.
  • Experience modernizing SSIS packages or migrating integrations to approved cloud services.
  • Familiarity with data governance, metadata repositories, common identifiers, and authoritative sources.
  • Experience developing automated reconciliation tests, data-quality checks, and pipeline regression tests.
  • Experience with CI/CD, version control, automated deployment, and rollback processes.
  • Familiarity with secure service accounts, secrets management, encryption, and audit logging.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-team coordination skills.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

raw.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
raw.excerpt: Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality.
raw.description:
Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn’t just building first-of-its-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options.

The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, infrastructure, and operations to build the definitive safety case for the commercial launch of our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas later this year.

We are seeking a highly skilled and autonomous Senior Robotics Engineer to play a critical role in investigating and diagnosing complex autonomous vehicle (AV) behaviors across on-road, resimulation, and synthetic simulation environments. This engineer will be responsible for taking end-to-end ownership of ambiguous problem spaces, utilizing Python, custom Spaceship tooling, and data visualization platforms to effectively perform root-cause analysis on emergent behaviors across our autonomy stack. Their work will directly contribute to accelerating the development of safe and reliable autonomous technologies by transforming deep technical debugging into clear summaries that support unified release narratives and executive insights.

What You'll Be Doing

  • System Diagnosis & Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep technical investigations of undesirable AV behaviors across simulation, HIL, and on-road operations. Take end-to-end ownership of complex investigations, driving solutions autonomously from initial triage to final resolution with little to no oversight.
  • Cross-Subsystem Debugging: Debug behaviors across perception, prediction, localization, planning, controls, and vehicle systems. Reason across subsystem boundaries to diagnose emergent behaviors resulting from component interactions.
  • Data Analysis & Tooling: Analyze large datasets from system logs, telemetry, and software outputs using Python. Develop automated diagnostic workflows and custom internal tooling using Python and Spaceship to increase the speed and scale of investigations.
  • Performance Visualization: Design and build interactive dashboards using Python frameworks and Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Looker) to effectively measure, analyze, and report on the performance of our AV systems.
  • Hypothesis Generation: Develop technical hypotheses from incomplete or ambiguous evidence, distinguish behavioral symptoms from underlying root causes, and design analyses to systematically test potential causes.
  • Problem Space Identification: Autonomously identify recurring undesirable behaviors, regressions, and emerging system-level performance issues, categorizing them into meaningful failure modes.
  • Technical Storytelling & Synthesis: "Dive deep" into technical complexities to uncover root causes, then step back to synthesize findings. Translate raw performance metrics into clear summaries that support executive-level reporting, unified release narratives, and cross-functional communication.

What We're Looking For

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer Science, Electrical, Systems, Robotics) or equivalent work experience, with a Master's degree considered a strong plus.
  • Robotics Experience: 5+ years of professional software or systems engineering experience working on safety-critical, complex systems such as Autonomous Vehicles, Robotics, Medical Devices, or Aerospace. Thorough understanding of robotics systems including sensors, actuators, and software autonomy stacks.
  • Data & Analytics Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis and scripting, backed by a strong understanding of modern software development principles. Experience building data visualizations using Python frameworks, with a willingness to learn Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Looker).
  • Systems Thinking & Quality: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for complex system performance evaluation. Ability to think logically, remove bias, perform root cause analysis using system logs, and maintain a strict commitment to data quality and rigorous testing.
  • Engineering Workflows: Proficient with Git and standard version control workflows, and entirely comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) environment.
  • Autonomy & Communication: Proven ability to work both independently and effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. Excellent communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex technical findings into clear summaries that support cross-functional teams and executive leadership.

Bonus Points (not required)

  • Experience using AV-specific software diagnostic and visualization tools (e.g., Planner Analyzer) to troubleshoot complex autonomy behaviors.
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and machine learning techniques relevant to performance evaluation.

Success Metrics

  • Core Diagnosis & RCA: Effective execution of deep technical investigations that accurately isolate the underlying root causes of complex, cross-subsystem AV behaviors and translate them into actionable engineering resolutions.
  • Diagnostic Automation: Successful implementation of robust, automated diagnostic workflows that significantly reduce the time required to triage and resolve anomalous AV behaviors.
  • Technical Synthesis & Insights: Consistent delivery of accurate, high-impact data visualizations and clear summaries that directly accelerate AV development and system maturity.

This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact at Motional by enhancing our diagnostic capabilities, improving system reliability, and accelerating development speed for our industry-leading autonomous vehicle ecosystem. We take pride in having some of the brightest and most dedicated talent in the world on our team. If you're innovative, driven, and eager to tackle challenges, we'd love to have you join us!

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors including but not limited to specific skills, experience and expertise, role location, certifications, licenses, and business needs. The estimated compensation range listed in this job posting reflects base salary only. This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus or company equity. The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Candidates for certain positions are eligible to participate in Motional’s benefits program. Motional’s benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, vision, 401k with a company match, health saving accounts, life insurance, pet insurance, and more.

Salary Range
$149,000—$198,500 USD

Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We’re driven by something more.

Our journey is always people first.

We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it’s not only good for our business, it’s the right thing to do.

Scale up, not starting up.

Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.

Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E-Verify. All newly-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.

raw.description:
Senior Biostatistician
All U.S. Locations (remote); candidates must reside in the United States

Position Scope:
The Senior Biostatistician is PaceMate's first biostatistician. The role independently leads the statistical design, analysis, and reporting of PaceMate's clinical research, including internal quality and research studies and externally published work.
The role owns each study from analysis plan through peer-reviewed publication and response to reviewers, working directly with the Chief Medical Officer and PaceMate's clinical team. About a quarter to a third of the role applies the same methods to operational and business questions. Routine operational reporting and dashboards sit outside this role. AI-assisted tools are part of how this role works every day, and the role is accountable for validating every result they help produce. The position has latitude to shape its own workflow and a potential path to expanded oversight of research-related functions.

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities:
  • Write and execute statistical analysis plans for retrospective and real-world evidence studies, including target trial emulation. Define estimands (ICH E9(R1)), cohorts, exposure windows, and outcomes with the Chief Medical Officer and clinical investigators.
  • Link and validate multi-table device data. Confirm denominators, person-time, and follow-up, and address left truncation and immortal time bias around device implant and remote monitoring enrollment.
  • Analyze count and rate outcomes (Poisson and negative binomial regression with person-time offsets), recurrent events (Andersen-Gill, PWP, and frailty models; mean cumulative function), time-to-event outcomes with competing risks (cause-specific hazards, Fine-Gray, Aalen-Johansen), and clustered data (mixed-effects models, GEE).
  • Control confounding with propensity score methods (IPTW, overlap weights, matching). Handle informative censoring with IPCW and missing data with multiple imputation. Test robustness with E-values, negative control outcomes, and tipping-point analyses.
  • Write and review methods and results sections for abstracts and peer-reviewed manuscripts to STROBE and RECORD standards. Respond to co-author and external advisor critique.
  • Respond to peer review: re-analyses, statistical sections of response letters, and defensible positions under methodological critique.
  • Evaluate operational and business changes using interrupted time series, segmented regression, difference-in-differences, and statistical process control. Present effect estimates with confidence intervals to leadership in plain language.
  • Use AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) daily to write, review, debug, and document R and SQL code and analysis reports. Validate all generated code and results before use, and use only PaceMate-approved tools with protected health information.
  • Provide statistical input and limited analyses to support quality improvement, patient safety monitoring, and clinical operations when needed. This is not a primary QA role.
  • Build reusable research infrastructure with the data science team: standardized cohort definitions, reusable R code, and templated outputs.
  • Maintain the analytic queue and the documentation that lets any published result be reproduced by script from the raw data extract.
  • Maintain high level understanding of PaceMate products and services.
  • Maintain appropriate levels of current knowledge and the ability to interpret, comprehend, and apply policies. Assist in ensuring consistency in practices and PaceMate Mission, Vision, and Customer Service standards are met. Adhere to the Code of Conduct and all Company Policies and Procedures.

Non-Essential Functions:
  • Infrequently, prepare IRB documentation, including determination requests and reliance materials.
  • When requested, evaluate predictive models for discrimination, calibration, and clinical usefulness (decision curve analysis), including temporal and external validation (TRIPOD+AI).

Qualifications: An individual must be able to perform each Essential Function of the job satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities, who are otherwise qualified, to perform the essential functions. Nothing within this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Education and Experience:
  • PhD in biostatistics, statistics, or epidemiology; or a Master's in one of these fields with at least 8 years applying statistics to health data with clear independent ownership of analyses.
  • Lead or methods statistician on peer-reviewed cardiovascular clinical research (electrophysiology, heart failure, cardiac devices, or closely related). General healthcare analytics experience alone is not sufficient.
  • Peer-reviewed publication track record as a contributing statistician, including successful responses to reviewer critique.
  • Command of the methods this data demands: linking many related tables; count and rate outcomes with exposure offsets; recurrent-event and time-to-event methods including competing risks; clustered and repeated-measures data; confounding control in observational data; non-random missingness and informative censoring.
  • High proficiency in R across the full pipeline, including R Markdown or Quarto.
  • SQL sufficient to query and join relational clinical tables.
  • Reproducible practice by default: Git, dependency management (e.g., renv), scripted pipelines, and literate reporting.
  • Ability to explain methods and limitations to physicians and to a manager who is not a statistician, and willingness to state clearly when the data cannot support a conclusion.
  • Current, regular use of AI coding assistants in analytical work, with a consistent method for checking their output and protecting patient data.
  • Interest in applying statistical methods to operational and business questions.

Preferred:
  • Research using CIED, electrophysiology, or remote monitoring data, especially transmission-level data.
  • Published work using target trial emulation.
  • Working knowledge of Python.

Preferred or Required Certifications
PStat or GStat a plus

Physical Requirements:
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be consistently required to remain in a stationary position working at a computer, constantly operate a computer and other office equipment, and frequently communicate with customers and employees via voice and video.•
  • Must be able to exchange accurate information, with the ability to effectively utilize voice over internet protocol; and repetitive motions using fingers and forearms in data entry.
Other Requirements:
  • Home office setup: Maintain a dedicated, separate office or room at home to ensure privacy and professional working conditions.
  • Connectivity: Maintain a reliable, high-speed internet connection at your residence.
  • Geographic restriction: Must reside and work exclusively within the contiguous United States.
  • Must legally be eligible to work in the United States.
  • Notification protocol: You must inform and receive approval from the IT department before working from any location other than the legal address PaceMate has on file. To update your address or request approval for a temporary work location, contact PaceMate IT or your HR representative. Additional information is available in the PaceMate official handbook.
  • Foreign transport of sensitive information: When confidential information is carried into a foreign country, it must be stored in an inaccessible form (e.g., encrypted external storage) or remain in the worker’s possession at all times. PaceMate workers may not take secret PaceMate information into another country without permission from Physical Security management.
  • May require limited travel based on the needs of the business.
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Are you ready for an exciting journey of development? Then you might be our new Senior Technical Solution Manager!

Goldwind Denmark is a subsidiary of Goldwind Science & Technology Co., Ltd (Goldwind), a world leading wind turbine technology and energy solutions provider headquartered in Beijing, China. Goldwind Denmark was established in the beginning of 2016 as a dedicated R&D office and with a steady development of the product portfolio, we are dedicated to furthering the most advanced and cost-efficient wind power technology in a high quality, continually raising the bar through a steadfast commitment to innovation.

Would you like to contribute to developing and evolving some of the worlds biggest wind turbines, new concepts, and worldwide expansion and operation of wind energy?

Goldwind is a global leader in wind power, both onshore and offshore, with a growing backlog, both domestically and internationally, and significant investments in R&D. They are committed to promoting energy transformation to attain access to affordable, reliable, and sustainable energy for all and to drive a renewable future.

Specializing in wind power, Goldwind leverage strong scientific research innovation and best business practices to take renewable energy utilization efficiency to new heights.

We are looking for our new Senior Technical Solution Manager. You will improve performance and reliability, resolve technical issues, and support modeling and verification processes. Join us to innovate in renewable energy engineering.


Your tasks and primary responsibilities will be as such:

  • International Market Insights:
    Independently conduct research on key elements of target regional markets, collecting and analyzing data on industry development trends, market access regulations and technical standards, major international or regional client demands and plans, competitor product roadmaps and competitive strategies. Continuously optimize competitive, product, and bidding strategies to improve tender success rates.
  • Customer Opportunity Development: Understand customer internal structures and decision-making chains. Participate in the planning of key account relationship management and guidance strategies. Responsible for presenting new products, technologies, or key project proposals to major clients, enhancing their recognition of Goldwinds products, technologies, and solutions. Maintain communication with domestic and international EPC partners or other third parties, and conduct technical or project information exchanges to expand the influence of the companys solutions and promote project adoption.
  • International Project Bidding:
    Lead bidding efforts for major clients, key accounts, and large or complex projects. Analyze and interpret client tender documents, identify pain points based on project information and customer requirements, and develop key milestones and full lifecycle solutions tailored to customer needs. Coordinate internal resources to resolve client issues and improve customer experience. For areas where product or technical competitiveness is insufficient, provide internal feedback and drive improvements in products and technologies.
  • Pre-Contract Execution Preparation: Take charge of or guide contract negotiations and technical risk assessments for awarded projects. Complete the preparation of overall technical solutions and conduct technical handover for project execution.
  • Organizational Capability Building:
    Participate in capability enhancement programs and system-building initiatives (e.g. refine workflows, streamline process, etc.) in alignment with solution capability development plans.

Qualifications:

  • We expect you to have a Masters or Bachelors degree in or higher or equivalent:
    • Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Energy, Automation, Software).
    • Renewable Energy, Power Systems, or similar.

Additionally, we envision that you have:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Wind energy, ideally from OEMs, developers, EPCs.
  • Technical experiences in wind turbine design, floating wind system design, offshore wind project bidding, development and execution are highly valued.
  • Background in customer-facing roles, solution design, or technical leadership.
  • Ability to translate operational and business requirements into scalable technical architectures.

Information

We prefer that you can be part of the headquarters in Aarhus, but this is not a requirement. It is expected that there will be approximately 10-15 days of travel per year.

Goldwind Denmark is currently a smaller unit with an entrepreneurial and embracing culture. We value and recognize every team member's contribution, creating a collaborative and supportive work environment that promotes innovation and creativity. Our passionate and dedicated team is here to make a positive difference in our industry and society every day. Come join us and be part of creating our collective sustainable future.

Apply
If you are interested and feel you are the right person for the job, do not hesitate to send a short application along with your resume.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product engineer to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Sweden. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Sweden.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Senior Financial Systems Analyst

What you will be doing:

This position serves as a senior individual contributor responsible for the administration, configuration, enhancement, and production support of Workday Financials and related finance technology solutions. The role partners with Finance and Accounting stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable system solutions, strengthen controls, improve reporting, and increase process efficiency.


Reporting to the Director of Financial Systems, this role provides hands-on functional and technical leadership across financial accounting, financial reporting, accounts receivable, revenue, supplier accounts, procurement, business assets, expenses, cash and banking, and financial planning and analysis. Responsibilities include Workday business process and security administration, reporting, integration support, release impact assessment, ServiceNow request management, audit support, and end-user guidance.


The position independently leads complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement efforts; coordinates cross-functional work with Finance, Accounting, IT, internal and external auditors, and third-party partners; and supports special projects and the financial systems roadmap. This role has no direct reports but is expected to provide subject-matter expertise, influence decisions, and mentor less-experienced team members through day-to-day collaboration.

Key Responsibilities


Responsibility #1 – 40%

Workday Financials Administration, Configuration, and Delivery:

  • Administer, configure, test, and support Workday Financials business processes and finance modules across financial accounting and reporting, accounts receivable, revenue, cash and banking, supplier accounts and procurement, expenses, business assets, and financial planning and analysis.
  • Translate complex Finance and Accounting requirements into scalable system designs, configuration changes, reports, integrations, testing plans, documentation, and production-ready solutions.
  • Lead assigned enhancements and projects from discovery through deployment, including requirements, design, testing coordination, stakeholder communication, training, and post-production support.
  • Support Adaptive Planning and other finance systems used by FP&A, Accounting, and Finance leadership, including data flows and downstream dependencies.

Responsibility #2 – 60%

  • Perform quarterly security and controls reviews, support internal and external audit requests, maintain documentation, and provide evidence for control compliance.
  • Own and resolve ServiceNow requests related to Workday access, business process routing, reporting, integrations, configuration, master data, and system exceptions in accordance with service expectations.
  • Review Workday releases and vendor updates, assess impacts, recommend adoption decisions, and coordinate testing and communications.
  • Lead complex issue investigation and root cause analysis for business process failures, reporting discrepancies, integration errors, security issues, master data changes, and downstream financial impacts.
  • Identify recurring support trends and improvement opportunities; implement sustainable fixes that reduce manual effort, strengthen data quality, and improve the user experience.

raw.description:
Senior Backend Engineer - Credit Card Payments

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Payments Infrastructure team.

You’ll design and build the payments platform behind iwoca’s business credit card – the services that approve each payment, monitor transactions for fraud, and pay out cashback.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca launched its business credit card in 2026. It gives small businesses a fast, flexible way to pay for what they need and control their cash flow, alongside iwoca’s loans. The card is a core part of iwoca’s long-term growth.

The Payments infrastructure team builds iwoca’s card payments platform. Its job is to approve each payment in moments when a customer uses their card. The team also builds the platforms that pay out rewards as customers spend and monitor every transaction.

The team is small – a principal engineer, a product manager with a background in payments, and you. It works closely with iwoca’s ledger, fraud and customer product teams.

The role

As a senior backend engineer, you’ll own services and projects end to end, and shape the platform’s architecture with the principal engineer, from service boundaries to how authorisation, rewards, and transaction monitoring fit together. You’ll work closely with product to decide what the team builds and how. There’s still plenty to build, and you’ll take new services into production.

You’ll build on your payments expertise alongside the principal engineer, with scope to grow as the platform matures. Most of the challenge is technical: scaling payments within card scheme rules and the regulation iwoca has to meet. Your code will run every time a small business uses its iwoca card.

Live project examples:

  • Payment authorisation. Extending the service built to approve or decline each card payment in real time, using data held in other services. It places a hold on available credit in the ledger and applies iwoca's own checks, such as account status, merchant category code restrictions, and spend limits.

  • Transaction monitoring. Building the service that will screen card transactions for fraud and financial-crime risk as customers spend, so iwoca will rely less on third parties.

  • Rewards. Extending the service that pays out cashback, as the team adds to what the card offers.

  • Testing for failure. Designing sandbox tests that cover edge cases and failures across the card transaction lifecycle.

  • Ledger cutover and go-live. Moving the card platform onto iwoca's own ledger and infrastructure with as little downtime as possible, then fixing the issues that only show up in production.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Payment systems. You've designed and run highly available, low-latency payment systems in production, ideally on the issuing side.

  • Card payment flows. You've worked on card authorisation and clearing, and traced transactions from the terminal, through the acquirer and card scheme, to the issuer. You've used response codes to diagnose declined transactions.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You've written and run backend services in it.

  • Distributed systems. You've built microservices, REST APIs, and asynchronous messaging with queues or topics, and designed the database schemas behind them, ideally in PostgreSQL.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone, at work or in your own projects. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Ledgers and clearing. You've worked on a ledger, reconciliation, or clearing system – for cards, loyalty points, bank transfers, or money remittance.

  • Testing. You've written automated tests for payment systems, ideally test-first.

  • Python. You've used Python in production. It's the language the team works in.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £120,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation Range: £100K - £120K

  • Serve as a trusted growth marketing consultant to retirement advisors and consultants, helping them prioritize high-impact opportunities and translate national marketing programs into practical, locally relevant growth activation plans.

  • Serve as the regional marketing liaison on high-value opportunities, partnering with advisors, market leaders, and national marketing to align messaging, tailor materials, coordinate preparation, and capture win/loss themes that strengthen future pursuits.
  • Enable retirement plan advisors to build and strengthen centers-of-influence (COI) relationships with CPAs, ERISA attorneys, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other retirement ecosystem partners that generate qualified plan opportunities.

  • Support the integration and onboarding of newly acquired and newly joined advisors and teams by connecting them with relevant marketing programs, growth resources, technology platforms, and enablement opportunities that accelerate adoption and field activation.
  • Serve as the connection point between the field and national teams—surfacing resource gaps, advisor feedback, local market intelligence, and successful practices that can be scaled, so national teams can strengthen campaigns, assets, technology investments, and enablement priorities.

Required

  • Strong written, verbal, organizational, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities across a large geographic territory.
  • Ability to travel throughout the West and Central regions as business needs require.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with nonqualified executive benefit solutions, defined benefit plans, and/or other institutional asset pools.
  • Experience supporting referral programs, COI strategies, and advisor-led event strategies.
  • Experience driving cross-practice or converged growth.
  • Experience driving adoption of AI-enabled sales, marketing, prospecting, or revenue-intelligence tools.
  • Familiarity with Seismic, ZoomInfo, intent-data platforms, marketing automation, and reporting tools.
  • Experience supporting the integration and onboarding of newly acquired or newly joined advisors and teams.
  • Experience supporting competitive finalist presentations, RFP responses, or complex pursuit processes.

Education, Training and Experience:

Labcorp is seeking a REMOTE Contracts Associate II position to join our team!

Work Schedule: Monday – Friday; 8:00am-5:00pm EST

Contract Management: Contract Associate II, Vendor Contracting

The Contract Associate II is responsible for performing the vendor contracting function and overseeing the full lifecycle of vendor agreements—from drafting and negotiation through execution, renewal, and termination. This role is ideal for an individual who brings hands-on experience in contract administration and can serve as a team lead with a collaborative mindset.


This role acts as a key spokesperson for the Law Department, with Procurement, and business stakeholders to ensure that contracts are compliant, risk-mitigated, and aligned with business needs. The Contract Associate II provides both strategic and hands-on support by drafting contracts, reviewing redlines, and managing vendor paper, while also driving operational excellence and consistency across the contracting process.


Duties and Responsibilities

Team Development

  • Provide coaching and training for new hires on contracting policies and best practices.

Contract Management, Drafting & Negotiation

  • Facilitate all phases of the vendor contracting process to ensure timely and accurate execution of agreements.
  • Draft and prepare contracts using pre-approved corporate templates, ensuring consistency and adherence to company policies and risk standards.
  • Review, analyze, and negotiate vendor-provided contract documents (“vendor paper”) to align with company requirements and minimize legal and commercial risk.
  • Review and respond to redlines and proposed revisions to company templates, coordinating with counsel as needed for escalations or non-standard terms.
  • Collaborate with counsel and business stakeholders to ensure contracts accurately reflect business intent, operational needs, and compliance obligations.
  • Review, update, and maintain template libraries, clause banks, and contracting playbooks in partnership with counsel.
  • Provides escalation assistance for redlines outside of pre-approved optional language.

Collaboration with the Business Teams

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the contracting function and counsel team to facilitate reviews, escalate complex issues, and align on contract language and risk positions.
  • Confer with counsel to interpret contractual terms, resolve disputes, and ensure adherence to applicable laws, regulations, and internal standards.
  • Work closely with business units to understand vendor requirements, operational objectives, and service expectations to translate them into contractual terms.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on contract structure, process, and risk considerations.
  • Conduct training and provide guidance to business teams on contracting best practices, processes, and policies.

Vendor Governance & Compliance

  • Partner with Procurement, Risk Management, Privacy, Compliance and other internal teams to support vendor due diligence, onboarding, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Ensure all contracts are executed and stored in compliance with company recordkeeping and data integrity requirements.
  • Track key contract obligations, renewals, and compliance milestones.
  • Support internal and external audits related to vendor management and contracting.

Process Optimization & Reporting

  • Continuously improve contracting workflows, standard operating procedures, and turnaround times.
  • Utilize contract lifecycle management (CLM) systems and reporting tools to track and monitor contracting activity, cycle times, and bottlenecks.
  • Develop and deliver metrics and dashboards to provide visibility into contracting performance, risk exposure, and vendor compliance.
  • Identify opportunities to increase efficiency, reduce cost, and improve contract quality.

Minimum Qualifications:


  • High school diploma or equivalent; Associate’s degree with 2+ years relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years experience drafting and negotiating contracts, including reviewing redlines and vendor-provided documents.
  • Organization skills and having the ability to adapt to high pressure situations is a must.
  • Good communication skills, verbal and written, necessary.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and Adobe
  • Ability to change directions in workload based on required timeframes.
  • Ability to work independently, and as a team, with little to no supervision.
