raw.description:
The Role
Menlo builds open source and production AI systems, from the brain, to developer facing tools to the runtime infrastructure and humanoid platform underneath. This fellowship is deliberately open ended: tell us your strengths and we'll match you to high impact work across software engineering, systems, applied AI, or research. You'll be hands on from day one, with a Menlo engineer or researcher directly responsible for your mentorship and your results. You own deliverables at the same level as the team you join. We expect you to contribute, not observe.

This is a paid internship program that runs year round. Candidates go through a rigorous interview process and get matched with a senior researcher or engineer working on real world problems.

What You'll Do

  • Own a real project end to end, from problem definition through implementation, testing, and documentation.

  • Ship production grade work in one or more areas: product engineering, systems, infrastructure, applied AI, or research.

  • Work on core Menlo projects, including developer tooling, model runtime and performance, automation, and reliability improvements.

  • Debug real issues across codebases and environments, and propose fixes that improve correctness, performance, and maintainability.

  • Write clear docs, runbooks, or internal notes that make your work easy for the team to adopt.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers and researchers through code reviews and technical discussions.

What We Look For

  • University, high school or mid-career individuals looking for a crash course in physical AI and robotics

  • The ability to read unfamiliar codebases and make safe, well scoped changes.

  • Practical debugging skills: you can isolate problems and validate fixes.

  • A grasp of software or hardware engineering basics: testing, version control, and review.

  • A high ownership mindset and the ability to work independently with fast feedback loops.

  • Above all, we hire for slope: how fast you grow matters more than where you start.

Logistics

  • 3 months minimum, based in one of our offices: San Francisco, Ho Chi Minh City, or Singapore

  • Paid role.

  • Open to pre university and university students.

  • You'll need existing work authorization for your office location, as we don't provide visa sponsorship for this role.

Why Join Menlo
You'll do real work that ships, not busywork on the bench. Genuine ownership, direct mentorship from the people building Asimov, and a chance to prove yourself on hard problems alongside some of the most curious and driven people you'll meet. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

raw.description:
Role type & Location

  • Full time Remote (Work from home) based either Dublin or UK only
  • Occasional Travel to Dublin office if Ireland based (Glasnevin) or UK (Oxford) if UK based

Visa

  • We regret we cannot offer Irish or UK visa sponsorship for this role

About this Role

You will be the engineer who protects sensitive data at Deciphex

We work in clinical and research digital pathology, so the data includes patient health information, personal data and confidential business and customer data.

You will report to the Principal Engineer - Cybersecurity & DevOps and join a lean, hands-on team where each engineer owns a defined area, with no large support structure.

In your first 12 months, three priorities come first:

  1. Data loss prevention and information protection on Google Workspace and Microsoft 365: classification, labelling and sharing controls, so sensitive data is shared only as intended.
  2. Least-privilege access to sensitive data: regular access reviews, and controlled, logged sharing with external providers and customers.
  3. Security review of the tools, integrations and data flows that touch sensitive data, including flows to on-premises laboratory systems, integrations and workflows, and the data side of our AWS-hosted products.

Our technology environment:

  • We are a Google Workspace company that also uses Microsoft services, and our products run on AWS.
  • You will work with the native data-protection and audit features of each platform: Google Workspace DLP, labels and context-aware access, Microsoft Purview and SharePoint, and AWS storage, encryption and logging services, alongside the security hubs of each platform.
  • We also use dedicated enterprise tools for endpoint protection and email security, and Vanta for compliance automation.

About our DTO Team

  • Our Digital Trust & Transformation Office (DTO) brings together the teams that keep Deciphex trustworthy and moving forward: information security, cybersecurity, application security, DevOps, IT, data protection and privacy, AI and AI governance, and operational resilience.
  • We work to one aim: our customers, clinicians and patients can trust our systems and the data in them, and our engineers can ship safely and quickly.

What You Will help us with

  • This is a hands-on engineering role in our Digital Trust & Transformation Office (DTO).
  • The Information Security team and Data Protection Officer own governance, risk and compliance, and rely on YOU as the data security specialist.
  • The Cybersecurity Engineer owns identity, endpoints and general security operations, and YOU work together on data incidents.

More specifically;

  • You will build and run the technical controls that keep it confidential wherever it lives: Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, our AWS-hosted products, other cloud and SaaS tools, or on-premises.
  • Design, deploy and tune data loss prevention and information-protection controls. Set retention, versioning and recovery settings so critical data survives ransomware and accidental deletion.
  • Enforce least privilege, run access reviews, fix oversharing, and control and log what leaves the company.
  • Keep sensitive data located through discovery and flow mapping. Set encryption and key-management requirements for cloud data stores and verify them. The DevOps team runs the keys and infrastructure encryption.
  • Carry out the technical security review of new tools, integrations and AI services before they touch sensitive data. The Information Security team, Data Protection Officer and AI governance decide on risk and approval.
  • Support the application security team on app data security, and collaborate with the product and data teams to lead good practice such as access models and logging. Those teams own product controls and anonymisation.
  • Monitor data access and movement in audit logs and security hubs
  • Lead the technical side of data incidents: scope, contain, preserve evidence and brief the Information Security team and DPO.
  • Support data subject and customer data requests. General security operations stay with the Cybersecurity Engineer.
  • Support the Information Security team with the technical side of ISO 27001, NHS DSPT, GDPR and customer assurance, providing data security expertise and automated evidence. They run the frameworks and audits.
  • Automate administration, investigation and reporting with Python, APIs and generative AI tooling.

What This Is Not

  • Not a paperwork or policy-only role. The controls must exist and be evidenced.
  • Not the application security lead. You support the application security team on app data security.
  • Not a general security-operations, identity-platform, endpoint or vulnerability-management role. Those sit with the Cybersecurity Engineer. Your incident work is about data.
  • Not a privacy-engineering or anonymisation role. Those sit with the data and product teams.
  • Not a legal or compliance role. The Information Security team and Data Protection Officer own governance.

Experience You Bring

  • 5/6+ years of hands-on security engineering, including ownership of security controls in production.
  • Hands-on DLP or information-protection experience in Google Workspace: sharing and external-access controls, labels and rules, and context-aware access.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 data security: Purview, SharePoint sharing and permissions, and how Entra ID access applies to data.
  • Strong access-control fundamentals across SaaS and cloud (Google Workspace, Entra ID, AWS), including how data is stored and encrypted.
  • Python scripting and API automation, and practical experience using generative AI tooling to work faster and more reliably.
  • Able to investigate data access and movement using audit logs, a SIEM, a security hub or native platform tools.
  • Able to work with product, engineering, research, clinical, privacy and information-security colleagues, and explain both the risk and the practical control.
  • Experience with health or other regulated data helps. We will teach you our regulatory and clinical context, so you need to arrive knowing how to protect data with working controls.

What Success Looks Like

  • We know where our sensitive data is, who can reach it and how it moves.
  • Sensitive data is shared only as intended, access is reviewed regularly, and external sharing is controlled and logged.
  • New tools and integrations are security-reviewed before they touch sensitive data, without slowing delivery.
  • Data incidents are scoped quickly and accurately, and audit evidence is automated and current.

What are the benefits of working with Deciphex?

  • 💰 Salary with performance-based annual increases to recognise your contribution.
  • 🩺 Healthcare benefits to support your wellbeing.
  • 🌴 Annual leave plus additional Christmas leave to rest and recharge.
  • 🔬 Meaningful work that helps improve patient outcomes.
  • 🚀 A growing company where you can make your mark.
  • 💡 Varied, challenging projects to keep you learning.
  • 📈 Regular feedback and career opportunities to help you progress.
  • 🤝 A supportive, multicultural team to share ideas and learn from.

About Deciphex

Through the work that we do, the team at Deciphex helps pharma to accelerate the process of essential drug development and helps cancer patients get a timely and accurate diagnosis.

Founded in Dublin (Ireland) in 2017, Deciphex has scaled rapidly to a team of over 230 people and counting who are providing software solutions to address the pathology gap in research pathology and clinical areas. We have offices in Dublin, Exeter, Oxford, Chicago and Toronto, and are expanding our team throughout the world.

We are software developers, clinical specialists, artificial intelligence engineers, operations professionals and so much more, all working as one team to support our customers and patients.

Read more about Deciphex here and more about our team on our Careers Page here.

Deciphex is an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to the principle of equality. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, race, religious beliefs, political views, gender identity, affectional or sexual orientation, national origin, family or marital status (including pregnancy), disability, membership of the travelling community or any other classification protected by applicable law.

VIDIZMO is hiring a Business Development Representative to open new doors for our business. You'll bring 1 to 3 years of outbound sales experience, clear and confident English, and the energy to talk with new prospects every day. You'll win new business by contacting end customers directly and by bringing in deals through our partners. You'll set up meetings with the right people, make sure there's a real need, and hand qualified opportunities to our account team, with AI tools helping you research, prepare and follow up.

About VIDIZMO

Founded in 2009, VIDIZMO is an AI software company based in Tysons, Virginia. We build four products: Nexus, AI Intelligence Hub, AI Live Insight, and Redactor. They let organizations store, search, analyze, redact and share all kinds of unstructured data, including video, audio, images, documents and text, and they give every one of those formats equal weight.

Over 100 organizations rely on VIDIZMO in production. They work in public safety and justice, government, healthcare, financial services, education, legal, manufacturing and energy. Many of them deploy it on-premises, in air-gapped environments, or in FedRAMP High environments, and our architecture is aligned with the CJIS Security Policy.

We sell both directly and through channel partners around the world, so this team deals with end customers and partners every day. VIDIZMO is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, a Microsoft Solutions Partner for Data & AI, and an NVIDIA Inception partner. Customers can purchase through GSA, Carahsoft, and state and cooperative contract vehicles.

We use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot every day, and we expect you to use them well. You're responsible for reviewing anything AI helps you create for accuracy, completeness and compliance, and the final result is yours to own.

Your Responsibilities

  • Reach out to end customers and partners daily by phone and message, working from a prioritized call list.
  • Spend at least two hours every day in live conversations with new prospects and partners.
  • Set up meetings with key decisionmakers and confirm that they have a real need.
  • Convert qualified interest into opportunities and pass them to the account team with a clear summary.
  • Register partner opportunities on the day you learn about them and bring on a new partner when a deal requires one.
  • Record every call, email and meeting in HubSpot on the day it happens.
  • Use Claude or a similar AI assistant daily to research prospects, prepare for calls, write outreach and follow up.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
  • Clear, confident English, both spoken and written, and easy to understand on calls with US buyers.
  • 1 to 3 years in outbound business development, lead generation or inside sales, or clear proof that you can do the work.
  • Comfortable making a high number of calls and hearing "no."
  • Experience using HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or similar tools.
  • A habit of recording every call and meeting on the same day.
  • A history of automating your own routine work with AI, for example with reusable prompts, Claude Projects, AI-assisted workflows or simple scripts. Share an example of something you automated.
  • Experience selling a SaaS product or service to US buyers, including outbound cold calling, is strongly preferred.
  • Able to make this a full-time commitment, without concurrent freelance work or outside business ventures.
  • Current US residence and authorization to work in the United States without visa sponsorship.

Why You'll Stand Out

Rejection doesn't stop you. After a "no," you're ready for the next call with the same energy. You're a good listener, you can tell the difference between real interest and politeness, and your pipeline and CRM are always organized. You use AI to prepare faster and follow up without missing a step, and you own your results without needing close supervision.

Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos Energy is seeking a Power Consultant Senior Project Manager - Transaction Services to play an important part in transactions, giving you an opportunity to contribute to the transformation of the energy industry. Older, inefficient power generation and transmission systems are being upgraded and replaced with modern, environmentally friendly alternatives. You will be an integral part of an exceptional team of power industry experts, providing consulting services and work products that our clients view as critical inputs to their business decisions. We evaluate a wide variety of technologies, from wind turbines and solar panels to battery storage systems, fuel cells, and advanced fuel conversion technologies.

We provide expertise, guidance, and consultation to our clients, and our work is centered on supporting financial transactions - the development, financing, acquisition and sale of generation (and non-generation) hard assets. We identify technical and commercial risks and help our clients to find and/or evaluate solutions to their challenges. Because we are exposed to numerous unique projects over short periods of time, we (i) are diversified in technologies and commercial approaches to project execution; (ii) contribute to and learn how problems are solved by industry leaders and how those solutions drive financial viability; and (iii) benefit from this knowledge as a team and as individuals, resulting in a professional experience that evolves, is dynamic, and is well-rounded.

Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you own the execution layer of our intelligence, turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems.

You will work across the model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of research, systems, and product.

What You'll Own

  • Own the end-to-end ML systems powering our company, from data and training to evaluation, inference, and deployment.

  • Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models.

  • Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance.

  • Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability.

  • Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data.

  • Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models.

  • Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements.

  • Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes.

  • Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference.

  • Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals.

  • Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently.

  • A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping.

  • High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality.

Outcomes

  • Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets.

  • ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable.

  • Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact.

  • Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction.

  • Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time.

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • GPU-based training and inference system

Ideal Experience

  • You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos.

  • You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes.

  • You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

About us

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and , we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

Your Role

Do you want to be the architect of a world-class employee journey, from the very first candidate interaction to the 90-day milestone?
Are you ready to attract and hire top-tier talent across the US while ensuring our operational backbone is flawless and scalable?

...then you are our perfect match!

This role starts with a solid foundation in People Operations and Onboarding (~60%), combined with focused, full-cycle recruiting for 2–4 critical US roles (~40%). Prepare for a steep learning curve where you will flex between talent acquisition and meticulous people operations, shaping the future of GotPhoto’s US presence.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect the Onboarding Experience: Lead the "Day 0 to Day 90" journey for all US hires.

  • Master People Operations & Compliance: Maintain absolute data integrity in our HRIS, coordinate payroll touchpoints, and support US-wide compliance and documentation across all 50 states.

  • Drive Targeted US Talent Acquisition: Own full-cycle recruiting for 2–4 concurrent roles. You won't just post ads; you’ll manage effective recruitment processes, ensure a strong candidate experience, and act as a strategic partner to our hiring managers.

  • Elevate Hiring Rigor & Strategy: Coach hiring managers on structured, bias-aware interviewing, lead decisive debriefs, and use market data to influence hiring strategy.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2–4 years of experience in agency recruiting, full-cycle in-house recruiting, or a hybrid People Ops/Talent role in the US market.

  • Recruitment Expertise: A track record of successfully managing end-to-end recruitment processes, engaging candidates, and partnering with hiring managers to make high-quality hiring decisions.

  • Operational Foundation: Hands-on experience with onboarding logistics, HRIS management, and US employment basics.

  • Tech Fluency: Experience with modern Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g., Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever), HRIS platforms, and collaborative tools like Google Workspace and Slack.

Mindset

  • The Consultative Talent Partner: You don’t just process applications—you proactively drive recruitment processes, use market data to guide hiring managers, and advocate for high-caliber culture-adds.

  • Bias to Action: You thrive in an autonomous, remote-first environment where you take full ownership of your workflows and solve ambiguous operational challenges independently.

  • Customer Obsession: You treat candidates and internal employees as your VIP customers, ensuring a seamless, white-glove experience from initial interaction to Day 90 and beyond.

Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto

  • Work Where You’re Best: In the US,we are a remote-first organization that prioritizes impact over office hours. While our roots are international, we empower our US team to design a workspace that fuels their best work—whether that’s a home office, a local café, or wherever you find your focus. You bring the talent; we provide the flexibility. Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. You have the option to work abroad for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.

  • Recharge & Unwind: We prioritize your well-being over a fixed tally of hours, which is why we offer a flexible, unlimited PTO policy and flexible sick days. Whether you need a long-awaited vacation, or time to recover from the unexpected, you have the autonomy to take the time you need to stay at your best.

  • Comprehensive Care: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you and your family are fully covered. We complement our core healthcare with a broad range of additional benefits, offering a mix of company-sponsored coverage and voluntary options designed to protect your income and your household.

  • Multicultural & Inclusive Team: We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together.

  • Fuel Your Growth: We’re big on learning. You’ll get a dedicated education budget to explore new ideas and grow professionally.

  • Stay Active, Wherever You Are: Your wellbeing matters to us. Through FitOn, you’ll get access to a wide range of online fitness and wellness classes — from yoga and strength training to cardio and mindfulness — so you can stay active and recharge wherever you

What Matters to Us

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may refrain from applying for positions if they feel they don't meet all qualifications. We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested: we're excited to discover how your distinctive experience can enhance our team!

We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However, you identify. We believe in equal opportunities.

What you'll own

  • A strategic book of business. You'll own retention, revenue growth & forecast predictability for a group of high-value biller clients in government & insurance
  • Executive relationships. You'll build relationships with executive sponsors at more than one level. One friendly contact isn't coverage. You'll know the client's strategic agenda well enough to shape it.

description: GROWTH STRATEGISTAt Fresh Prints, we work with thousands of customers, but not every customer should have the same experience with us.

raw.title: Growth Strategist
raw.excerpt: GROWTH STRATEGISTAt Fresh Prints, we work with thousands of customers, but not every customer should have the same experience with us.
raw.description:
GROWTH STRATEGIST

At Fresh Prints, we work with thousands of customers, but not every customer should have the same experience with us.

Some might be ordering for the first time. Others have been buying from us for years. Some need an occasional reminder or a well-timed offer, while others represent significant opportunities that deserve a much more personalized approach.

Today, we reach these customers through emails, SMS, automated journeys, promotional campaigns, gifting programs, and direct outreach. We've built much of the infrastructure to make these things possible, but there's a much bigger opportunity ahead of us: bringing all of these touchpoints together into a thoughtful, cohesive strategy for how we grow our customer relationships.

That's what we're hiring a Growth Strategist to do.

Your job is to understand our customers, figure out what they need at different stages of their relationship with Fresh Prints, and build experiences that make them want to engage, purchase, return, and grow with us.

For some customers, that might mean a great email at exactly the right moment. For others, it might mean an entirely different experience, with personalized outreach, exclusive offers, samples, or programs designed around their long-term potential.

We don't want someone who thinks about growth as a collection of campaigns or channels. We want someone who can see the bigger picture, identify where the opportunities are, and turn those opportunities into programs that drive meaningful business results.

This isn't a role where you inherit a finished playbook. You'll have the freedom, and responsibility, to question how we do things today, build better systems, and shape what customer growth looks like at Fresh Prints.

This role is about:

  • Understanding our customers deeply: Who they are, what they care about, why they buy, what brings them back, and what makes them disengage.
  • Designing the right experience for different customers: Knowing when automation and great content are enough, and when a relationship deserves a more personalized, high-touch approach.
  • Finding opportunities to grow customer value: Identifying where we're losing customers, leaving revenue on the table, or missing opportunities to build stronger relationships.
  • Being a great marketer: Understanding what makes someone open an email, click a link, respond to an offer, or take the next step, and being able to create that experience yourself.
  • Turning ideas into execution: Building programs, writing compelling content, coordinating teams, testing approaches, and taking ownership of the results.
  • Building systems that scale: Using data, technology, AI, and automation to create experiences that become smarter and more effective over time.

What You'll Own

Understanding Customers & Finding Growth Opportunities

  • Develop a deep understanding of Fresh Prints' customers, their buying behavior, motivations, needs, and decision-making journeys.
  • Use customer insights, data, and commercial judgment to identify the biggest opportunities to improve engagement, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, and customer value.
  • Build meaningful customer segments based on behavior, lifecycle stage, value, and growth potential, rather than treating everyone on our list the same way.
  • Identify where different customers need different experiences, and determine where we should invest more time, effort, and resources.
  • Continuously question our existing approach and develop new ideas that could materially change how customers engage and grow with Fresh Prints.

Building Experiences That Drive Growth

  • Own how Fresh Prints engages with customers throughout their relationship with us, from their first interaction to becoming loyal, repeat customers.
  • Develop thoughtful customer journeys that bring together content, communication, offers, personalization, and outreach to move customers toward the next meaningful action.
  • Own the strategy, messaging, and execution of customer communications across email, SMS, automated journeys, and promotional programs.
  • Build experiences around key customer moments, including onboarding, first purchases, post-purchase engagement, repeat purchases, reactivation, and win-back.
  • Develop more personalized approaches for our highest-value customers, including targeted campaigns, gifting, exclusive programs, and coordinated outreach with account-facing teams.
  • Create compelling content that customers actually want to engage with, from subject lines and SMS messages to promotional concepts and personalized pitches.
  • Work closely with Brand and Creative to make sure everything we put in front of customers feels relevant, engaging, and distinctly Fresh Prints.

Turning Strategy Into Results

  • Take ideas from insight to execution. You'll be expected to develop the strategy, build the plan, and make sure it actually happens.
  • Own performance across the experiences and programs you build, using engagement, conversion, retention, repeat purchase behavior, revenue, and customer value to measure success.
  • Develop a disciplined approach to experimentation, constantly testing messaging, offers, timing, audience selection, and customer experiences.
  • Look beyond surface-level metrics to understand what's actually driving performance and what needs to change.
  • Use our marketing technology, customer data, automation platforms, and AI tools to build and improve programs efficiently.
  • Maintain strong execution standards across customer communications, including segmentation accuracy, deliverability, list health, testing, and quality control.
  • Build processes, playbooks, and systems that allow successful programs to scale without requiring constant manual intervention.

Making Growth a Company-Wide Effort

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Creative, Data, Tech, and Operations to turn customer insights and growth opportunities into coordinated action.
  • Influence how different teams engage with customers when changes are needed to improve retention, expansion, or the overall customer experience.
  • Bring a clear point of view on where we should focus, what we should test, and what we should stop doing.
  • Make the business case for new initiatives, align stakeholders, and drive execution even when the people involved don't report to you.
  • Help build a more connected approach to customer growth, where every interaction contributes to a stronger long-term relationship.

Who You Are

  • You're a marketer first. You understand people, what motivates them, and how to turn that understanding into messaging and experiences that drive action. You can write a great subject line as comfortably as you can design a customer growth strategy.
  • You think in customer journeys, not marketing channels. You don't see email, SMS, or account-based programs as separate worlds. You see different ways to engage different customers based on what they need and what they're worth to the business.
  • You're commercially minded. You understand that engagement is a means to an end. You're constantly thinking about how your work influences purchases, retention, revenue, and long-term customer value.
  • You're both strategic and hands-on. You enjoy figuring out the big picture, but you're equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves to write the copy, build a journey, launch a test, or troubleshoot a problem.
  • You're curious about customers. You don't assume you know what people want. You ask questions, study behavior, challenge assumptions, and use what you learn to build better experiences.
  • You think in systems. Rather than solving the same problem every month with another campaign, you look for ways to build something that will keep working and improving.
  • You have strong ownership. You don't need someone else to constantly set priorities or check the quality of your work. You hold yourself accountable for both the thinking and the execution.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You don't need a detailed playbook to get started. You can take an unclear opportunity, develop a strong point of view, and create a path forward.
  • You know how to bring people along. You can challenge ideas, communicate clearly, and work across teams to get things done without relying on formal authority.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, customer growth, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated experience owning marketing initiatives end-to-end, from identifying opportunities and developing strategy to execution and performance analysis.
  • Strong marketing instincts and writing ability, with experience creating messaging, campaigns, or customer experiences that drive measurable action.
  • Experience working with customer segmentation, behavioral data, and lifecycle journeys.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to understand customer behavior, evaluate performance, and make decisions.
  • Experience improving conversion, customer engagement, repeat purchases, retention, or revenue through marketing initiatives.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and independently drive projects from concept to completion.
  • Experience with SMS, account-based marketing, loyalty programs, or high-value customer engagement is a plus.
  • Experience in B2C, DTC, e-commerce, or businesses with repeat-purchase behavior is strongly preferred.

Above all, we're looking for someone who combines great marketing instincts with strong strategic thinking and the ability to execute. Someone who can look at how we engage with customers today, see what we could be doing better, and take ownership of making it happen.

Details and other benefits

  • Work From Home / Remote
  • Competitive annual salary
  • Learning opportunities
  • Working in a great culture
  • At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees

Fresh Prints is an equal employment opportunity employer and promotes diversity, actively encouraging people of all backgrounds, ages, LGBTQ+, and those with disabilities to apply.

Overview

Every day, Imagine Communications is delivering billions of media moments all over the world — anywhere, anytime, and on any device. Imagine Communications delivers innovative, end-to-end media software and networking solutions to over 3,000 customers in more than 185 countries, including the world’s leading broadcasters, network operators, and content owners who rely on our playout and infrastructure solutions to keep their channels on air and their operations running at scale.

A Bit About The Role

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing, as a Product Marketing Manager for our Playout and Infrastructure products, you are responsible for deeply understanding the market and making your products highly visible as part of a truly compelling proposition for the customer base.

This role is the strategic center of gravity for how Imagine’s Playout and Infrastructure portfolio reaches the market. You own the go-to-market strategy — defining who to target, with what message, through what channels — and you lead that thinking in close partnership with product, engineering, sales, support, and marketing teams. You are an enthusiastic and knowledgeable portfolio evangelist for the “Make TV” side of our business — the playout, infrastructure, and operational technology that keeps broadcasters on air.

This role serves as the critical bridge between technical development and go-to-market strategy. You work with engineering and product owners to deeply understand the roadmap and translate it into positioning, messaging, and market strategy that resonates with buyers and empowers the teams around you. You back up strategic insights with market evidence — knowing your competitors, your buyers, and how purchasing decisions are made — and use that knowledge to ensure the full organization is aligned on who we’re targeting, what problems we solve, and why Imagine is the right choice. You understand the buying community for products and what value proposition and messaging support their needs.

  • Own positioning and messaging for the Playout and Infrastructure portfolio — developing clear value propositions, buyer-specific narratives, and competitive differentiators that translate complex technology into compelling reasons to choose Imagine
  • Lead go-to-market strategy, defining target audiences, the messages that resonate with each, and how we reach them — building programs that find customers and help them find us
  • Partner with Product Owners to shape go-to-market plans for new products and releases, ensuring market and buyer perspectives are embedded in how we develop, launch, and evolve the portfolio
  • Lead the development of high-impact content that moves buyers through the decision process — customer case studies, white papers, and thought leadership that demonstrate real-world value and set Imagine apart
  • Equip the sales team with the tools to compete and win — including presentations, product battle cards, and deal-specific materials that communicate value clearly across technical, user, and economic buyers
  • Own Imagine’s voice in the market through website, blog, and press content that reflects current positioning and speaks to the right audiences at the right moment
  • Identify the industry events, trade shows, and speaking forums that matter most to our buyers, and lead the strategy for how Imagine shows up — what story we tell, who tells it, and what outcomes we drive

About You

raw.description:
JOB ROLE: Business Development Manager – New Client Acquisition

LOCATION: Remote

HOURS: Monday - Friday 8am-5pm (UK hours)

SALARY: 20,000 ZAR per month + Bonus based on performance

About the role

Optimal delivers property maintenance and refurbishment services. We’re looking for a proactive, commercially driven salesperson whose sole focus is winning new business clients.

Your job is to identify suitable businesses, reach decision-makers, understand their property requirements and demonstrate why Optimal is the right partner for them. You’ll build your own pipeline, generate qualified opportunities and turn prospects into clients with the potential for regular, repeat work.

You’ll own the sales process from first contact through to securing the client and supporting their first confirmed opportunity. You’ll then provide a clear handover to our Client Project Management team, who will take responsibility for ongoing account management and delivery.

We’re building our own system with AI and automations to reduce administration and improve productivity. We want someone who already uses tools such as ChatGPT and is constantly looking for ways to research better, improve outreach and win more business.

Key responsibilities

Find and engage new prospects

  • Identify businesses with ongoing property maintenance and refurbishment requirements.
  • Build targeted prospect lists, focusing on organisations where Optimal can win profitable, repeat work.
  • Identify decision-makers and understand how they appoint and assess maintenance contractors.
  • Generate opportunities through outbound calls, email, LinkedIn, referrals and networking.
  • Take ownership of your prospecting activity and consistently create new sales conversations.

Turn conversations into opportunities

  • Understand each prospect’s property portfolio, service requirements and frustrations with existing arrangements.
  • Ask effective questions to establish business potential, decision-making authority, buying process and timing.
  • Explain clearly how Optimal can meet their needs and address their concerns.
  • Secure meetings, introductions, quote opportunities and access to relevant supplier onboarding processes.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up and move prospects towards a clear next step.

Win new business clients

  • Own the new business sales process from initial approach through to agreement and activation.
  • Work with the quoting and operational teams to develop credible proposals and competitive offers.
  • Present proposals confidently, handle objections and negotiate within agreed commercial guidelines.
  • Secure the first confirmed work and establish a clear opportunity for an ongoing relationship.
  • Focus on clients whose needs fit Optimal’s capabilities and offer sustainable commercial value.
  • Make accurate commitments on pricing, service and delivery, with internal agreement where needed.

Deliver a clear client handover

  • Coordinate a smooth introduction to the Client Project Management team once the client is won.
  • Record the client’s requirements, key contacts, agreed terms, commitments and immediate opportunities.
  • Ensure the client understands who will manage their work and how to request services.
  • Support the initial transition so the relationship starts well, then return your focus to winning the next client.

Manage your pipeline and performance

  • Keep prospect records, sales stages, next actions and expected outcomes accurate in our system.
  • Maintain a healthy pipeline and provide realistic forecasts.
  • Track which sectors, messages and outreach methods produce the strongest results.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and regular sales reviews.
  • Take responsibility for meeting agreed activity, conversion and new business targets.

Use AI to sell more effectively

  • Use ChatGPT and other approved AI tools to support prospect research, meeting preparation, outreach drafting and follow-up.
  • Personalise communications and check facts before contacting prospects.
  • Use our developing system and automations to improve consistency and reduce repetitive administration.
  • Keep learning about new AI capabilities and share practical ideas that improve sales performance.
  • Handle prospect and company information responsibly.

What success looks like

Your primary measure of success is new business clients won and the profitable work they generate.

We’ll also measure:

  • Qualified new business opportunities created.
  • Meetings held with relevant decision-makers.
  • Conversion from prospect to first confirmed job.
  • New client revenue and gross profit against agreed targets.
  • Sales cycle length and pipeline quality.
  • The accuracy and completeness of client handovers.
  • Activity targets support these outcomes. We want someone who turns outreach into commercial results.

Requirements

  • A proven track record in outbound B2B sales and winning new business clients.
  • Evidence that you can generate your own pipeline and close opportunities.
  • Confidence making cold calls, reaching decision-makers and asking for business.
  • Strong questioning, listening, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Persistence and discipline with follow-up, combined with sound judgement about where to focus your time.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of the difference between winning revenue and winning profitable business.
  • Experience in property maintenance, refurbishment, facilities management, construction or a related service sector.
  • Enough trade knowledge to hold credible conversations, recognise opportunities and involve technical colleagues when needed.
  • Hands-on experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools to improve productivity.
  • A commitment to continually developing your sales skills, trade knowledge and use of AI.
  • Confidence using CRM systems, Microsoft Office and digital prospecting tools.
  • Strong written and spoken communication and the ability to work independently against clear targets.
  • Experience selling to property managers, managing agents, landlords, facilities teams or businesses with multiple sites is an advantage.

Additional requirement for remote working, you must have:

  • Your own well-specified computer: A reliable, modern computer capable of running multiple business applications, AI tools and video calls smoothly.
  • Two screens: A dual-screen setup for efficient prospecting, research and client communication.
  • A good-quality camera: A clear, professional webcam for client and team meetings.
  • A good-quality headset: Headphones with a clear microphone suitable for frequent sales calls.
  • Fast, reliable internet: A stable connection that supports uninterrupted calls and cloud-based systems.
  • A suitable home office: A dedicated, quiet and professional workspace where you can make sales calls without interruptions.
  • Availability aligned with UK operations: The ability to work agreed hours that suit UK prospects and colleagues.
  • You must be comfortable maintaining a consistent outbound sales routine, staying accessible and taking ownership of your results.

Benefits

  • A role with a clear focus on winning new business.
  • Support from quoting and delivery colleagues to help turn opportunities into successful client relationships.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a business developing its own system with AI and automations.
  • A collaborative, commercially focused environment where your results are visible.
  • Opportunities to develop as the business grows.

raw.description:
CHW Lead - Job Description

The CHW Lead oversees the day-to-day operations and performance of the CHW team, ensuring alignment with the New Mexico Department of Health (NMDOH) Community Health Worker Scope of Work and FronteraCare’s clinical and operational standards.

This position involves managing a remote, regionally dispersed team of CHWs, providing mentorship, training, and support to ensure high-quality outreach, engagement, and continuity of care for families receiving Diagnostic and ABA services. The CHW Lead also serves as a liaison between CHWs, clinical leadership, and administrative teams.

Clinical Quality

  • Oversee CHW activities to ensure consistent and effective family engagement, outreach, and care coordination across FronteraCare regions.

  • Monitor performance metrics related to client onboarding, service continuity, and waitlist management.

  • Personally engage with high-risk or stalled families to re-engage them and move them through the intake process.

  • Support CHWs in coordinating referrals, assessments, and family onboarding processes; directly monitor intake conversion and time-to-start metrics across assigned regions and proactively intervene on stalled or at-risk cases.Support CHWs in coordinating referrals, assessments, and family onboarding processes.

  • Ensure documentation accuracy and adherence to Frontera Health and NMDOH standards.

  • Analyze data and identify trends in service barriers and family engagement; collaborate with leadership to address system-level challenges.

  • Maintain familiarity with community resources and state programs to guide CHWs in providing accurate, up-to-date information to families.

  • Manage CHW program that drives Client / Family outcomes, collaborates effectively with interdisciplinary care team, and optimizes growth and revenue across Diagnostics and ABA Therapy Services

Professional and Ethical Conduct

  • Model professional, ethical, and culturally responsive behavior consistent with Frontera Health and NMDOH CHW standards.

  • Promote integrity, confidentiality, and accountability in all aspects of work and leadership.

  • Uphold FronteraCare’s mission of family-centered care and equitable access to services.

  • Conduct regular supervision and case reviews to ensure CHWs operate within ethical and regulatory guidelines.

  • Support compliance with all federal, state, and company policies and procedures.

Communication and Family Interaction

  • Provide guidance to CHWs on effective communication strategies with families, including education on ABA services, service navigation, and addressing barriers to care.

  • Oversee communication workflows to ensure families receive timely and consistent information.

  • Serve as an escalation point for complex family or community concerns requiring leadership input, and as an active driver of forward movement for families stuck in the intake pipeline, proactively identifying and working stalled cases.Serve as an escalation point for complex family or community concerns requiring leadership input.

  • Foster a culture of empathy, respect, and responsiveness across the CHW team.

  • When needed, engage directly with families to model high-quality service delivery and reinforce Frontera Health’s standards for engagement.

  • Lead full alignment with FronteraCare’s technology platforms, ensure CHWs are fully engaging families in obtaining consent, using the parent training app, and understanding video-based technology.

  • Monitor CHW use of technology to support family engagement, promote adherence to digital protocols, and identify areas for additional training or support.

Leadership and Mentorship

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a remote team of Community Health Workers across New Mexico.

  • Provide ongoing coaching, training, and performance feedback through regular one-on-one supervision and virtual team meetings.

  • Support staff development by identifying professional growth opportunities and encouraging CHW certification and continuing education.

  • Set and hold CHWs accountable to proactive outreach cadences and intake-conversion targets; monitor productivity and quality metrics for the CHW team.

  • Monitor productivity, quality metrics, and documentation compliance for the CHW team.

  • Collaborate with the Business Operations Director and HR to recruit, onboard, and train new CHWs.

  • Identify systemic intake bottlenecks and drive fixes in partnership with Intake and Scheduling leadership.

  • Foster a positive, inclusive, and solutions-oriented team culture that reflects FronteraCare’s values.

  • Serve as a communication bridge between CHWs and leadership, ensuring information flows clearly and consistently across regions.

Qualifications and Requirements

Required:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience as a CHW, care coordinator, or similar role in health, behavioral health, or social services.

  • Active social work license (LSW, LMSW, or LCSW per NM licensure requirements).

  • Demonstrated experience providing peer leadership, mentoring, or supervision.

  • Strong ability to lead and communicate effectively in a remote work environment.

  • Excellent organizational skills and comfort with technology (video platforms, case management systems, and reporting tools).

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish with the ability to communicate professionally in both languages.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience in a leadership or supervisory role within a healthcare, behavioral health, or social service setting.

  • Demonstrated track record improving family engagement, conversion, or throughput metrics in a prior role.

  • Knowledge of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) or experience supporting families of children with developmental or behavioral needs.

  • Active Community Health Worker Certification from the NMDOH Office of Community Health Workers.

At Frontera, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and safe—period. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to maintaining an environment where harassment, discrimination, and retaliation have no place.

raw.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike.

We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

As a Team Lead at Reserv, you will be a working leader providing support to a Claims manager with leadership and claim technical responsibilities. Leadership responsibilities will include overseeing work done within the Commercial Transportation Claims (trucking) adjusting staff. We want your background and experience to deliver operational effectiveness, particularly in leveraging technology and analytics to drive better efficiencies and performance. You will serve a critical role with the team, the customers, and the client. This role will balance management responsibilities and individual contributor responsibilities when volume dictates the need for assistance with a claim.

Who you are

  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented, impactful and influential
  • Claims professional - you are knowledgeable and have a track record of success in commercial transportation claims adjudication.
  • Strong leader - through formal management experience or a proven track record of peer and project leadership, you have demonstrated the ability to motivate, support, and teach a team to help them excel in their roles.
  • Tech-oriented - You are excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims organization while delivering an excellent service and have proven results leveraging technology and analytics.
  • Passionate - Claims professional who cares about their team, the customer, and their experience
  • Empathetic leader - You exercise empathy and patience towards everyone you interact with
  • Sense of urgency - at all times. That does not mean working at all hours
  • Creative - You challenge existing assumptions and find ways of leveraging technology and the talents of your team to address problems
  • Curious - You want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and be decisive when it counts.
  • Problem solver - You have the ability to take a ‘deep dive’ into the details of the business while staying focused on the big picture.
  • Anti-status quo - You don’t just wish things were done differently; you act on it
  • Communicative - You are comfortable with and understand the importance of phone communications throughout the claims process.
  • And did we mention a sense of humor? Claims are hard enough as it is!

What we need

We need you to do all the things typical to the role:

  • Flexibility - you will need to be able to switch from claims handling to coaching and feedback
  • Agility- you must have an agile mindset and the ability to pivot from focus to focus in a moment’s notice
  • Be consistently dependable in achieving or exceeding goals and overcoming obstacles
  • Implement and maintain best practices for claims handling, including claim intake, investigation, evaluation, settlement, and recovery
  • Align team with client and customer expectations of the claims process
  • Serve as a resource for escalated claims
  • Foster a positive work environment, promote teamwork, and encourage professional growth and development
  • Attract, hire, retain, and provide a high level of training with the support of the rest of the leadership team
  • Prepare and present comprehensive claims reports, metrics, and analyses to clients and customers; advise clients on claim trends and loss mitigation

Job Duties:

  • Serve as backup/leader when the Manager is out of office
  • Responsible for having direct reports
  • Responsible for initial onboarding tasks/ access and new hire cultural immersion
  • SME for first-line questions, escalations, roundtable discussions
  • Increased reserve and payment authority with the ability to assist with moderate reviews
  • Identify topics and trends to discuss in team Huddles and Elevated Claims Experience Workshops lead/ co-lead by Team Leads, Managers, and other Reserv employees
  • Customer Obsession Champions- Active advocates who help leadership cultivate a customer-centric mindset

Requirements

  • 5+ years of insurance claims experience in multiple lines of business, preference for an transportation (trucking) with some bodily injury experience
  • Active adjuster license required: resident state license if available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license
  • 3+ years of leadership experience with a preference for experience managing in a remote environment
  • Comfortable with technology and the ability to evolve the claims systems and processes to drive better efficiencies and outcomes
  • Demonstrated commitment to quality, accuracy, and attention to detail
  • Integrity, ethics, and a strong sense of accountability in handling confidential and sensitive information

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance paired with frequent, regular corporate retreats to build team cohesion, reinforce culture, and have fun
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity and believe that a variety of perspectives leads to innovation and success. We are actively seeking candidates who will bring unique perspectives and experiences to our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from underrepresented groups to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Become a part of our caring community

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first


The Home Health Strategy Advancement Advisor develops strategic direction and provides operational support for complex, cross-functional CenterWell Home Health priorities, such as clinician productivity & workforce strategy to support growth and high-quality patient care.


The Strategy Advancement Advisor works cross functionally to design, implement, and track initiatives that drive enterprise value via:

  • Strategy: Develop strategy with accompanying roadmap and metrics to best solve complex challenges and drive operational outcomes
  • Operational improvement focus: As part of strategic work, analyze current operations and workflows to ensure that strategy reflects on-the-ground needs and to identify areas for improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement: Closely collaborate with stakeholders (from field to senior leadership) and lead cross-functional project teams to define opportunities, present findings, build cross-organizational alignment, and implement strategic initiatives.
  • High degree of organization and bias for action: Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring impact, timely delivery, and adherence to metrics.
  • Data-driven decision making: Utilize quantitative data (including partnering with Analytics team) and qualitative data (e.g., stakeholder interviews/surveys and field visits) to support strategy development, pilot design, and decision making.
  • Tool & dashboard strategy: To support strategy implementation, develop plan for required tools that enable ongoing performance tracking and decision-making.


Use your skills to make an impact

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in strategy consulting or 6 years of corporate strategy / operations work, workforce planning, or related discipline
  • Must have independently led significant, quantifiable business impact in fast-paced strategic environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Economics, Data Analytics, Human Resources, or a related field (Master's degree or MBA preferred)
  • Experience working in or with healthcare organizations, especially home healthcare, is a strong plus


Additional Information

Skills

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Proven experience in strategy, business operations, or workforce planning
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and software
  • Able to author and present materials for Management Team / CEO-level audiences with limited guidance
  • Track record of setting and achieving performance metrics and KPIs, with a focus on delivering tangible and measurable results
  • Proven project management skills with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and multiple initiatives simultaneously
  • Experience working cross-functionally with HR, data teams, and operations
  • Familiarity with change management principles and tools

Personal Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset
  • Self-starter who takes ownership and thrives both independently and in team environments
  • Detail oriented and organized, with strong execution discipline
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong ethical standards and commitment to integrity
  • Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Tech-savvy and intellectually curious
  • Passion for improving home healthcare outcomes and experience
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$104,000 - $143,000 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About CenterWell Senior Primary Care: CenterWell Senior Primary Care provides proactive, preventive care to seniors, including wellness visits, physical exams, chronic condition management, screenings, minor injury treatment and more. Our unique care model focuses on personalized experiences, taking time to listen, learn and address the factors that impact patient well-being. Our integrated care teams, which include physicians, nurses, behavioral health specialists and more, spend up to 50 percent more time with patients, providing compassionate, personalized care that brings better health outcomes. We go beyond physical health by also addressing other factors that can impact a patient’s well-being.About CenterWell, a Humana company: CenterWell is a leading healthcare services business focused on creating integrated and differentiated experiences that put our patients at the center of everything we do. The result is high-quality healthcare that is accessible, comprehensive and, most of all, personalized. As the largest provider of senior-focused primary care, a leading provider of home healthcare and a leading integrated home delivery, specialty, hospice and retail pharmacy, CenterWell is focused on whole health and addressing the physical, emotional and social wellness of our patients. CenterWell is part of Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM). Learn more about what we offer at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

title: Jr. AI Native Engineer
description: The opportunityAt Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth.

raw.title: Jr. AI Native Engineer
raw.excerpt: The opportunityAt Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth.
raw.description:
The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

Why Valtech?

At Valtech, we are transforming how people experience the world through technology. Our culture is built around a mindset to make, learn and grow, bringing together technology, creativity and experience to solve meaningful business challenges. [valtech.com]
AI is rapidly changing what it means to build software, and we want people who are excited to be part of that change.
We are looking for an AI Native Engineer who has spent the last few years building strong software engineering foundations while actively exploring what's possible with AI. You are someone who didn't wait for AI to become part of your job description. You started experimenting, building, breaking things and learning.
You may have built an agent because you wanted to understand how agents actually work. You may have experimented with several models to understand their strengths and limitations. Maybe you've created a RAG application, automated part of your development workflow, contributed to an AI project, or simply spent countless hours turning new ideas into working prototypes.

That curiosity matters to us.

If you're an engineer who sees the emergence of AI as an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how software is built, we'd like to meet you.

The role

As an AI Native Engineer, you'll work with multidisciplinary teams to design, prototype and build intelligent digital products and experiences.
You'll combine strong software engineering fundamentals with modern AI capabilities, working across large language models, agentic systems, retrieval, APIs, cloud platforms and emerging development tools.
Importantly, you'll help us discover what's next.
The AI landscape is moving quickly. We don't expect you to have all the answers. We expect you to be excited about finding them.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and ship AI-native applications and experiences for real-world use cases.
  • Build applications using large language models, generative AI APIs and agentic architectures.
  • Develop high-quality software using Python, TypeScript/JavaScript or comparable modern languages.
  • Work with models and platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and open-source models.
  • Build RAG and knowledge-retrieval solutions using embeddings, semantic search, vector databases and enterprise data.
  • Experiment with AI agents, tool/function calling, structured outputs, orchestration and multi-step workflows.
  • Integrate AI solutions with APIs, databases, existing platforms and enterprise systems.
  • Rapidly prototype new ideas, test assumptions and turn promising experiments into scalable solutions.
  • Build approaches for evaluating and testing AI systems, considering quality, accuracy, reliability, latency and cost.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools to explore new ways of designing, developing, testing and maintaining software.
  • Apply sound engineering practices around security, privacy, responsible AI, observability and human oversight.
  • Share what you're learning and contribute to the evolving AI engineering practices across Valtech.

What we're looking for

  • 2–4 years of professional software engineering or application development experience.
  • Strong programming experience with Python, TypeScript/JavaScript or another modern programming language.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals, including application architecture, APIs, testing, debugging, version control and CI/CD.
  • Hands-on experience building with generative AI, whether through client work, production applications, prototypes, internal innovation, hackathons, open-source contributions or substantial personal projects.
  • Practical experience working with LLMs and model APIs, including prompting, context management, structured outputs and model selection.
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, semantic search or vector databases.
  • Exposure to agents, function/tool calling or AI workflow orchestration.
  • Experience connecting applications to APIs, data sources, databases and cloud services.
  • An understanding that building a great AI demo and building a dependable AI product are two very different challenges.
  • Most importantly, a demonstrated habit of exploring emerging technology and turning your curiosity into something tangible.

We'd love it if you've...

We don't expect you to check every box. You might have:
  • Built your own AI application, agent, copilot or developer tool.
  • Experimented with multiple models and learned where each performs well, and where it doesn't.
  • Built RAG solutions using real-world or enterprise data.
  • Explored agentic architectures, tool use or multi-agent workflows.
  • Worked with frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph or LlamaIndex.
  • Used technologies such as Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch, pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant or Weaviate.
  • Built applications on Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
  • Used tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Cursor as part of your engineering workflow.
  • Created evaluations or testing approaches for AI outputs.
  • Participated in AI hackathons, internal innovation initiatives or open-source communities.
  • Seen a newly released AI capability and thought,“I need to try that.”
Specific frameworks will come and go. We're more interested in how you learn, what you've built and what you've discovered along the way.

You are

A builder.
You don't just read about AI. You build with it. You're comfortable moving from an idea to a prototype and learning through experimentation.
An explorer.
New models, multimodal experiences, agents, reasoning systems and AI development tools genuinely interest you. You're energized by a technology landscape where the playbook is still being written.
An engineer.
You care about what happens after the demo. Reliability, maintainability, architecture, security and testing matter to you.
A pragmatic thinker.
You understand that AI isn't the answer to every problem. You're interested in finding where it creates genuine value, not adding AI for AI's sake.
A learner.
You won't know every new model, framework or technique. That's okay. What matters is being able to say: “I haven't worked with that yet. Let's figure it out.”

What you can expect from us

You'll join an environment where experimentation and continuous learning are part of how we work. You'll collaborate with people across engineering, data, experience and strategy, and have opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to meaningful client and business challenges.
Valtech currently recruits across AI-focused roles alongside engineering, cloud, data and digital experience disciplines, reinforcing that AI is being embedded within the broader technology organization rather than existing solely as a standalone specialty.
You'll have room to make, learn and grow, while helping shape what AI-native engineering means at Valtech.
