raw.description:
WHO WE ARE: MagicSchool is the premier generative AI platform for teachers. We're just over 2 years old, and more than 7 million teachers from all over the world have joined our platform. Join a top team at a fast growing company that is working towards real social impact. Make an account and try us out at our website and connect with our passionate community on our Wall of Love.

The Account Executive will own MagicSchool's Gulf Coast territory, turning a strong existing foundation into meaningful revenue during a high-priority window for the state. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: you'll navigate state-level dynamics and the K-12 education landscape while personally driving deals across the finish line, from stakeholder mapping through procurement. This role requires a proactive approach to tailoring our offerings, working both internally and with clients, to secure MagicSchool as the solution of choice amidst competitive pressures.

Location: This is a remote position with Alabama location preferred. We are open to candidates across any state in the territory.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving towards the following outcomes:

  • Territory revenue ownership: Deliver against a $1M to $1.2M annual quota by closing K-12 district partnerships across the Gulf Coast, with average deal size of $50K+.

  • Full-cycle deal execution: Own deals end-to-end, from opportunity development through procurement and close, personally driving the details that move contracts forward.

  • Strategic territory planning: Build and execute a sales plan that leverages the foundation already built to accelerate revenue within your first six months, not the typical 12 to 18 month ramp.

  • State and district relationship building: Cultivate senior relationships with superintendents, district leaders, and state-level stakeholders to shape MagicSchool's positioning

  • Expand Reach: Leverage successes in one district to facilitate conversations and sales with neighboring districts.

  • Collaborate Internally: Work with product, finance, success, marketing, and other teams to customize our offerings to meet the needs of large districts.

  • Qualifications, competencies, and skills

  • To be successful in this role, you'll bring the following skills and competencies:

  • Gulf Coast education fluency: You understand how Gulf Coast K-12 works, including DOE dynamics, legislative context, district politics, and the state's specific procurement patterns.

  • Demonstrated sales results: You have a consistent track record of quota attainment and can speak to specific deals, how you won them, and the outcomes you drove.

  • Operational ownership: You take pride in the details of moving a deal forward, from procurement navigation to final signatures, and don't rely on others to handle the friction.

  • Strategic sales thinking: You approach territory planning with rigor, sequence multi-stakeholder deals thoughtfully, and think several moves ahead inside an opportunity.

  • Competitive positioning: You know how to sell in a competitive K-12 landscape and can position effectively against other solutions.

What sets our sales team apart

  • The people who thrive on our sales team share a common set of qualities. We look for salespeople who are:

  • Hungry: Exhibit a strong work ethic, take ownership of their book, and consistently exceed expectations.

  • Execution-minded: Quick learners, curious and resourceful, with a knack for creative problem-solving.

  • Relationship-driven: Excel at building relationships, highly emotionally intelligent, communicate clearly, and project warmth.

  • Cross-functional leaders: Drive teams across product, finance, customer success, and marketing to achieve strategic goals.

  • Visionary: See the bigger picture, foster success within large accounts, and strategically allocate their time, pilots, and resources.

Experience

  • Required: 5+ years in strategic or enterprise EdTech sales, with a track record of top-seller performance and consistent quota attainment against complex K-12 or public sector deals.

  • Required: Deep connections and working knowledge of Gulf Coast's K-12 education landscape, including direct experience selling into Gulf Coast districts and established state-level relationships across DOE, district leadership, and procurement.

  • Required: Willingness to travel up to 50%.

  • Preferred: Background at education technology or productivity platform serving K-12.

  • Preferred: Prior district or state-level education leadership experience.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI technology that directly impacts educators and students.

  • Join a mission-driven team passionate about making education more efficient and equitable.

  • Flexibility of working from home, while fostering a unique culture built on relationships, trust, communication, and collaboration with our team - no matter where they live.

For full time employees:

  • Unlimited time off to empower our employees to manage their work-life balance. We work hard for our teachers and users, and encourage our employees to rest and take the time they need.

  • Choice of employer-paid health insurance plans so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Dental and vision are also offered at very low premiums.

  • Every employee is offered generous stock options, vested over 4 years.

  • 401k match & monthly wellness stipend.

Our Values:

  • Educators are Magic: Educators are the most important ingredient in the educational process - they are the magic, not the AI. Trust them, empower them, and put them at the center of leading change in service of students and families.

  • Joy and Magic: Bring joy and magic into every learning experience - push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI.

  • Community: Foster community that supports one another during a time of rapid technological change. Listen to them and serve their needs.

  • Innovation: The education system is outdated and in need of innovation and change - AI is an opportunity to bring equity, access, and serve the individual needs of students better than we ever have before.

  • Responsibility: Put responsibility and safety at the forefront of the technological change that AI is bringing to education.

  • Diversity: Diversity of thought, perspectives, and backgrounds helps us serve the wide audience of educators and students around the world.

  • Excellence: Educators and students deserve the best - and we strive for the highest quality in everything we do.

Compensation Range: $75K - $130K

You’ll own the marketing strategy and activation for assigned events and field marketing programs, within an agreed event calendar and level of marketing support. You’ll define how NIQ shows up, what we communicate, and how we engage priority audiences before, during, and after each event.

This role combines independent program ownership with hands-on execution and guidance from the Events and Partner Marketing lead and North America Marketing Leader.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop event marketing plans that define target audiences, messaging, customer experiences, and desired commercial outcomes.

  • Write invitations, promotional emails, and follow-up communications; build emails and landing pages; and coordinate digital and social promotion.

  • Partner with Sales to identify priority accounts and contacts, align on meeting goals, and prepare outreach resources that support productive conversations.

  • Deliver on-site activations, coordinating with Marketing Operations on logistics and owning selected logistics tasks as agreed.

  • Execute timely post-event campaigns that connect attendee interests with relevant content, meetings, or solution discussions.

  • Coordinate lead capture, qualification, and routing with Sales and marketing partners; monitor follow-up and escalate gaps.

Events engage the intended audiences, qualified interest reaches Sales with actionable context, and timely follow-up supports progression toward pipeline.

  • Relevant B2B marketing experience, typically gained over 3+ years in event marketing, field marketing, customer marketing, or demand generation.

  • Strong writing skills and hands-on experience building emails and landing pages.

  • Experience partnering with Sales on customer outreach and engagement.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage overlapping timelines and stakeholders.

  • Ability to interpret performance data and recommend practical improvements.

  • Travel: Approximately 25% within the United States

Preferred Experience

  • Delivering on-site B2B event activations or targeted customer programs.

Our Benefits

  • Flexible working environment

If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. For more information, please visit NIQ’s AI Safety Policies and Guiding Principles:

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About India Market Entry (IME):
India Market Entry (IME) is a leader in market entry strategy and business expansion in the
Education Sector in India. We excel in assisting international clients to establish themselves
in the Indian market. Our mission is to build lasting relationships with customers through
intelligent sales engagement, value-based selling, and deep market understanding.
About the Role
As an ISM – Outbound Partnerships & Institutional Outreach, you will be responsible for
identifying and engaging potential strategic partners, Higher Education institutions,
publishers and other relevant organisations through structured, targeted outreach.
The role will primarily involve email-led prospecting, supported by calls, LinkedIn and other
appropriate channels, to identify the right organisations and decision-makers, initiate
meaningful conversations, understand their requirements and create opportunities for
strategic partnerships and business development.
You will engage with stakeholders such as Deans, Directors, Vice Chancellors, Heads of
Departments, Publisher Heads, Business Heads, HR/L&D Leaders and other senior
decision-makers.
This is a target-driven, research and outreach-focused role that requires strong
communication, persistence, follow-up and the ability to convert cold/warm outreach into
meaningful business conversations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Target Account Identification
  • Research and identify potential Higher Education institutions, publishers,
strategic partners and corporate organisations.
  • Build and maintain a targeted database of organisations and relevant
decision-makers.
  • Identify the right stakeholder within each organisation based on the nature of the
opportunity.
  • Prioritise accounts based on relevance, potential and business opportunity.
2. Email Outreach
  • Plan and execute targeted email outreach campaigns to prospective organisations
and decision-makers.
  • Develop personalised and relevant email communication based on the organisation
and potential opportunity.
  • Manage structured follow-up sequences to improve response and meeting rates.
  • Experiment with messaging, subject lines and outreach approaches to improve
effectiveness.
  • Coordinate with Marketing/GTM teams on campaigns and communication assets
where required.
3. Strategic Partnership Outreach
  • Identify potential partners for institutional tie-ups, content partnerships,
distribution, learning programmes, technology partnerships and other
strategic opportunities.
  • Initiate conversations with potential partners and understand their business
requirements.
  • Qualify the opportunity and assess strategic fit.
  • Coordinate with senior team members for discussions involving high-value or
strategic accounts.
4. Higher Education Outreach
  • Reach out to universities, colleges, business schools and other Higher
Education institutions.
  • Identify relevant decision-makers and initiate conversations around potential
collaboration and business opportunities.
  • Understand institutional priorities, requirements and decision-making processes.
  • Generate qualified meetings for the relevant GTM/Sales team.
5. Publisher & Content Partner Outreach
  • Identify relevant educational publishers and content organisations.
  • Approach publishing, business development and senior leadership teams regarding
potential partnerships.
  • Understand their portfolio, market presence and potential areas of collaboration.
  • Develop and maintain a pipeline of potential publisher partnerships.
6. Prospect Qualification & Meeting Generation
  • Conduct initial conversations to understand the prospect's requirements, interest and
potential fit.
  • Qualify organisations before passing opportunities to the relevant senior stakeholder.
  • Schedule meetings with GTM Sales, GTM Marketing, Co-Founder, Sales
Enablement or other relevant team members.
  • Ensure the meeting handover includes sufficient background, stakeholder details and
context.
7. Follow-up & Relationship Nurturing
  • Follow up consistently with prospects across email, calls and LinkedIn.
  • Maintain relationships with interested prospects who may not have an immediate
requirement.
  • Develop long-term engagement with strategic accounts.
  • Ensure no potential opportunity is lost due to inadequate or delayed follow-up.
8. CRM & Pipeline Management
  • Maintain accurate records of all organisations, contacts, outreach and interactions in
the CRM.
  • Track the complete outbound funnel:
Target Account → Contact Identified → Outreach → Response → Meeting →
Opportunity → Partnership / Sale
  • Maintain clear next actions and follow-up dates.
  • Ensure 100% CRM hygiene and timely reporting.
9. Market Research & Intelligence
  • Research target organisations, market developments, competitor activity and
potential partnership opportunities.
  • Capture insights from conversations with prospects.
  • Identify new sectors, account types and channels for expanding outreach.
  • Share market feedback with Marketing, Sales and Product teams.
10. Continuous Improvement
  • Track outreach performance and analyse response and meeting-generation rates.
  • Identify what messaging, industries and stakeholder profiles generate better results.
  • Suggest improvements to targeting, outreach and follow-up processes.
  • Continuously build and refine the target account database.

Requirements

Candidate Profile
Experience
  • 2–5 years of experience in Inside Sales, B2B Business Development, Lead
Generation, Institutional Sales, Partnerships or Outbound Sales.
  • Experience in email-led prospecting and account-based outreach is strongly
preferred.
  • Experience engaging with Higher Education institutions, publishers, EdTech
companies or corporate organisations would be an advantage.
Preferred Industry Exposure
  • EdTech
  • Higher Education
  • Educational Publishing
  • Corporate Learning & Development
  • Education Services
  • LMS / Learning Technology
  • Professional Education
  • Content / Publishing Partnerships
Skills Required
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong business email writing skills.
  • Good research and prospect identification ability.
  • Comfortable initiating conversations with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong B2B sales and business development orientation.
  • Persistent and disciplined in follow-ups.
  • Strong CRM knowledge and data-management discipline.
  • Good understanding of email outreach and prospecting.
  • Comfortable working with activity and outcome-based targets.
  • Strong ownership and ability to work independently.
Preferred Market Exposure
Preference will be given to candidates with experience working with institutions in:
  • Mumbai
  • Delhi
  • Noida
  • Gurugram
  • Bengaluru
  • Hyderabad

raw.description:
About HubSync

HubSync is the AI-enabled workflow platform built for CPA firms by tax veterans. We replace the pile of point tools firms use to run an engagement—letters, data collection, organizers, document exchange, e-sign, e-file, payments, and analytics—with one unified system. Top 25 CPA firms already run on it. Backed by Thoma Bravo, we are rebuilding support around an agentic AI platform that answers routine questions instantly, backed by an in-house team that owns everything that needs a human.

About the Role

As an L1 Technical Support Agent reporting to the Support Manager, you are the first person our customers talk to. You will resolve what you can, triage what you can’t, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks. We are looking for someone with sharp troubleshooting instincts, clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working alongside AI tools to deliver exceptional customer experience during peak tax season and beyond.

What You Will Own

  • Pick Up Where AI Leaves Off: Own conversations handed off by the AI agent, resolving them on first contact whenever possible with friendly, clear, and accurate answers.

  • Work the Queue with Urgency: Respond within SLA in our ticketing platform, keep tickets moving, and follow up until customers confirm resolution.

  • Triage Like a Pro: Troubleshoot common issues across the Engagement Letter Wizard, e-Sign (8879, KBA), Tax Organizer, and Tax Return Delivery modules.

  • Clean Escalations: Escalate complex tickets to L2 with complete steps to reproduce, screenshots, and diagnostic details so L2 can act immediately.

  • Keep Jira Clean: Set tier, category, and priority correctly on every ticket to ensure operational reporting accurately reflects queue dynamics.

  • Make the AI Smarter: Flag wrong or missing AI answers and transform repeat questions into knowledge base articles.

  • Capture the Voice of the Customer: Log feature requests and recurring customer pain points through our intake process so Product receives direct signal.

  • Coverage When Needed Most: Share rotating on-call weekend and holiday shifts, and flex availability during busy season when timing is critical for CPA firms.

Your First 45 Days

  • Day 15: Complete product and Jira training, shadow L2 agents, handle AI handoffs with support, and learn SLAs and escalation standards.

  • Day 30: Work the queue independently, hit response-time SLAs, submit complete reproducible escalations, and publish your first knowledge base articles.

  • Day 45: Hit first-contact resolution and CSAT targets, become the L1 go-to specialist for a product area, and prepare for busy-season volume.

What We Are Looking For

  • Core Support Experience: 3–5 years in technical support, ideally within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Troubleshooting Instincts: Sharp diagnostic skills and the patience to isolate root causes.

  • Clear Communication: Warm, professional, and clear written and verbal communication skills with professional clients.

  • Ticketing & AI Tools: Experience with ticketing systems (e.g., Jira) and comfort working alongside and improving AI platforms.

  • Strong Ownership: Dedicated follow-through until customer issues are fully resolved.

  • US Location & Availability: Based in the United States, available during US business hours, and open to rotating weekend/holiday on-call shifts.

  • Bonus Points: Experience in tax, accounting, or CPA firms; exposure to e-signature or document management software; or prior busy-season customer support experience.

HubSync is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

A DXC Technology ajuda empresas globais em seus sistemas e operações de missão crítica modernizando TI, otimizando arquiteturas de dados e garantindo segurança e escalabilidade em nuvem pública, privada e híbrida. As maiores empresas e organizações de setor público confiam na DXC para implantar serviços para impulsionar novos níveis de desempenho, competitividade e experiência do cliente em suas propriedades de TI. Saiba mais sobre como entregamos excelência para nossos clientes e colegas em DXC.com.


Sobre a área:

Soluções de nuvem e infraestrutura resilientes e sólidas compõem a base de qualquer ambiente de TI, garantindo serviços simplificados, otimizados e gerenciados, uma empresa sempre conectada, uma estratégia escalável, máxima eficiência em ambientes multicloud e on-premises, e muito mais. Ajudamos você a modernizar seu ambiente de TI com serviços de nuvem e a entregar recursos tradicionais críticos, seguros e econômicos de hospedagem, rede e mainframe.


Funções essenciais do cargo:

Atuação na sustentação e operação de ambientes Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop e Citrix, incluindo monitoramento, atendimento de incidentes, troubleshooting e execução de procedimentos documentados.


  • Monitorar ambientes AVD e Citrix.
  • Atender incidentes relacionados a desktops, aplicações virtuais e sessões.
  • Investigar problemas de acesso, logon, lentidão, desconexão, aplicações e perfis.
  • Gerenciar sessões de usuários.
  • Apoiar a manutenção de Session Hosts e Citrix VDAs.
  • Executar procedimentos operacionais e mudanças controladas.
  • Coletar logs e evidências para análise ou escalonamento.
  • Apoiar instalações e atualizações de aplicações.
  • Atualizar procedimentos e documentação técnica.

Qualificações básicas:

  • Graduação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas afins
  • Experiência com Suporte e troubleshooting em Windows 10/11 e Windows Server.
  • Noções de Active Directory, GPO, DNS, redes e autenticação.
  • Experiência na utilização do Event Viewer e análise básica de logs.
  • Conhecimentos em investigação de problemas de sistema operacional, serviços e perfis de usuários.

Qualificações desejáveis em AVD e Citrix:

  • Noções de Azure Virtual Desktop e Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops.
  • Familiaridade com Host Pools, Session Hosts, Application Groups, Workspaces e RemoteApp.
  • Familiaridade com Citrix Workspace, Machine Catalogs, Delivery Groups, StoreFront e Citrix Director.
  • Gerenciamento de sessões, Drain Mode, Session Hosts e Citrix VDAs.
  • Troubleshooting básico de acesso, conectividade, performance, aplicações e sessões.
  • Noções de FSLogix Profile Container e arquivos VHD/VHDX.
  • Familiaridade com Azure Portal, Azure Monitor e Log Analytics.
  • Análise básica de CPU, memória, disco, rede e sessões.

Conhecimentos adicionais desejáveis

  • PowerShell básico para executar ou adaptar scripts existentes.
  • Uso de IA ou Copilot como apoio ao troubleshooting e à documentação.
  • Inglês ou Espanhol para leitura de documentação e interação técnica.
  • Certificações Microsoft, Azure ou Citrix serão consideradas diferenciais.

Job Title: Business Analyst

We, at Leggett & Platt Inc., are searching for a Business Analyst within our Home Furniture Sales and Field Support team to help support our Home Furniture business. Our Home Furniture business brings an intense focus on the customer, innovation, world-class manufacturing capabilities, and a global footprint together to create full package solutions for the industry. We do not make furniture. We make furniture more comfortable. We need the best people on our team to support our strategy, and your work will ensure people around the world have a little more comfort in their lives.

As a Business Analyst, you will have the opportunity to influence strategic business decisions, support innovation, and contribute to revenue and margin growth across a global organization. You'll work alongside talented professionals across multiple functions while gaining broad exposure to product development, commercial strategy, and financial planning.

So, what will you be doing as a Business Analyst?

  • Create, maintain, and improve business reporting, KPI dashboards, and recurring management reports using Excel, Power BI, and Zoho Analytics.
  • Analyze sales, operational, inventory, and financial data to support business decisions and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Reconcile data from multiple systems and sources, identify discrepancies, and establish trusted reporting metrics.
  • Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting for leadership teams.
  • Partner with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Product Management, and Sales teams to understand business performance and reporting needs.
  • Investigate variances, data anomalies, and unexpected business results to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support forecasting, budgeting, and financial planning activities through data analysis and reporting.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of meaningful KPIs that support operational and financial performance.
  • Work with manufacturing and operational data to improve reporting accuracy, consistency, and visibility across the organization.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process inefficiencies and opportunities for automation where practical.

To Be Successful in This Role, You'll Need
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business, Analytics, Economics or a related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in business analysis
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through incomplete, inconsistent, or conflicting data.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including Pivot Tables, lookups, formulas, and data analysis.
  • Experience creating reports, dashboards, and KPIs that support business decision-making.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Strong business curiosity and desire to understand how operational activities affect financial results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a manufacturing
  • Experience with Power BI, Zoho Analytics, Zoho Projects, or similar reporting platforms.
  • Experience reconciling and validating data from multiple systems.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems and operational reporting processes.
  • Exposure to inventory reporting, product costing, procurement, forecasting, or budgeting.
  • Experience identifying root causes of business performance issues and providing actionable recommendations.
  • Familiarity with Bills of Material (BOMs), inventory transactions, product costing, or manufacturing processes is a plus.

What Will Make Someone Successful in This Role?

The ideal candidate enjoys solving problems, digging into data, identifying inconsistencies, and translating information into meaningful business insights. Success in this role comes from being able to find the truth in imperfect operational and financial data, build trusted reporting, and help leaders make informed decisions.

What to Do Next

Now that you've had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.excerpt: About Alpine IQ Alpine IQ (AIQ) was founded in 2019 to help companies make sense of their customer data and turn it into real, measurable outcomes.
raw.description:
About Alpine IQ

Alpine IQ (AIQ) was founded in 2019 to help companies make sense of their customer data and turn it into real, measurable outcomes. What started as a focused data-unification platform has evolved into a full suite of tools used by brands, retailers, and digital businesses of every size, from fast-growing startups to global enterprises.

We’re a fully remote team of builders who love turning complex problems into simple, elegant solutions. Our products streamline operations, power smarter decision-making, and help businesses create personalized, connected experiences for their customers.

If you’re energized by fast-moving environments, creative challenges, and work that genuinely moves the needle, you’ll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

Retention drives a SaaS business, and we’re looking for an experienced renewals professional to own it. As our Renewal Specialist, you’ll manage the full renewal lifecycle across a book of AIQ customers, from early outreach and risk identification through negotiation and signature. You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Partnerships, Sales, and Finance, and you’ll have a real voice in shaping how AIQ approaches renewals as we scale.

This role is for a seasoned renewals professional who knows what a healthy renewal motion looks like and is ready to bring that expertise to a growing team.

What You’ll Do

  • Own renewals end to end for an assigned book of accounts, initiating outreach 90–120 days before term end, preparing quotes, and driving contracts to on-time signature.
  • Multithread every account, building relationships beyond your day-to-day contact and getting to the decision makers and economic buyers who sign.
  • Negotiate with confidence, including pricing adjustments, multi-year agreements, and renewal terms within approved guidelines, and knowing when to escalate.
  • Mitigate churn by spotting risk early through customer data, usage trends, and stakeholder signals, then building and executing save plans before renewals are in jeopardy.
  • Forecast accurately by keeping your HubSpot pipeline current weekly: stages, close dates, and risk notes.
  • Grow accounts by identifying upsell and expansion opportunities during the renewal window.
  • Resolve issues across teams, coordinating with Finance and Billing on invoicing, payment, and contract questions.
  • Turn data into insight by tracking renewal rate, net and gross revenue retention, and churn reasons, and sharing what you learn with CS leadership.
  • Build the playbook: help shape AIQ’s renewal process through templates, automation, and documentation, bringing best practices from your prior experience.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role is measured by how well you retain and grow AIQ’s revenue, and how reliably you execute. Key measures include:

  • Revenue retention: Gross and net revenue retention across your book
  • Renewal rate: The share of renewals closed on time, before term end
  • Expansion: Upsell and cross-sell revenue closed during the renewal window
  • Forecast accuracy: How closely your renewal forecast matches actual results
  • Execution: Timely outreach, accurate quotes and contracts, and a current HubSpot pipeline

These measures are defined in the role’s compensation plan and performance scorecard.

What You Bring

  • 3–5+ years of experience in a dedicated SaaS renewals role, such as Renewal Specialist or Renewals Manager, with direct ownership of a renewal book and retention targets.
  • Strong negotiation skills, with a track record of closing renewals, pricing increases, and multi-year agreements while protecting revenue.
  • Proven churn mitigation experience, including identifying at-risk accounts early and turning them around.
  • The ability to multithread across customer organizations and get to the decision makers who own the renewal.
  • Experience managing a high volume of accounts and contracts with strong accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience using a CRM to manage pipeline and forecast renewals.
  • Clear, confident communication, including the ability to explain pricing and contract terms in plain language.
  • Solid understanding of SaaS subscription models and retention metrics (GRR, NRR, churn).

Nice to Have

  • Renewals experience at a well-established, high-performing SaaS company with a mature renewal motion.
  • Experience with HubSpot.
  • Experience building or improving a renewal playbook or process from the ground up.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Why AIQ

  • Remote-first culture with a team spread across 15+ states
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) details
  • Flexible Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Home office stipend
  • Company-provided computer
  • Recognition program,

Work Environment

This is a fully remote role. You’ll need a quiet, professional workspace, a secure (non-public) and reliable high-speed internet connection, and the ability to be on camera for team and customer meetings.

Alpine IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact [email].

Overview

The DFES Consultant leads, conducts, and assists in data preservation and digital investigations in complex litigation cases by leveraging knowledge of digital forensic tools, technology and protocols related to the collection and management of electronically stored information (ESI) from a wide variety of data sources. The Consultant is part of our Digital Forensics and Expert Services team and performs investigative work and data collections as part of a team with Consilio’s external clients.

Responsibilities

· Works internally with colleagues and with clients in the planning and execution of data preservation using the most appropriate and legally defensible solutions

· Performs investigative analysis activities for a variety of digital devices, computers, storage media, servers, networks, and cloud-based services, including seizure and retention of mobile phones and handheld devices

· Performs data restoration and data conversion to prepare data for processing and hosting

· Leverages experience with forensic tools, including Encase, FTK, Axiom, and Cellebrite to carry out forensic investigations

· Displays sound knowledge and expertise of common operating systems and applications and exhibits an aptitude for problem solving in a methodical manner consistent with forensic protocols

· Follows Digital Forensic good practice methodologies (ISO17025 standard and ACPO Principles of Digital Evidence) in all aspects of the forensic and eDiscovery workflow

· Assists with and independently conducts the forensic examination of data and prepares expert reports and other expert witness documentation related to investigations

· Displays competence in oral delivery of complex technical information to non-technical clients

· Travels to onsite locations with a team or independently to perform data collections when safe and feasible

· Displays high degree of comfort operating in a client-facing environment and meeting the needs of clients

· Ability to be responsive to internal and external communications

· Has the ability to make well-reasoned decisions “on the spot” and execute on the plan

Qualifications

Minimum Education Requirements:

· Bachelor’s degree in forensic computing or equivalent relevant experience

Minimum Experience Requirements:

· 1 to 3 years of progressively responsible experience in related roles

Other Requirements:

· Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal

· Ability to thrive in a highly collaborative team environment

· Ability to work on multiple projects concurrently

raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks an Integration/Test Automation Engineer to build and maintain automated regression, API, integration, and load tests for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role creates repeatable automated test coverage, maintains representative test data, integrates test execution with CI/CD pipelines, and produces reproducible results and objective verification evidence.

The Integration/Test Automation Engineer works with software developers, API and integration engineers, functional testers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, CI/CD engineers, operations teams, and Government stakeholders. The position helps identify defects earlier, improves regression coverage, validates interfaces and data exchanges, and provides reliable quality feedback throughout the software-development lifecycle.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Integration/Test Automation Engineer will:

  • Design, develop, execute, maintain, and improve automated software tests.
  • Build automated regression suites covering critical application capabilities and mission workflows.
  • Develop API tests that validate requests, responses, schemas, authentication, authorization, error handling, and business rules.
  • Develop integration tests that validate interfaces, adapters, services, data exchanges, dependencies, and end-to-end processing.
  • Develop load and performance tests to evaluate throughput, response time, concurrency, resource utilization, stability, and failure behavior.
  • Translate requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, interface specifications, data mappings, and technical designs into automated test coverage.
  • Maintain traceability among automated tests, requirements, interfaces, defects, and release content.
  • Design and maintain representative test data for positive, negative, boundary, exception, and high-volume scenarios.
  • Develop repeatable processes for test-data creation, setup, masking, refresh, reset, reconciliation, and cleanup.
  • Protect sensitive data and use approved synthetic, masked, or controlled test data.
  • Integrate automated tests into approved continuous-integration and continuous-delivery pipelines.
  • Configure appropriate triggers, quality gates, result thresholds, notifications, and failure conditions.
  • Ensure automated tests provide timely and actionable feedback to development, testing, integration, and operations teams.
  • Maintain automated execution across development, integration, test, staging, and other approved environments.
  • Improve test reliability by identifying and correcting unstable, inconsistent, environment-dependent, or non-deterministic tests.
  • Produce complete and reproducible test results, logs, reports, metrics, and objective evidence.
  • Document test configurations, dependencies, data conditions, execution procedures, expected results, and known limitations.
  • Analyze failed tests and distinguish product defects from test-script, test-data, environment, configuration, or dependency issues.
  • Create clear defect reports with reproducible steps, expected and actual results, evidence, and affected requirements.
  • Support defect triage, root-cause analysis, correction verification, and regression testing.
  • Coordinate with API and integration engineers to validate service contracts, mappings, schemas, data transformations, and interoperability.
  • Coordinate with CI/CD engineers to improve automated execution, artifact retention, test reporting, and pipeline reliability.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to validate security corrections and integrate approved security testing where applicable.
  • Support Government demonstrations, user acceptance testing, release testing, and operational validation.
  • Provide automation coverage, execution status, defect trends, performance results, and quality risks for release-readiness decisions.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily coordination, reviews, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Maintain test source code, scripts, configurations, data, and documentation in approved version-control repositories.
  • Participate in peer reviews, code reviews, test reviews, and technical walkthroughs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks, test data, CI/CD integration, performance testing, and quality practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, systems engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • Minimum of ten years of relevant experience in enterprise architecture, systems architecture, systems engineering, solution architecture, software architecture, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience developing enterprise or system Concepts of Operations.
  • Experience conducting technical analyses and trade studies.
  • Experience decomposing mission or business needs into functional, component, interface, security, performance, and derived requirements.
  • Experience defining and documenting system and external-interface requirements.
  • Experience supporting complex systems integration across software, data, infrastructure, cloud, network, security, or external systems.
  • Experience designing scalable, extensible, resilient, and supportable enterprise solutions.
  • Experience developing technical assumptions and inputs for rough-order-of-magnitude estimates.
  • Experience developing current-state, target-state, and transition architectures.
  • Experience producing or reviewing architecture diagrams, System Design Documents, Interface Control Documents, Interface Design Documents, requirements-traceability records, and architecture decision records.
  • Experience communicating architecture decisions, options, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, facilitation, technical-writing, presentation, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • CISSP-ISSAP certification.
  • CISSP-ISSEP certification.
  • A certification formerly recognized for DoD 8570.01-M IASAE Level III and aligned to the applicable current DoD 8140 work role and proficiency level.
  • TOGAF certification.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Google Professional Cloud Architect.
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional certification.
  • International Council on Systems Engineering certification, such as Certified Systems Engineering Professional.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense enterprise architecture or systems-engineering programs.
  • Experience applying DoD Architecture Framework, Federal Enterprise Architecture Framework, or comparable architecture methods.
  • Experience with architecture-modeling languages or tools such as ArchiMate, SysML, UML, Cameo, Sparx Enterprise Architect, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with Zero Trust, identity architecture, cloud architecture, DevSecOps, data architecture, API management, or enterprise integration.
  • Experience supporting RMF authorization, DISA STIG compliance, COOP, disaster recovery, or mission-resilience planning.
  • Experience working with multiple Agile software-development teams.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation or higher certification.

Skills and Competencies

  • Enterprise and systems architecture.
  • CONOPS and operational-concept development.
  • Structured requirements analysis and decomposition.
  • Technical trade studies and alternative analysis.
  • Interface and integration architecture.
  • Scalability, extensibility, resilience, and capacity planning.
  • Technical estimation and ROM development.
  • Current-state, target-state, and transition-roadmap development.
  • Architecture governance and design reviews.
  • Security architecture and risk analysis.
  • Technical modeling, documentation, and visualization.
  • Government stakeholder facilitation and executive communication.
  • Strong judgment in balancing mission, security, interoperability, cost, schedule, and technical sustainability.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Technical Lead, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Job Title: Technical Solutions Architect
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Salary: $150K - $200K

Experience: 8+ years

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.

We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.

No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.

For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Technical Solutions Architect to design and govern enterprise-grade application architectures spanning cloud platforms, integration ecosystems, data domains, and large business application portfolios. This role partners closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering leaders to translate strategic objectives into pragmatic, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions that align with enterprise architecture standards.   • Lead architecture review boards, evaluating proposed designs against enterprise standards, security policies, and long-term roadmap considerations.
  • Design integration strategies across SaaS, on-premise, and hybrid landscapes, leveraging API gateways, event streaming, and managed integration platforms.
  • Establish architecture principles, technology selection guidelines, and reusable patterns for use across multiple delivery teams.
  • Collaborate with security architects to embed identity, data protection, and compliance controls into solution designs from the outset.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts including context diagrams, component models, sequence diagrams, and decision records.

  • Support proof-of-concept development to validate critical architectural choices before broader adoption.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams during solution delivery.
  • Track emerging technologies and recommend strategic investments that align with business priorities.
  • Drive standardization across application portfolios to reduce technical debt and operational complexity.
  • Engage with vendors and platform partners to evaluate roadmap fit and negotiate technical commitments.
  • Ensure that solutions meet regulatory, audit, and data governance requirements applicable to the business.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in software engineering or solution architecture roles.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting enterprise applications across at least two major cloud platforms.
  • Strong expertise in integration patterns, API design, and event-driven architectures.
  • Deep familiarity with at least one major enterprise platform such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or Workday.
  • Working knowledge of identity, security, and data governance frameworks at enterprise scale.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience producing formal architecture artifacts and presenting them to senior leadership.

  • Exposure to regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or life sciences.

raw.title: Cloud Solutions Architect || 12+ Yrs || Offshore
raw.excerpt: Role OverviewWe are looking for an experienced Cloud Solutions Architect with 12+ years of IT experience and strong expertise in the Banking and Financial Services domain.
raw.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Solutions Architect with 12+ years of IT experience and strong expertise in the Banking and Financial Services domain. The candidate will be responsible for designing, architecting, and governing secure, scalable, and resilient cloud solutions that support digital transformation initiatives, regulatory compliance, and business growth across banking platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and implement cloud architecture strategies aligned with enterprise and business objectives.
  • Design end-to-end cloud-native and hybrid-cloud solutions for banking applications and platforms.
  • Lead cloud migration and modernization initiatives, including core banking, digital banking, payments, lending, and customer engagement platforms.
  • Develop architecture blueprints covering application, integration, security, infrastructure, and data domains.
  • Establish cloud governance frameworks, security controls, and compliance standards.
  • Drive adoption of microservices, containerization, serverless technologies, and API-driven architectures.
  • Collaborate with enterprise architects, business stakeholders, security teams, and delivery teams to ensure successful solution implementation.
  • Conduct architecture reviews and ensure adherence to banking security and regulatory requirements.
  • Define disaster recovery, business continuity, scalability, and high-availability strategies.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud technologies and provide recommendations to improve efficiency, resilience, and customer experience.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development and engineering teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Cloud & Architecture Skills

  • Strong experience with cloud platforms:
    • Microsoft Azure
    • Amazon Web Services (AWS)
    • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Expertise in:
    • Cloud-Native Architecture
    • Hybrid & Multi-Cloud Solutions
    • Microservices Architecture
    • API Management
    • Event-Driven Architecture
    • Serverless Computing
    • Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift)
    • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM, CloudFormation)
    • CI/CD and DevSecOps Practices

Security & Compliance

  • Strong understanding of:
    • Cloud Security Best Practices
    • Identity & Access Management (IAM)
    • Zero Trust Architecture
    • Data Encryption & Key Management
    • Regulatory Compliance Frameworks
    • Risk Management & Governance

Banking Domain Expertise

  • Core Banking Systems
  • Retail & Corporate Banking
  • Digital Banking Platforms
  • Payments & Transaction Processing
  • Open Banking & API Banking
  • Lending & Mortgage Systems
  • KYC, AML & Fraud Management
  • Treasury & Wealth Management Solutions
  • Banking Regulatory Standards and Compliance

Required Experience

  • 12+ years of overall IT experience with at least 5+ years in Cloud Architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs within banking organizations.
  • Experience with cloud migration, modernization, and application re-platforming initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of banking operations, security requirements, and compliance standards.
  • Experience working with geographically distributed teams and large enterprise environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert Certification
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
  • Google Professional Cloud Architect
  • TOGAF Certification
  • Banking or Financial Services Certifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Technology Planning
  • Cloud Architecture & Governance
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Risk & Compliance Management
  • Leadership & Team Mentoring
  • Problem-Solving & Decision-Making
  • Business and Technology Alignment
  • Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills

Employment Type

  • Full-Time
  • Offshore Delivery Model

Ideal Candidate

A seasoned Cloud Solutions Architect with deep banking domain expertise and proven experience in cloud transformation, modernization, and secure architecture design. The individual should be capable of driving enterprise-scale cloud initiatives while ensuring compliance, resilience, security, and alignment with business objectives.

raw.title: QA Engineer - Game Development (Hard Rock Games)
raw.excerpt: What are we building? At Hard Rock Games, we’re not just making games—we’re crafting experiences that connect people, deliver thrills, and celebrate the spirit of Hard Rock.
raw.description:
What are we building?

At Hard Rock Games, we’re not just making games—we’re crafting experiences that connect people, deliver thrills, and celebrate the spirit of Hard Rock. As the social casino gaming arm of Hard Rock Digital, our teams shape every stage of the journey from concept to launch to live operations, giving our teams the ability to innovate, experiment, and make real impact.

With the backing of a globally recognized brand, we combine the agility of a startup with the reach of an entertainment powerhouse. Here, creativity thrives, ideas scale, and careers grow.

We’re looking for passionate creators, builders, and innovators to join us in shaping the future of free-to-play gaming. Let’s play hard.

About the role

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our Games team. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of delivering high-quality gaming products across web and mobile platforms in a fast-paced environment. As a QA Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting our game development pipeline, contributing to quality assurance and regulatory compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in all stages of the SDLC, ensuring the quality of gaming products.

  • Review and analyze product and technical requirements; identify untestable or ambiguous items before development starts.

  • Collaborate with QA and development teams to create comprehensive test strategies.

  • Write and maintain automated tests for web and mobile game clients.

  • Execute test cases and analyze results to identify issues across web and mobile platforms.

  • Verify game behavior against its specification, including paytables, RTP, and payout behavior against the math model.

  • Test against regulatory and certification requirements; help prepare evidence for regulatory submissions.

  • Report and manage bugs with clarity and actionable detail.

  • Work alongside AI-assisted tooling, specifying expected behavior precisely enough for automated verification.

  • Foster close collaboration with Product and Development teams to drive continuous improvement.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • Proven work experience in software development and quality assurance.

  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated tests in an existing framework.

  • Hands-on expertise testing web (HTML5, WebGL) and mobile (iOS, Android) platforms.

  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process.

  • Strong knowledge of QA best practices, tools, and methodologies.

  • Excellent communication skills; ability to write clear test plans and test cases for execution or automation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Familiarity with Jira, TestRail, or similar tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing real-money or social casino products against certification requirements (GLI or equivalent).

  • Experience verifying game math from a specification or math file.

  • Experience with AI-assisted QA tooling.

  • Experience with device-cloud testing platforms such as BrowserStack.

Education and Experience

  • 3–5 years in QA within an agile environment.

  • Prior experience testing games for web and mobile.

  • Proven experience with game development pipelines and release cycles.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional QA experience.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunities employer)

raw.title: Corporate Vice President, Advanced Planning Consultant
raw.excerpt: Location Designation: Fully Remote Advanced Planning ConsultantLocation of role that candidates may live in: Washington D.
raw.description:
Location Designation: Fully Remote

Advanced Planning Consultant

Location of role that candidates may live in: Washington D.C., Maryland, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi, Tennessee, orKentucky - Responsible for General Office coverage

Please Note: Travel frequently (typically ~50%, with potential for up to 100% based on business needs)

Business Unit Overview

New York Life’s Agency distribution system is the cornerstone of our business. Through this system, dedicated professionals build lifelong client relationships and help provide financial security to individuals and families. In this role, you will support and enable our agents by delivering expertise, training, and premium finance solutions that drive growth, production, and long-term success across the enterprise.

Role Overview

The Advanced Planning Consultant (APC) is responsible for achieving and exceeding $25K+ in premium sales nationwide by partnering closely with New York Life’s agents and advisors. This role drives large-case production through advanced sales strategies, estate planning, and premium finance solutions by delivering targeted agent engagement, hands-on client-facing support, and comprehensive training for agents and field leadership.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive life insurance case production by working directly with New York Life’s agents and targeted top producers
  • Own and exceed $25k+ premium case goals through proactive sales leadership, pipeline management, and strategic agent partnerships
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with top agents, GO Management, and General Office leadership
  • Provide advanced case development, product design, and technical support for individual and business planning needs involving premium finance
  • Run and support client seminars, client meetings, and high-impact sales presentations focused on premium finance strategies
  • Deliver agent training and GO Management training on premium finance concepts, case positioning, product solutions, and sales best practices
  • Introduce and educate agents and field management on new products, enhancements, underwriting considerations, and premium finance strategies
  • Deliver compelling presentations to agents, management teams, and clients in both virtual and in-person settings
  • Collaborate closely with General Office consultants and leadership to align premium finance strategies, production goals, and field execution
  • Support the field through individual agent consultations, group training sessions, and in-market engagement

What You’ll Bring

  • JD preferred but not required
  • Minimum of 5 years of life insurance wholesaling experience
  • Extensive advanced knowledge of life insurance, premium finance strategies, sales processes, and investment product dynamics
  • Proven ability to work independently while driving results in a fast-paced, goal-oriented sales environment
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills with senior agents and leadership
  • Industry designations such as CFP®, CLU®, or ChFC® highly desirable
  • Life insurance license and FINRA registrations: Series 6 or 7, Series 63, and Series 65 or 66
  • Willingness to travel frequently (typically ~50%, with potential for up to 100% based on business needs)

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: 140,000 - 200,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: No

Sales bonus eligible: Yes

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Please note: This role requires FINRA licensed and/or FINRA Associated Person pre-hire fingerprinting.

Company Overview

At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress.

As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it.

Our Benefits

We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work.Click hereto discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. We have a longstanding commitment to creating an environment where individuals can contribute their best and succeed together. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. By embracing a broad range of perspectives and experiences, we achieve greater success and fulfill our promise of providing financial security and peace of mind to families across all communities. Click here to learn more about New York Life’s leadership in this space.​

Recognized as one of Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies, New York Life is committed to improving local communities through a culture of employee giving and volunteerism, supported by the Foundation. We're proud that due to our mutuality, we operate in the best interests of our policy owners. To learn more about career opportunities at New York Life, please visit the Careers page of .

​Visit our LinkedIn to see how our employees and agents are leading the industry and impacting communities.

Visit our Newsroom to learn more about how our company is constantly evolving to meet our clients' and employees’ needs.
