raw.title: EverHealth -Strategic Customer Success Manager (Remote, US)
raw.excerpt: At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 745,000+ customers.
raw.description:
At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 745,000+ customers. As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries.


We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:


EverHealth, a business within EverCommerce, provides modern end-to-end solutions for healthcare providers. Our open, connected ecosystem of solutions and services helps providers engage patients, increase revenue, improve business efficiency, and remain market competitive. We serve 72,000 healthcare practices and counting. EverHealth consists of five SaaS products; DrChrono, iSalus, CollaborateMD, Updox, and MDTec, combined these products offer end to end solutions for the health care industry.


We are looking for a Strategic Customer Success Manager, that will manage our largest and most complex healthcare clients. You will be responsible for driving adoption, retention, and expansion across your portfolio while delivering value through deep partnerships and strategic guidance. This role will report to the Sr Manager of Customer Success.


Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of 10–20 enterprise healthcare accounts, serving as the primary strategic advisor for executive stakeholders and driving long-term customer success
  • Develop and execute customer success plans aligned with organizational goals to increase platform adoption, optimize workflows, and achieve measurable business outcomes
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with executive sponsors, clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders across complex healthcare organizations
  • Conduct regular Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to demonstrate ROI, track success metrics, and align on strategic priorities
  • Monitor account health, product adoption, support trends, and customer feedback to proactively identify risks and develop mitigation plans to improve retention
  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and collaborate with Sales to support cross-sell and upsell strategies that align with customer objectives
  • Serve as the voice of the customer by partnering with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to advocate for customer needs, feature enhancements, and roadmap priorities
  • Guide customers through product updates, new feature releases, and change management initiatives to maximize platform utilization and user adoption
  • Coordinate with Implementation, Support, Product, and Sales to ensure a seamless customer experience across the entire customer lifecycle
  • Own executive escalations by coordinating cross-functional teams, communicating resolution plans, and maintaining customer confidence during critical issues
  • Analyze customer data and success metrics to identify trends, demonstrate value realization, and recommend best practices for continuous improvement
  • Be an expert on EverHealth products maintaining a deep understanding of our solutions.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred  
  • 7+ years in Customer Success, ideally in SaaS or HR tech.
  • Proven success with renewals, cross-sell, and expansion strategies.
  • Experience building and executing customer success plans aligned to business goals.
  • Skilled in using and creating playbooks to drive scalable success motions.
  • Strong discovery and consultative skills — able to uncover customer needs and align solutions to long-term vision.
  • Comfortable navigating organizational change and helping others adapt to new ways of working.
  • Experience transitioning from reactive to proactive CS models

Ideal Additional Qualities

  • Executive presence and ability to engage with VP/C-suite stakeholders.
  • Data-driven mindset — uses customer health scores, usage data, and KPIs to inform strategy.
  • Background in behavioral health or healthcare is a strong plus.
  • Experience with customer advocacy and influencing product roadmap through feedback.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Product, and
  • Support.
  • Natural mentor or coach — able to elevate team thinking and share best practices.

Where:

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


Benefits and Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend.
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation:

The On Target Earnings (base + commission) for this position is $80,000 to $100,000 USD per year and a variable component included in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!


EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

Join ProMach and shine. Whether you're creative, strategic, persuasive, or mechanically inclined, there’s a place for you here. Be a problem-solver, a closer, a futurist - whatever drives you.


At ProMach, you'll be challenged and rewarded as you help improve packaging performance and shape the future of automation. And we’ll be proud to have you on the journey.


Do we have your attention? Keep reading.


Pro Mach's Brenton Engineering is seeking an experienced Regional Sales Manager to contribute to our success by proactively developing leads, building excellent customer relationships, and increasing company sales from customers to achieve sales goals within a territory. This position reports to the VP Sales and is a remote position in the Northeast territory.

Pro Mach's Brenton Engineering is seeking an experienced Regional Sales Manager to contribute to our success by proactively developing leads, building excellent customer relationships, and increasing company sales from customers to achieve sales goals within a territory. This position reports to the VP Sales and is a remote position in the Northeast territory.

ProMach's Brenton Engineering is seeking an experienced Regional Sales Manager to hit the ground running in an important territory with significant growth potential. The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) contributes to our success by developing, maintaining, and growing our customer relationships to achieve targeted sales goals. They are motivated, self-starters, with a strong desire to achieve personal and professional growth. The position will require extensive travel across a territory. This position reports to the VP of Sales and can be located in the Northeast territory.

Brenton, based in Alexandria, MN, is a leading manufacturer of case packers, palletizers, shrink-wrapping machines and complete End of Line packaging systems for the food & beverage and consumer packaged goods markets. Brenton is a division of Pro Mach, a leading provider of integrated packaging and processing solutions for over 20,000 customers worldwide. Through multiple brands, Pro Mach provides product packaging and processing equipment, PMMI-certified training, installation, parts, and service for primary and secondary packaging, flexible packaging, end-of-line packaging, and identification and tracking. For more information on Pro Mach’s brands visit www.ProMachBrands.com.

Are you passionate about this work?

  • Establishing and maintaining relationships with new and existing accounts at all functional levels of the organization, including engineering, operations, purchasing, and management.
  • Prior industry-related sales experience in packaging equipment, product sales, or applications is a plus.
  • Developing sales strategies, sales opportunities, and value-based solutions through application evaluations with End User Customers.
  • Consistently utilizing all available sales and marketing tools for presentations, sales calls, cold calling, and prospecting.
  • Creating an efficient territory schedule to ensure regular client visits and effective prospecting.
  • Working as a liaison between the customer and engineering to develop innovative project solutions with strong value propositions.
  • Ensuring accurate and timely collection of all project details necessary for applications engineering evaluation and quote projects.
  • Providing competitive, market, and customer intel to the Product Line Manager for timely feedback to on new product developments.
  • Partnering with project management to guarantee seamless order transitions between sales and operations.
  • Conducting yourself with the highest ideal in ethics and integrity.
  • Providing excellent customer service with a sense of urgency, purpose, and professionalism.
  • Consistently achieving or exceeding sales forecasts and quotas.
  • Documenting all Opportunities, Companies, Contacts, and customer Interactions in our Sales Force Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system

If this sounds like you, we want to connect!

  • Minimum 3-5 years of proven experience in a territory sales role requiring success in prospecting, qualifying, developing and securing new customer accounts.
  • Direct sales experience with leading domestic CPG companies
  • Four-year degree in Sales, Engineering or Business is highly desired.
  • Mechanical aptitude to understand packaging automation and company products.
  • Strong technical sales and polished presentation skills.
  • Motivated self-starter with proven closing skills
  • Effective and driven prospecting ability
  • Must possess top-level business management, interpersonal and facilitation skills.
  • Competent user of Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint
  • Knowledge of AutoCAD and experience with industrial line layout is preferred.
  • Competent user of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems
  • Strong listening & communication skills, both oral and written
  • Demonstrated ability to work remotely.
  • Up to 70% of travel required, must be located by a major airport.

What’s in it for you?


There's no monopoly on innovative ideas or limits to how far you can advance with our team. We offer an open, communicative environment that fosters individual initiative. We pride ourselves in being a company where people are happy and choose to build a career.


In addition to growth opportunities, as a ProMach employee, you receive more than just a paycheck. Total compensation includes your salary, comprehensive medical/dental programs, as well as life insurance, a generous paid time off program, and a retirement savings plan with a company match. And because we understand the importance of feeling protected, there is no waiting period for benefits – you are eligible on your first day of employment!


Please note that the pay ranges listed on external job boards, outside our posting details, do not accurately reflect our internal compensation ranges.



Pro Mach, Inc. was named to the Inc. 5,000 list of the fastest growing private companies in the U.S. seven times. We continue to introduce innovative products, enter new markets, expand our global presence, and actively acquire new capabilities.


We have the rewards, opportunities, and the market strength of a large organization combined with the entrepreneurial culture of a small, fast-paced company. You will enjoy the benefits of working with a growing company that competes globally, with the personal touch and feel of a smaller company where you can make an impact every day.



ProMach is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Pro Mach uses E-Verify to verify employment eligibility of all new hires to work in the United States. Pro Mach is a drug-free workplace.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Investing.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

At ALTOUR, we believe people are the driving force behind every meaningful connection - our clients’ and our own. With more than 1,000 team members and a presence in over 80 countries, we are a globally recognized leader in corporate travel management and a proud division of Internova Travel Group, the highest-ranking American corporate travel management company (Business Travel News).

Our mission is to manage the complexities of connecting people so they can represent their brands in the most impactful way possible. That same philosophy shapes our workplace culture, one that evolves, improves, and empowers our people to grow and thrive.

We embrace innovation and leading-edge technology to create smarter, faster, and more tailored solutions - not just for our clients, but for each other. At ALTOUR, you’ll be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your voice matters and your success is a shared journey. Click here for more information about Altour.

Responsibilities

JOB OVERVIEW

Transforming Data into Intelligence, Automation, and Business Growth.

The Data Solutions Developer is a strategic role responsible for transforming data into intelligence, automation, and measurable business value that drives growth, improves decision-making, and accelerates enterprise performance. Serving at the intersection of data, technology, analytics, and client solutions, this role advances ALTOUR's enterprise intelligence capabilities through automation, governance, visualization, and innovation.

Operating within the Enterprise Intelligence team, the Data Solutions Developer supports the evolution of ALTOUR iQ, BI Client Solutions, and enterprise data initiatives across Corporate Travel and Meetings & Incentives. The role focuses on strengthening data integrity, optimizing connected data ecosystems, developing KPI frameworks, and delivering actionable insights that improve performance, support client retention, and drive revenue growth.

The ideal candidate combines industry expertise, analytical curiosity, and technical capability with strong business acumen and client-facing communication skills. As a key driver of ALTOUR's intelligence strategy, this role transforms complex data into actionable business value, enabling smarter decisions, stronger client outcomes, sustainable growth, and long-term competitive advantage.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Commercial BI Solutions & Revenue Impact

  • Track solution adoption, commercial performance, budgets, revenue impact, and return on investment to support product and business decision-making.

Process Automation, MDM & Data Integrity

  • Analyze platform and operational processes to identify automation opportunities that reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and improve data integrity

Data Architecture, Concept Schemas & Governance

Data Analysis, Visualization & Insight Storytelling

We are seeking an energetic, highly persuasive, and articulate Virtual Sales & Lead Follow-Up Specialist to serve as the primary sales representative and appointment scheduler for our medical practice. In this key growth-driven position, your core mission is to convert patient leads and inquiries into booked appointments, taking the sales and scheduling burden entirely off the provider.

The ideal candidate possesses a proven background in sales and lead conversion, a goal-oriented mindset, and experience working under commission or percentage-based quotas. You will manage a pipeline of active inquiries (including follow-ups on promotional offers like "1 Month Free"), utilize modern AI productivity tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and DearDoc to draft compelling communications, and seamlessly manage schedules within Practice Fusion EHR.

Working Environment & Core Schedule

  • Role Title: Virtual Sales & Lead Follow-Up Specialist
  • Status: Full-Time (32–40 Hours / Week – 4-Day Work Week)
  • Schedule: Monday – Thursday, 8 Hours / Day (Subject to minor adjustment based on practice volume)
  • Core Systems:Practice Fusion EHR, AI Productivity Tools (Claude, ChatGPT), Patient Engagement Platform (DearDoc), VoIP Phone System
  • Primary Scope: Outbound Lead Conversion, Appointment Scheduling, Pipeline Management, and Quota Achievement

Top 3 Daily Tasks

  1. Outbound Lead Follow-Up & Conversion: Actively call, text, and email incoming patient leads and inquiries to pitch practice services, answer questions, and convert prospects into scheduled patients.
  2. Appointment Scheduling: Manage provider calendars within Practice Fusion EHR, ensuring seamless appointment booking and maximizing schedule utilization.
  3. Pipeline Tracking & Quota Execution: Track lead status, manage follow-up cadences for active promotional campaigns, and hit defined conversion goals and monthly booking percentages.

Core Responsibilities

  • Lead Nurturing & Outreach: Contact new leads and past inquiries rapidly across phone, SMS, and email; overcome patient hesitations and highlight promotional offers (such as "1 Month Free" trial campaigns).
  • AI-Assisted Patient Communication: Utilize AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) and patient platforms (DearDoc) to quickly draft customized, highly polished, and persuasive follow-up messages and email sequences.
  • Practice Fusion Scheduling: Navigate Practice Fusion EHR to verify calendar availability, register patient details, and book initial consultation appointments.
  • Target & Quota Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed performance metrics, including lead-to-appointment conversion percentages and target daily touchpoints.
  • CRM & Record Maintenance: Keep accurate notes on every lead interaction, update pipeline statuses, and ensure no lead drops through the cracks.

Requirements

  • Sales & Lead Conversion Experience: Proven track record in phone sales, appointment setting, lead nurturing, or phone-based customer acquisition.
  • Quota & Goal Orientation: Experience working toward performance quotas, booking targets, or percentage-based growth goals.
  • Elite English Communication: Flawless spoken and written English skills with a persuasive, confident, and professional phone presence.
  • Tech-Savvy & AI Literate: Hands-on experience or familiarity using generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) and patient engagement platforms like DearDoc to draft communications and streamline workflows.
  • EHR/EMR Experience: Working knowledge of medical EHR scheduling systems (Practice Fusion experience is a plus).
  • Schedule Availability: Full availability to work 4 days per week (Monday through Thursday, 8 hours per day).
  • Remote Workspace Setup: Dedicated, quiet home office with a high-performance computer (PC/Mac), high-speed internet, backup power/internet solutions, and a noise-canceling headset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Practice Fusion EHR.
  • Prior experience in healthcare sales, elective medical procedure sales, or concierge/membership medical practice growth.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a natural salesperson who loves chasing leads and closing appointment bookings. You leverage modern AI tools to work smarter and faster, pick up Practice Fusion quickly, and take pride in hitting your monthly conversion quotas while providing a warm, professional experience for prospective patients.

NewEdge seeks an ambitious, detail-oriented finance professional with strong modeling skills, curiosity, and emotional intelligence to support the company’s project finance, transaction, and corporate finance activity across its utility-scale and distributed power businesses. The Finance Associate / Analyst position requires a strong commitment to analytical rigor, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple transaction and reporting workstreams at once.

Your Core Responsibilities
  • Financial Modeling: Build and maintain project-level and portfolio financial models for battery storage and solar assets, including contracted and merchant revenue, capex and opex, tax credits (ITC, adders, and transferability), debt and tax equity sizing, and returns analysis.

Preferred Differentiators
  • Experience modeling battery storage revenue (capacity, energy arbitrage, ancillary services, tolling).

  • Prior experience in an entrepreneurial environment and/or working for a small-to-medium size project development company.
  • CFA progress, or experience with Python, SQL, or Power BI.

Life and Benefits at NewEdge
NewEdge believes that team members are its greatest asset and is committed to fostering an environment where employees can be the best version of their professional selves while helping grow the platform.
Benefits at NewEdge include:
  • Competitive base salary
  • Annual performance based bonus
  • Remote first environment
  • In-person team summits
  • 401(k) plan
  • Company equity program
  • Unlimited PTO and paid holidays
  • Health, Dental, and Vision insurance benefits
  • Life and disability insurance benefits

Compensation: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $90,000 – $145,000. Final base salary will be determined based on a range of factors, including skills, experience, qualifications, and location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual performance-based bonus, participation in the company equity program, and the benefits listed above.

If you do not see yourself fitting 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Urgent Hiring. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.

Own Your Catalog Like a Business, and Win on Amazon.

Hadley Designs is seeking an Amazon Brand Manager to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar group of our products on Amazon, as the product manager, the merchandiser, and the CEO of that catalog. This is a high-impact role for an e-commerce brand builder who brings real judgment, reads a market quickly, and knows how to grow net profit, not just sales.

You will report to the leader of our Amazon channel and work as part of a small, high-performing Amazon team. While this role operates deeply within Amazon, we welcome candidates who have built brands across e-commerce, DTC, or marketplace environments and are excited to bring that experience to a scaled Amazon catalog.

How You'll Win at Hadley Designs

You bring the judgment. We bring the brand, the catalog, and the team.

  • Learn our brand. Get to know our brand, our expectations, your catalog group, and the standards and SOPs our team runs on.
  • Run your catalog as its CEO. Make the calls on pricing, listings, imagery, promotions, and inventory, and own the net profit that results.
  • Challenge the status quo. Bring better ideas, back them with a clear point of view, and help us raise the bar.

We are looking for thinkers who are coachable and confident, not people waiting for a playbook.

What You'll Own

  • End-to-end ownership of your catalog group's performance, including revenue, net profit, pricing, advertising, and inventory
  • Reading the competitive landscape, from merchandising and listings to imagery and pricing, and responding with strategy rather than reacting to every price drop

  • Elevating our brand experience on Amazon so your catalog protects its margin and earns a higher price
  • Advertising, listings, experiments, and inventory planning with our supply chain team, used as levers toward profit
  • AI workflows that handle the routine work, so your time goes to the decisions that grow the catalog
  • Clear weekly reporting on results, risks, and next moves

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will:

  • Learn our brand, expectations, catalog group, and SOPs, and share a clear read of your competitive landscape
  • Own your catalog's weekly numbers and make the first judgment calls that protect margin and lift results
  • Bring forward product and format ideas, including ones inspired from outside Amazon, with at least one relaunch in motion
  • Challenge at least one way we do things with a better one, and be measured on the net profit you deliver

Requirements

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of experience owning a product line or catalog on Amazon, in e-commerce, or in marketplaces, end to end as a business
  • A strong visual eye, and you see what wins on the page, not only in the data
  • You read competitors and markets and can explain your reasoning, not just the answer
  • You find ideas outside Amazon and know how to turn a trend into a product or format
  • You know the tactics that grow net profit and you have protected margin and price
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and Amazon advertising
  • AI capability, a CRM and documented SOPs. You use AI every day to get more done with less, which is a must-have here and a capability rather than any one tool, and you are excited to build how we use all three now and going forward
  • Very organized and buttoned up, and you follow through until the job is done
  • Clear, confident spoken and written English
  • Coachable and quick to learn our way, and confident enough to challenge it

This is an ownership role for an experienced brand builder, not a virtual assistant position.

Benefits

Why You'll Thrive Here

  • Own a multi-million dollar Amazon catalog with a team that's got the tools and trust to help you scale
  • Join a high-growth crew that lives for innovation, data, and collective wins
  • Remote full-time work with a flexible schedule
  • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO
  • Personal development and autonomy over your time
  • An established company, 10+ years strong, ready to soar higher with you onboard

Our Hiring Process

Every candidate completes a Culture Index assessment and a case study before interviews.

Apply Now

If you're a brand builder who reads markets, sees what wins, and wants to run a catalog like your own business, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape the next phase of growth at Hadley Designs.

Job Title: Medical Virtual Assistant (Athena EMR & Concierge Primary Care)

Position type: Part-Time

Work hours: 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM Eastern Time (5 hours per day)

Work days: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday

Salary: $6 - $7 per hour

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines

Our client is a U.S.-based concierge primary care practice dedicated to delivering personalized, high-quality healthcare and exceptional patient experiences. We are seeking a highly experienced, tech-savvy, and dependable Medical Virtual Assistant (Athena EMR & Concierge Primary Care) to provide comprehensive administrative support, optimize clinical workflows, and enhance daily practice operations.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced healthcare professional who thrives in a patient-centered environment, enjoys working with technology, and can independently manage complex administrative responsibilities.

As a Medical Virtual Assistant, you will play an essential role in patient scheduling, call management, laboratory result workflows, insurance verification, prior authorizations, and electronic health record management.

You will work closely with the physician, nurse, and receptionist to streamline administrative processes, maintain accurate patient records, and ensure patients receive the responsive, personalized service expected in a concierge medical practice.

The ideal candidate has advanced hands-on proficiency in Athena EMR (AthenaHealth), experience supporting U.S.-based healthcare or concierge primary care practices, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

This is a strictly administrative support role focused on improving clinical and operational efficiency. You will not be responsible for making independent clinical decisions.

If you're an experienced Medical VA who enjoys solving problems, improving healthcare workflows, and making a meaningful impact on patient care, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

Patient Scheduling & Call Management (Top Priority)

  • Independently manage the physician's appointment schedule according to established scheduling preferences and practice-specific guidelines.
  • Ensure appointments are scheduled accurately, respecting the practice's limited daily patient volume and strict no-overbooking requirements.
  • Understand and follow concierge primary care scheduling workflows and patient service expectations.
  • Answer and manage inbound patient calls, including appointment requests, scheduling inquiries, and general administrative concerns.
  • Provide call overflow support during busy periods or when the in-office receptionist is unavailable.
  • Handle outbound calls, appointment confirmations, rescheduling requests, and patient callbacks.
  • Respond promptly to patient inquiries, maintaining the practice's expectation of callbacks within approximately 20 minutes.
  • Prioritize time-sensitive patient requests and coordinate appropriate follow-up.
  • Manage patient communications through designated phone, email, text, and internal messaging channels.
  • Maintain accurate scheduling records and document patient communications.
  • Coordinate with existing staff to prevent duplicate callbacks, scheduling conflicts, or unnecessary communication.
  • Escalate urgent concerns or matters requiring physician input according to established protocols.
  • Deliver professional, empathetic, and personalized service to patients with high expectations.

Laboratory Result Management & Athena EMR Workflows (Top Priority)

  • Manage and organize incoming laboratory results and outstanding result-related tasks within Athena EMR.
  • Review laboratory result queues and categorize tasks according to established physician-approved protocols.
  • Identify results requiring routine processing, physician review, or urgent escalation based on approved workflows.
  • Process and close normal laboratory result tasks using pre-approved templates and authorized procedures.
  • Send physician-approved templated communications to patients regarding normal laboratory results when authorized.
  • Flag abnormal, urgent, unclear, or potentially concerning results for physician review and appropriate follow-up.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of laboratory result communications, completed tasks, and pending actions.
  • Monitor outstanding result-related tasks to prevent unnecessary backlogs.
  • Help streamline laboratory result workflows and reduce administrative bottlenecks.
  • Support the physician's goal of completing clinical notes and documentation on the same day.
  • Follow HIPAA requirements and established protocols when handling sensitive clinical information.

EHR Documentation, Insurance & Prior Authorizations (Top Priority)

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and organized patient records within Athena EMR /AthenaHealth.
  • Create appropriate labels and categories for clinical documents.
  • Upload, organize, and file clinical documents into the correct patient charts.
  • Verify that insurance documents are uploaded correctly and stored in the appropriate sections of Athena.
  • Ensure insurance information is accurate, current, and properly reflected in the patient's electronic record.
  • Assist with insurance eligibility and benefits verification as needed.
  • Manage administrative aspects of prior authorization requests, including collecting required information, preparing submissions, tracking authorization status, and following up with insurance providers.
  • Identify missing or inconsistent insurance information and coordinate necessary corrections.
  • Support medical billing-related administrative workflows and insurance inquiries.
  • Review patient charts for missing, duplicated, incorrectly filed, or incomplete documentation.
  • Maintain organized electronic records and ensure outstanding documentation tasks are addressed.
  • Assist with reducing existing administrative backlogs and preventing new ones from accumulating.
  • Identify opportunities to replace manual or paper-based processes with more efficient digital workflows.

Patient Check-In & Chart Reconciliation

  • Assist with patient check-in and pre-appointment preparation workflows.
  • Review and verify patient demographic information and social history updates.
  • Ensure medication lists, allergies, and vaccination records are accurately documented in Athena.
  • Support medication and vaccination reconciliation by comparing available records, identifying discrepancies, and routing items requiring clinical review.
  • Verify that patient-provided information is accurately imported or reflected in the appropriate chart sections.
  • Identify incomplete, outdated, or inconsistent patient information and coordinate corrections with authorized clinical staff.
  • Maintain organized and accurate patient records to support efficient appointments and continuity of care.

External Communication & Administrative Support

  • Contact specialists, referring providers, and other medical offices on behalf of the physician when authorized.
  • Coordinate administrative inquiries, documentation requests, referrals, and follow-up communications.
  • Track outstanding requests and document communication outcomes.
  • Provide additional back-end administrative support as needed.
  • Assist with organizing high-volume administrative tasks and outstanding EHR work queues.
  • Identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend practical improvements.
  • Help modernize administrative processes through improved digital documentation, task organization, and workflow standardization.
  • Maintain accurate records and communicate relevant updates to the appropriate team members.
  • Work independently while following established procedures and physician-specific preferences.

Team Collaboration & Workflow Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with the existing nurse, receptionist, and physician to support smooth daily operations.
  • Complement the in-office team's responsibilities by providing additional administrative and technical support.
  • Coordinate patient communications and scheduling activities to prevent duplicate work or unnecessary follow-ups.
  • Follow clear communication and escalation protocols to minimize interruptions to clinical operations.
  • Independently resolve routine administrative concerns within the scope of established procedures.
  • Escalate urgent, unclear, or clinically sensitive matters to the appropriate team member.
  • Provide concise, organized updates rather than requiring frequent supervision or check-ins.
  • Respect established team workflows while proactively identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Maintain a collaborative, respectful, and solutions-oriented approach when supporting existing staff.

Top 3 Priorities

1. Precise Scheduling Management & Responsive Patient Communication

Take ownership of the physician's schedule by following specific appointment preferences, respecting limited patient volume, and preventing overbooking. Manage incoming calls, call overflow, and patient callbacks while maintaining the prompt, personalized service expected in concierge primary care.

We're Google Cloud, AWS, and Cloudflare partners, and we're 100% remote by design.

About the role

We're hiring a Mid/Senior ML Engineer to contribute to technical direction across client engagements and mentor a growing team of junior ML engineers. You'll work directly with clients, taking AI systems from prototype to production-grade deployment.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and deploy production ML and LLM-based systems (RAG, agentic workflows, fine-tuning, embeddings) for enterprise clients
  • Own technical delivery end-to-end: from architecture and prototyping to deployment, monitoring, and iteration
  • Work directly with client engineering and product teams to translate business needs into scoped, shippable technical solutions

  • Represent TensorOps technically in client conversations, workshops, and (optionally) at industry conferences

You’ll be part of a supportive, fast-growing team that values autonomy, open communication, and continuous learning.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional experience in Machine Learning, AI Engineering, or a related role (Mid-level) / 5+ years for Senior
  • Strong hands-on skills in Python, writing clean, efficient, well-documented, production-quality code
  • Proven experience designing, training, optimizing, and deploying ML models independently (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn)
  • Experience building GenAI & LLM systems: RAG pipelines, chatbot architectures, and applications using tools like LangChain
  • Familiarity with MLOps & production ML practices: model versioning, monitoring, CI/CD for ML workflows
  • Experience deploying and scaling ML systems on AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Strong performance optimization and debugging skills (diagnosing complex issues and improving system reliability and efficiency)
  • Experience working with stakeholders or clients is a plus

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: no mandatory office days, work from wherever
  • Funded certifications: fully paid AWS and GCP professional certifications
  • Dynamic, High-Impact Projects: Work on cutting-edge ML and GenAI solutions across diverse industries
  • International Clients: Collaborate with global organizations and solve real-world challenges at scale
  • Urban Sports Club Membership: Supporting your physical and mental wellbeing

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for product engineers to own product areas within Doit's AI Investing.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Australia.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

At FronteraCare, we’re not just providing ABA therapy, we’re transforming how behavioral health is delivered. Born from firsthand experience with the delays and inefficiencies in today’s diagnostic and therapeutic systems, Frontera was created to bridge the gap between families and the care they need. We do this by combining compassionate, culturally informed clinical care with innovative technology that supports—rather than replaces—clinicians, making care more precise, accessible, and sustainable.

We’re seeking a mission-driven, technology-forward Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) to join our telehealth team in New Mexico. This is more than a clinical role, it’s a leadership opportunity. As a BCBA at Frontera, you’ll be at the forefront of an innovative care model that leverages digital phenotyping, intelligent assessment tools, and asynchronous supervision technology to expand access and improve outcomes. You’ll lead and mentor RBTs with intention, ensuring high-quality implementation and meaningful professional development.

If you believe in the power of technology to transform care—without compromising clinical integrity, and if you're passionate about guiding and growing the next generation of behavior technicians, we want to hear from you.

The BCBA will operate within Local, State and Federal Regulations as well as adhere to all Frontera policies and procedures. Essential duties include but are not limited to:

  • Conducting behavior or functional Analytic Assessment Process

  • Developing the case supervision and clinical management

  • Developing and implementing an ABA Treatment Plan

  • Consulting with a Registered Behavior Technicians (RBT) or Behavior Technicians (BT) regarding client/family concerns

  • Selecting appropriate stimulus materials and treatment modalities for age and ability of person served

  • Including the client/family in setting treatment goals and training families on specific treatment strategies and carryover skills for the client/family

  • Giving clear concise instructions in presenting materials and/or techniques in therapy

  • Recording and tracking daily progress for client/family accurately

  • Utilizing time in session efficiently to meet objectives

  • Providing accurate and immediate feedback to the client and/or family

  • Planning for discharge of the person served

General Requirements:

  • General knowledge and experience in the field of Applied Behavior Analysis

  • Services and/or knowledge of Autism Spectrum Disorder

  • Managerial experience

  • Proficient computer skills in Excel, database management and record keeping.

  • Effective oral and written communication.

  • Excellent interpersonal and coaching skills.

  • Evidence of the practice of a high level of confidentiality.

  • Excellent organizational skills.

  • Completing stage two assessments

  • Completing other duties as assigned

Education and Experience:

  • Master's Degree in Psychology or related field, emphasis in Applied Behavior Analysis.

  • Two or more years of experience working with a pediatric population.

  • Two or more years of experience in an applied setting participating in functional assessments/analyses, the development and implementation of functional behavior plans as well as the ongoing oversight and monitoring of the implementation and adjustments to such programs.

  • Memberships to specific state and national (ABAI) professional associations are highly recommended.

  • 1+ year of Telehealth supervision experience

  • Located in AZ, CO, FL, GA, ID, NC, NM, NV, OK, TX, or UT

Why Frontera Health?

With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Sales Development Representative with a hunter mindset who can break through the noise, open doors at major brands, and fill our pipeline with qualified opportunities.

Why This Role Matters

Tenacity, persuasion, and velocity are your playground. As an SDR, you are the tip of the spear for our revenue team. You are the first human interaction a potential client has with High Scale, and you set the tone for the entire relationship.

You aren't just "dialing for dollars"; you are identifying problems and offering solutions to CMOs and VPs of Marketing. Your ability to articulate value, handle objections, and book qualified meetings directly fuels our growth engine. If you are competitive, resilient, and looking to fast-track your career in high-ticket sales, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Execute High-Volume Outbound

    • Relentlessly hunt for new business via cold calling, personalized email sequences, and social selling (LinkedIn/Twitter).

    • execute 50+ touchpoints daily to engage decision-makers at DTC brands, engaging them on their pain points (creative fatigue, scaling ad spend).

  2. Qualify & Book Meetings

  3. Strategic Account Mapping

Who You Are

  2. Resilient & Competitive

  4. Coachability

    • You crave feedback. You record your calls and listen back to them to see where you can improve.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Clear path to becoming an Account Executive (AE) or Sales Manager.

Payroll Accountant – Remote

Payroll | Accounting | U.S. Payroll Compliance | Financial Operations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible, aligned with U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Payroll Accountant to manage end-to-end payroll operations while ensuring employees are paid accurately, on time, and in compliance with U.S. payroll regulations.

This is a highly detail-oriented role that combines payroll processing, accounting, tax compliance, reconciliations, and financial reporting. You’ll be responsible for maintaining accurate payroll records, integrating payroll with accounting systems, resolving discrepancies, and supporting audits while ensuring compliance across all payroll processes.

The ideal candidate has strong payroll expertise, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to manage confidential information with accuracy and professionalism.

What You’ll Own

Payroll Processing

  • Process bi-weekly, semi-monthly, and monthly payrolls for organizations ranging from 50–500 employees.
  • Validate employee time entries, overtime, bonuses, commissions, and deductions prior to payroll processing.
  • Administer payroll using platforms such as ADP, Paychex, Gusto, QuickBooks Payroll, BambooHR, or similar systems.
  • Ensure payroll is processed accurately and delivered on schedule.

Accounting & Reconciliations

  • Record payroll journal entries within accounting systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero.
  • Reconcile payroll clearing accounts and payroll-related bank transactions.
  • Record employer contributions, benefit deductions, and payroll liabilities accurately.
  • Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies promptly.

Payroll Tax & Compliance

  • Prepare and submit federal, state, and local payroll tax payments.
  • File payroll tax forms including 941, W-2, 1099, and applicable state filings.
  • Monitor changes in payroll tax laws and labor regulations.
  • Ensure payroll processes remain compliant and audit-ready.

Benefits Administration

  • Reconcile healthcare, retirement, and employee benefit contributions.
  • Verify employee deductions align with benefit elections.
  • Coordinate with benefit providers regarding payroll-related discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate payroll deduction records.

Employee Payroll Support

  • Respond to employee payroll inquiries regarding paychecks, direct deposits, tax withholding, and payroll documentation.
  • Support payroll setup for new hires and employee updates.
  • Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling employee information.

Reporting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare recurring payroll, headcount, and labor cost reports.
  • Support audits with organized payroll documentation.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

Technical Skills

  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, reconciliations).

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience reconciling payroll with accounting systems.
  • Familiarity with HRIS integrations including BambooHR, Zenefits, or Workday.

Tools & Platforms

  • ADP
  • Paychex
  • Gusto
  • QuickBooks Payroll
  • BambooHR
  • QuickBooks
  • NetSuite
  • Xero
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Google Sheets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly detail-oriented with exceptional numerical accuracy.
  • Strong understanding of payroll compliance and accounting processes.
  • Able to troubleshoot discrepancies under tight deadlines.
  • Professional and discreet when handling confidential information.
  • Organized with strong documentation habits.
  • Proactive in identifying process improvements and ensuring compliance.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review employee timecards and payroll changes.
  • Process payroll and verify payroll accuracy.
  • Reconcile payroll accounts and journal entries.
  • Respond to employee payroll inquiries.
  • File payroll tax payments and maintain compliance.
  • Reconcile employee benefit deductions.
  • Prepare payroll reports and financial summaries.
  • Update payroll documentation and SOPs.

In short: You ensure payroll is processed accurately, accounting records remain balanced, employees are paid on time, and payroll operations stay compliant with all applicable regulations.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • 100% on-time payroll processing
  • Payroll error rate below 1%
  • Timely payroll tax filings
  • Payroll discrepancies resolved within two business days
  • Accuracy of payroll reconciliations and journal entries
  • Audit readiness and compliance standards maintained

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote opportunity supporting U.S.-based organizations.
  • High-impact role within finance and accounting operations.
  • Exposure to payroll, tax compliance, HR, and financial reporting.
  • Opportunity to improve payroll systems and operational efficiency.
  • Career growth into Senior Payroll Accountant, Payroll Manager, or Accounting leadership roles.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Practical Assessment (Payroll Reconciliation & Discrepancy Resolution)
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Payroll Accountant who enjoys ensuring accuracy, maintaining compliance, and supporting efficient payroll operations, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key contributor to a growing finance team.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Marketing Strategy & Operations team is responsible for driving organizational effectiveness and leading transformational programs across Marketing, Self-serve, Startup and Sales Development. We create the processes and conditions that enable high performance across teams and help Stripe scale with focus and discipline.

We partner closely with the CMO, Marketing and Sales Development leadership team to define strategy, lead operational planning, and steward execution across global programs.

Our work spans cross-functional efforts that are critical to Stripe’s growth. From delivering strategic insights and frameworks to leading complex initiatives, we focus on what moves the needle most for the business. raw.excerpt: About DarkroomDarkroom (Darkroom Digital, Inc. ) is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow.
raw.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom (Darkroom Digital, Inc.) is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is hiring an FP&A Analyst to join the Finance team. You'll own financial modeling, performance reporting, compensation reporting, and utilization and capacity analysis, the numbers behind how and when we hire. You'll report to the SVP of Finance and work closely with the Finance Operations Manager, the AR & Billing Specialist, and our department Managing Directors, turning complex operating and financial data into clear recommendations that drive forecasting, planning, and decision-making across the company.

You'll own your work end to end, from weekly pacing to the monthly and quarterly reports that go to the CEO. Teammates peer-check each other's work, and the SVP of Finance approves what goes to the CEO.

This role is built for someone who sees AI as a core part of how finance gets done. You'll use tools like Claude to sharpen analysis, automate repetitive work, and build workflows that raise both the speed and quality of our financial output.

This is a fully remote role from Brazil or Portugal supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).

What You'll Do

  • Build, maintain, and enhance our unified financial model, including the P&L, budgets, forecasts, headcount plan, scenario analyses, and unit economics.

  • Prepare the weekly pacing report, tracking MRR, bookings, and revenue against target.

  • Prepare the revenue, EBITDA, year-to-date, MRR, and outlook sections of the monthly report, and the quarterly performance report.

  • Explain the numbers: break every variance against budget into its drivers, and recommend changes to model assumptions when actuals move away from them.

  • Own the utilization model by department, role, and person, including Shadow FTEs (the capacity our AI platform adds), and connect it directly to gross margin and unit economics.

  • Work with Managing Directors on every hiring request, building the case for hiring now or waiting based on utilization, pipeline, and margin impact.

  • Build and maintain the department-head compensation dashboard, and prepare the quarterly KPI figures behind our incentive plans.

  • Run cohort analysis: retention, expansion, and lifetime value by client cohort.

  • Analyze our media mix and profitability by client and service line, and recommend pricing, scope, and staffing changes.

  • Peer-check teammates' work, including budget vs. actual, model changes, payout calculations, and vendor payments against budget.

  • Use AI tools like Claude to enhance analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and build more efficient workflows.

  • Identify and implement improvements to the accuracy, consistency, and efficiency of financial processes and reporting.

  • Take on ad hoc analysis and special projects as the business needs them.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • You have 2–4 years of professional experience in FP&A, private equity, investment banking, transaction services, or consulting.

  • You've built and maintained complex financial models, not just updated them.

  • You're advanced in Google Sheets or Excel, including lookups, pivot tables, dynamic formulas, and scenario analysis. Our model runs in Google Sheets.

  • You understand unit economics in a services business (capacity, utilization, billable rates, and margin), or you can learn them fast.

  • You write clear management reporting: you can explain what changed, why, and what to do about it in a few sentences.

  • You already use Claude or similar AI tools in your work and can point to real examples of AI-driven analysis, automation, or workflow improvements.

  • You form a view and defend it with data. You bring recommendations, not just numbers.

  • You're analytical, organized, and a strong problem-solver with a high bar for accuracy and detail.

  • You work independently, juggle multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • You're fluent in written and spoken English.

  • Experience in an agency or professional services firm is a plus.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership, but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape, just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + local holidays (relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace. We are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

What You'll Own

  • Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

What We're Looking For

  • Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
