raw.description:
Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient medical nutrition therapy using an integrative and functional nutrition approach. This is a fully remote, full-time role offering a consistent schedule and the opportunity to build deep, ongoing relationships with patients.

Unlike many outpatient roles, this position offers a full-time, salaried structure with benefits, providing stability and consistency in your schedule and income—while giving you the flexibility to choose a schedule that fits your lifestyle.

The ideal candidate has experience in clinical or outpatient nutrition counseling, is licensed (or eligible for licensure) in Pennsylvania, and is passionate about delivering personalized, root-cause care to support long-term health outcomes.

Our Mission: Radically improve the health of Humankind—one person, one appointment, one connection at a time.

At Simplex Health, we do things differently. Our insurance-funded medical nutrition therapy goes beyond symptom management to improve — and in many cases reverse — chronic conditions. We partner with hospitals, healthcare practices, and individuals to provide personalized, root-cause nutrition care across a wide range of conditions, including metabolic health, digestive disorders, hormonal imbalances, and chronic disease.

Our approach is grounded in prevention, root-cause resolution, and sustainable lifestyle change, supporting patients throughout their health journey. Through a fully virtual, telehealth model, we meet patients where they are, delivering accessible, high-quality care.

Our evidence-based, progressive nutrition interventions are tailored to each patient’s unique biochemistry. Through nutrition counseling, education, and health coaching, we empower patients to improve their health, build lasting habits, and achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes.

Role details:

  • Location: Telehealth
  • Schedule Options: Choose between a 4-day (32-hour) or 5-day (40-hour) work week, with flexibility to design a schedule that fits both your preferences and your patients’ needs.
  • Reports to: Clinical Manager
  • Compensation:
    • 32 hours/week (4-day work week): $44,000–$59,000 annually
    • 40 hours/week (5-day work week): $55,000–$70,000 annually
    • Final schedule and compensation are aligned based on candidate preference, experience, and availability

You love helping people heal. You just don’t love doing it all alone.

If you’ve ever run (or dreamed of running) your own private practice, you know what it takes — the marketing, the scheduling, the billing, the insurance headaches, the empty calendar days, the tech issues, the isolation…

At Simplex Health, you get the best parts of private practice — the autonomy, the flexibility, the deep 1:1 relationships with patients — without the burnout or business stress.

Here, you get to focus on what you do best: helping patients transform their health through integrative and functional nutrition.

What we are looking for:
We are seeking mission-driven dietitians (RD/RDN) who:

  • Are passionate about integrative and functional nutrition
  • Thrive in a collaborative, growth-minded environment
  • Have at least 2 years of experience in outpatient or clinical care
  • Hold current registration with CDR
  • Are credentialed or open to being credentialed with insurance companies
  • Want to spend more time with patients and less time running a business
  • To avoid conflicts of interest, candidates should not maintain an active private practice or independent nutrition counseling business

Preferred:

  • Availability for evening appointments strongly preferred to meet patient demand, with flexibility based on individual scheduling needs.
  • CDCES (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist) strongly preferred
  • IFNA Certified (IFNCP credential a plus); candidates actively enrolled in IFNA training welcome

PA license and completion of major insurance credentialing required before start; this process may take 3–6 months.

Role Responsibilities (including but not limited to):

  • Provide telehealth medical nutrition therapy using a functional and integrative approach
  • Implement Simplex Health protocols, tools, and educational materials in patient care
  • Assess the nutritional health of patients/clients and develop personalized, root-cause care plans
  • Create and modify individualized nutrition interventions based on patient needs and goals
  • Document all new and follow-up appointments in the Healthie platform with strong attention to detail
  • Respond to patient communications in a timely, professional, and supportive manner
  • Collaborate with team members through case discussions, meetings, and shared learning opportunities
  • Communicate openly and effectively to resolve work-related issues and support team outcomes
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and ongoing clinical initiatives
  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and clinical standards
  • Stay current with emerging research and best practices in nutrition and health
  • Manage a full and consistent patient caseload, ensuring timely follow-ups, continuity of care, and optimal patient outcomes

What to expect:

At Simplex Health, you’ll have access to:

  • Structured onboarding and training
  • Regular case reviews and clinical collaboration
  • Real-time support via team chat and peer connection
  • Team meetings and shared learning opportunities
  • Opportunities to contribute to committees, resources, and clinical initiatives
  • Credentialing: If you’re not yet in-network, our team fully manages the insurance credentialing process on your behalf, including covering all associated fees and handling the paperwork.
  • Ramp-Up To Full-Time: This role begins in a ramp-up phase with variable hours as your patient caseload grows, transitioning into a full-time, salaried schedule once full-time metrics are met. Our team provides consistent referrals and support to help you build a full and sustainable schedule as quickly as possible.

Benefits

  • Flexible Scheduling: Choose between 32 or 40 hours per week, with the ability to structure your schedule in a way that works best for you and your patients
  • 4-Day Work Week (32 hours): A condensed schedule option designed to support balance, energy, and sustainability
  • Supplement Commissions: Earn 12.5% of MSRP on supplements purchased through Fullscript, providing additional earning potential.
  • Performance-Based Bonus Opportunities: Earn additional income based on patient retention and face-to-face care time.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k) (after 90 days)
  • Discretionary Holiday Break: Office closed between Christmas and New Year’s
  • Fitness Allowance: Partial reimbursement for gym memberships, fitness classes, or wellness activities
  • Simplex Wellness on Demand: Free access to virtual fitness programs

Time Zone & Schedule:

Our operations and patient base are primarily in Eastern Standard Time (EST). Candidates in Pacific or Mountain time zones have the unique advantage of working standard daytime hours in their local time zone while providing essential evening coverage for our East Coast patients. Please note that administrative support is available from 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM EST, and while live attendance at team meetings is encouraged, recordings will be provided for those unable to join due to time zone differences.

Key Intangible Characteristics of the Ideal Candidate:

Called: A passion for our mission and a sense that this role and company are a strong fit for the blessings of your gifts, talents, passions, and experiences.. Must be mission-motivated with a resolve to overcome obstacles, anchored in a sense of purpose in this work.

Servant Leadership: Nobody is above any task, and we are all here to serve others. Every customer—internal or external—needs help, and the most powerful way to lead will be to serve.

Learning and Adaptive: As a startup with a big mission, new systems, technology, and situational adaptability are expected. This person must have an appetite for learning and skill improvement.

Grit, Resourcefulness & Entrepreneurial Spirit: Not everything will have a pre-planned solution. This person will have to be resourceful in figuring things out, resist feeling overwhelmed, and be willing to roll up their sleeves to make things happen. This person will have to have an open mind and good resolve, whether it’s looping in other people, finding answers online, or seeking best practices.

Organizational Skills: Being or becoming a constant organizational force. It will require a capacity for being open to change, discerning better processes, and prioritizing for improved outcomes.

Chemistry Fit: We have a unique and fun culture—we laugh, press in, work hard, and jump in to figure things out. Fitting into the team chemistry is essential.

High Character: We operate with a high trust culture. Personal values must fuel our work. Integrity, honesty, compassion, reconciliation, and diligence are all things this person must possess to flourish.

Energy & Enthusiasm: This person must bring joy and passion for work to the job. Encouraging and spurring on others on the mission while being self-motivated and positive is essential.

Multitasking: This is not a steady-state or static environment. Workflow will cycle, and interruptions are normal, so this person must be able to juggle and adjust on the fly.

Project Management: While multitasking, this person must be able to keep an eye on deadlines and critical dependencies, working to preserve them or source support proactively.

🌟 Why Dietitians Choose Simplex Health

Because great clinicians deserve great support.

🧾 We Handle Credentialing & Licensing
We cover insurance credentialing costs and reimburse for out-of-state license fees.

🎓 CEU Reimbursement
We invest in your professional growth and continued learning.

💻 Technology Reimbursement
Support for the tools you need to work efficiently and effectively.

💲 Recruitment Thank You Bonus
Bonus for any referrals hired by Simplex Health who stay at least 90 days

📋 Consistent Referrals & Quality Resources
A steady patient flow and high-quality patient-facing materials to support your care.

👥 Helpful Support Team & Quick Response Times
From scheduling to tech help, our support staff makes your day run smoother.

🌿 Approachable Leadership & Collaborative Culture
Leaders who listen, and a clinical community that truly supports one another.

🤝 Opportunities Beyond Patient Care
Get involved with social media, engagement projects, or hosting lunch & learns.

🌎 Broad Range of Clients, Deep Skill Development
Grow your counseling skills and confidence across a variety of cases.

💞 Strong Sense of Community
Even in a virtual environment, you’ll feel connected, encouraged, and supported.

If you’ve ever wished you could combine the freedom of private practice with the camaraderie and stability of a larger organization, this is where you belong.

Apply today and rediscover the joy of patient care without the grind of running a business.

Simplex Health Core Values:

Simplex Health strives to embody the following values and to apply them to every aspect of how we run our business, including how we interact with each other as teammates and leaders. These values also apply to how we interact with and continue to inspire our clients and strategic partners:

We Inspire Each Other
You are an important part of our team and together we make a collective intention to uplift and commit to one another. Through cultivating genuine, transparent, relationships, we create an environment that encourages individuals to dream big, take risks, and be bold. We aim to inspire and commit to everyone we touch. This sense of commitment and care sets the stage for a culture of accountability, where we hold ourselves and each other to the same high standards, taking the ownership necessary for achieving our goals.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
1 Thessalonians 5:11

We Always Learn and Grow
We at Simplex Health strive to be continual learners and to expand our abilities as people and as an organization. We educate ourselves, remain curious, and use evidence-based research to challenge our current understanding. We see mistakes and failure as great teachers and learning opportunities. When we stay engaged in the world with a growth mindset, it creates the right environment for us to thrive and make a meaningful impact on each other and on the world.
Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance.
Proverbs 1:5

We Think Big Picture What we do day in, day out, how we do it, and the decisions we make- shape who we are as a people and as a company. The details are super important, AND should always be guided by our wide perspective and an understanding of how we are impacting each other, our clients, and our business. Before making any major decision, ask yourself:

• Does it help us grow? How?

• Does it answer “how are we different and why should you care?”
• Is what I’m working on duplicatable and transferable (ie can I duplicate it and apply to other situations)? How?
• Does it challenge the status quo?
• Does it inspire?
• Does it tightly align with and advance our mission? How?
• Can it be more humanized and relatable?
• Does it unite us? How?
• Does it solve a problem? How?
Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.
I Corinthians 13:12

We Challenge the Status Quo:
We are inquisitive by nature. We are courageous! We are not afraid to go against the grain in our search for truth. We always question conventional wisdom- it’s how Simplex Health started- it’s what we do.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. Romans 12:2

We Cultivate Health and Vitality:
Being alive in a body is an incredible, temporary experience. Even though at times we feel pain and face challenges, our next breath is not guaranteed and is a HUGE gift. We experience EVERYTHING through our bodies, including thoughts, emotions, spirit, and our inspiration. We see health and vitality as the foundation for living a life that is happy, fulfilled, present, and productive.
Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.
3 John 1:2

We Embody Integrity:
We communicate with transparency and face conflict head-on. We do this with the understanding that we respect each other and recognize that we are on the same team working toward a unified noble mission with shared goals. We don’t compromise our morals or integrity no matter the context. When challenging scenarios arise, we approach them with honesty and trust that we are all holding the highest intentions, are committed to our values, and are making best efforts.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
Luke 6:31

We Simplify the Complicated:
We believe that complex problems don’t always require complex solutions. By simplifying the complicated and offering digestible, scalable solutions, we can pay more attention to the things that matter most. Simplicity- it’s the word that inspired our name - we make cultivating health and vitality simple.
Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.
Philippians 4:6

EUROPEAN DYNAMICS is seeking a UX/AX Specialist fluent in German to contribute to the design and evaluation of intuitive, inclusive, and accessible digital services for international projects.

The successful candidate will combine User Experience (UX) design with Accessibility Experience (AX) principles and guidelines to ensure a high level of usability and accessibility of the applications.

Responsibilities

  • Design and improve user journeys, interfaces, and interaction flows, applying user-centered design principles.
  • Integrate usability and accessibility requirements into design and development processes.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, accessibility assessments, and recommend improvements.
  • Prepare wireframes, prototypes, and design specifications for web and mobile applications, collaborating with developers and project stakeholders.
  • Communicate with German-speaking stakeholders concerning usability and accessibility topics.

Requirements

  • Degree in UX/UI Design, Human–Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience in UX/UI design, application and usability testing as well as usability and accessibility evaluation.
  • Good understanding and knowledge of WCAG 2.2 (and BITV 2.0), ergonomic principles (ISO 9241-110 and ISO 9241-210), inclusive design (visual, hearing, motor, cognitive and learning disabilities), and assistive technologies.
  • Familiarity with front-end technologies (e.g. Angular and Bootstrap), web-technologies (HTML structure and semantics, CSS and ARIA) prototyping tools (e.g. Figma), accessibility evaluation and testing tools (e.g. Google Lighthouse), and screen readers (e.g. NVDA or JAWS).
  • Fluency in German and good command of English.

Knowledge of EN 301 549, the European Accessibility Act, and accessibility evaluation methodologies will be considered an advantage.

Benefits

We believe in rewarding talent and dedication. Here's what you can expect as part of our team:

  • Competitive full-time salary;
  • Private Health Coverage on the Company’s group program;
  • Flexible Working Hours;
  • Top-of-the-Line Tools;
  • Professional Development: Benefit from language courses, specialized training, and continuous learning opportunities;
  • Career Growth: Work with some of the most innovative and exciting specialists in the industry;
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a setting that offers challenging goals, autonomy, and mentoring, fostering both personal and company growth.

If you want an exciting challenge, work with some of the coolest technologies, and enjoy your time doing it, then join us! Submit your detailed CV in English, quoting reference: (UX/AX/10/26).

You may also consider all our other open vacancies by visiting the career section of our website () and follow us on Twitter (@EURODYN_Careers) and LinkedIn.

EUROPEAN DYNAMICS (ED) () is a leading European Software, Information, and Communication Technologies company, operating internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Berlin, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Valetta, Vienna, Den Haag, Hong Kong, etc.) The company employs over 1100 engineers, IT experts, and consultants (around 3% PhD, 41% MSc, and 54% BSc). We design and develop software applications using integrated, state-of-the-art technology. Our current IT projects have a value exceeding 300 million EURO. EUROPEAN DYNAMICS is a renowned supplier of IT services to European Union Institutions, international organizations, European Agencies, and national government Administrations in 40 countries and 4 continents.

Creator Coordinator

Function: Creator Sourcing | Influencer & UGC Partnerships | Creator Operations
Reports to: Creator Operations Lead
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-Time, Contractor
Seniority Level: Mid Level
Fee: $2,000 – $2,500 USD

The Role:

We’re looking for a Creator Coordinator to join one of the UK’s leading agencies and become the driving force behind our creator sourcing operation.

This role is responsible for building and managing a consistent pipeline of high-quality UGC creators across multiple client accounts. You’ll identify new creator talent, vet creators against our internal quality standards, coordinate creator onboarding, build relationships and ensure our wider team always has access to the right creators for every campaign.

If you’re highly organised, proactive and passionate about creators, this is an opportunity to build your career within one of the fastest-growing agencies.

About Soar Group

The Soar Group is one of the UK's fastest-growing performance agency groups, built around a specialist paid media core — with Meta as our primary growth channel — backed by an in-house creative execution arm and a dedicated TikTok Shop implementation capability.

With over £100M+ in annual ad spend under management and a team of 130+, we partner with ambitious 7-9 figure DTC and eCommerce brands, with Meta as our primary growth channel, alongside TikTok and Google.

Our capabilities include:

  • Performance Media – Full-funnel paid media and growth strategy across Meta, Google, and TikTok, with Meta as our primary growth channel.
  • Creative Execution – An in-house creative execution arm delivering high-production creative, UGC, and static content at scale.
  • TikTok Shop & Social Commerce – A dedicated TikTok Shop implementation and creator-led growth capability.

We were nominated for Meta's Creative Diversity Award 2025 and recognised by Meta as the UK's #1 independent Meta agency group.

Our culture is built around four core values: Extreme Ownership, Radical Curiosity, Kind Candour, Outcome Obsessed.

Requirements

Comprehensive training will be provided across all aspects of the role, including our creator sourcing processes, internal systems and creator ecosystem.

  • Launch UGC creator casting calls across in our creator community. Source externally on social media platforms to build a consistent pipeline of high-quality creators.
  • Source and identify creators that align with each client’s brand, audience and campaign objectives.
  • Vet and review UGC creators based on content quality, performance, audience fit and brand suitability to ensure only the strongest creators are recommended.
  • Maintain a curated, engaged creator network, ensuring all creators are contractually bound and compliant before any assignment begins.
  • Execute multi-platform creator outreach using tools including TikTok Creator Marketplace, Insense, X (formerly Twitter) and other relevant sourcing platforms.
  • Coordinate creator communications throughout the onboarding process, acting as a professional point of contact.
  • Support the wider team with administrative tasks, campaign coordination and creator operations.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve creator sourcing processes and expand the quality and scale of our creator network.
  • Act as an external ambassador for the agency in all creator-facing interactions, representing the agency with professionalism, empathy, and clarity. Strong creator relationships protect the agency's reputation, drive long-term partnerships, and reduce the risk of negative sentiment.
  • Maintain strong relationships internally and externally.

Who You Are:

We’re looking for someone who is organised, proactive and excited by the world of creator marketing. You don’t need years of experience-we’re looking for potential, curiosity and a willingness to learn.

You’ll ideally have:

  • 1+ years’ experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, social media, affiliate marketing or a related field.
  • A Strong understanding of social media (Meta, TikTok etc) and creator culture
  • Excellent organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong written communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Confidence in managing multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
  • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership.
  • The ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.
  • A genuine interest in eCommerce, content creation and creator marketing.
  • Empathy, with a genuine ability to understand creator and client needs.
  • Creative thinking, with the ability to spot fresh ideas and creator talent.
  • Critical thinking, to evaluate creator quality and campaign fit with sound judgement.
  • Experience using TikTok Creator Marketplace and Meta Creator Marketplace.
  • Experience sourcing UGC creators or influencers.

Success in the first 6 months:

  • Built a reliable pipeline of high-quality creators across multiple industries.
  • Own creator briefing from start to finish.
  • Become a trusted partner to our team for creator sourcing and coordination.
  • Helped launch successful creator campaigns that generate measurable commercial results.
  • Build strong relationships with creators that lead to repeat collaborations and long-term partnerships.

Benefits

Access to ongoing training, development, and progression opportunities across the Soar Group.

Soar Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment, where all of our employees have equal access to opportunities and everyone’s voices are heard. We respect and value all differences (seen and unseen) and strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds, which will be considered regardless of race, colour, religion or belief, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, pregnancy and maternity, disability, or age.

Due to the evolving nature of the business, the job holder may be required to carry out duties that are not detailed within this job description.

title: Head Psychologist: Autism & Developmental Diagnostics
description: Frontera is reimagining how children with autism and other behavioral health needs get the care they deserve.

raw.title: Head Psychologist: Autism & Developmental Diagnostics
raw.excerpt: Frontera is reimagining how children with autism and other behavioral health needs get the care they deserve.
raw.description:
Frontera is reimagining how children with autism and other behavioral health needs get the care they deserve. We bring together world-class clinicians, technologists, and autism specialists to build cutting-edge AI tools that help care teams work smarter and spend more time with the children and families who need them most.

Our platform is HIPAA-compliant and designed for the real-world needs of behavioral health teams — from psychologists to ABA therapists. By combining evidence-based care with powerful technology, we're expanding access to high-quality services for families everywhere.

Our Mission

Frontera exists to close the care gap: every child, no matter where they live, should be able to access effective behavioral healthcare.

Why Join Us

At Frontera, you'll join a team driven by impact. We're growing quickly, backed by leading investors, and united by a shared belief that innovation and equity can change lives. If you're excited to build the future of pediatric healthcare, we'd love to meet you.

Role Overview

As Lead Psychologist, Autism & Developmental Diagnostics, you'll be the clinical and operational anchor for Frontera's telehealth diagnostic team. You'll ensure every autism and developmental evaluation meets a consistently high bar for quality, while helping your team find smarter, more efficient ways to work, because time saved without sacrificing quality means another child gets answers sooner. You'll carry a small evaluation caseload of your own, and spend the rest of your time developing your team, strengthening clinical standards, and partnering closely with Operations, Intake, and Product to build a diagnostic program that's both excellent and built to scale.

This is a role for someone who can hold two things in tension: the clinical rigor and individualized care every family deserves, and the efficiency Frontera needs to reach more of the families who need us. You'll set the standard for what “good” looks like on both fronts and you'll be comfortable making real tradeoffs, and helping your team make them too.

What You'll Do

Clinical Leadership & Quality

  • Serve as the go-to resource for clinical questions, screener guidance, and evaluation standards across the diagnostics team

  • Set and uphold consistent standards for clinical quality, complex case decision-making, report writing, and neuroaffirming language

  • Review evaluations and consult on complex or atypical cases

  • Define best practices for accessible, high-quality telehealth autism and developmental evaluation

  • Carry a modest caseload of your own (about two evaluations per week) to stay grounded in the work

  • Set clear, explicit guidance on where the line is between more time meaning more quality, and more time meaning a family waits longer for a diagnosis and help your team make that call with confidence

Team Support & Development

  • Lead onboarding, training, and calibration for new psychologists

  • Support your team's ongoing growth and skill development

  • Run regular 1:1s and team meetings that keep people aligned, supported, and unstuck

  • Own change management for new tools, processes, and programs across the team

  • Set clear expectations and hold your team accountable to them — with warmth, and without avoiding the hard conversations when they're needed

Operational Alignment

  • Partner with Intake and Operations to build workflows, scheduling, and communication that actually work

  • Spot the operational gaps that get in the way of quality or efficiency, and help fix them

  • Turn good clinical ideas into concrete, sequenced plans, with real metrics and timelines, not just principles

Product & Technology Partnership

  • Partner closely with Engineering and Product on report tools, documentation templates, and workflows

  • Bring specific, proactive ideas for where technology could save time without costing quality — you don't just flag problems, you help solve them

  • Help identify, track, and prioritize product issues with clear clinical context

  • Partner with Customer Success to close the loop between client experience and clinical practice

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Represent the clinical point of view in conversations about scaling, tooling, and how we design our services

  • Help hire, evaluate, and calibrate new psychologists and speech-language pathologists

  • Advocate for standardized, scalable workflows where they help us serve more families, even when that means less case-by-case customization

  • Contribute to quality improvement and clinical governance efforts

Travel

  • Occasional travel to New Mexico and other markets for team training, calibration, and partnership-building

  • Frequent visits to our Denver headquarters to stay connected with the clinical operations team

Who You Are

  • A doctoral-level psychologist with deep experience in autism and developmental evaluation

  • Skilled in telehealth-based assessment, with strong clinical judgment, report writing, and ADOS (Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule) administration

  • Experienced training, mentoring, and leading interdisciplinary clinical teams

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and building consistency in a fast-growing environment

  • Experienced managing the performance of licensed clinicians serving underserved communities

  • A natural partner to technologists and product teams — you can talk concretely about where tools and workflows intersect with clinical quality, not just work around what exists

  • Someone who makes good decisions under time pressure, not only when things are calm

  • Comfortable standardizing and scaling processes, and willing to prioritize consistency when it's what's best for the most families

  • An assertive, steady leader who can set a clear standard for a team and hold to it

What Success Looks Like

  • Clinicians have a reliable go-to person for day-to-day questions and support

  • Evaluation quality is consistent, timely, and meets gold-standard practices

  • Workflows between Ops, Intake, and Clinical run smoothly

  • New clinicians ramp up quickly with strong support

  • A cohesive team culture aligned with our mission to close the care gap

  • A well-maintained library of clinical SOPs and documentation

  • Clear, measurable improvements in quality and/or throughput — not just team morale

  • A strong, trusted working relationship with Product and Engineering, built on specific and proactive ideas

Why Frontera Health?

  • Help shape the future of pediatric behavioral healthcare

  • Lead and grow a clinical team at a company built to close the care gap

  • Join a mission-driven team backed by leading investors

Telecommuter

Join Our Team: Do Meaningful Work and Improve People’s Lives

Our purpose, to improve customers’ lives by making healthcare work better, is far from ordinary. And so are our employees. Working at Premera means you have the opportunity to drive real change by transforming healthcare.

Premera is committed to being a workplace where people feel empowered to grow, innovate, and lead with purpose. By investing in our employees and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous development, we’re able to better serve our customers. It’s this commitment that has earned us recognition as one of the best companies to work for. Learn more about our recent awards and recognitions as a greatest workplace.

Learn how Premera supports our members, customers and the communities that we serve through our Healthsource blog: .

Systems Analyst II


Job Description Summary

Analyzes business functions, processes, and procedures to provide solution recommendations, including system specifications and business process implications, based on business objectives, business requirements, and cost effectiveness. Collaborates with others in system development and design, which may include database, report, and interface design. Assists in the development of test plans and coordination or execution of testing activities and helps triage issues, anomalies, and opportunities to improve solutions. Provides analysis and recommendations on problems of moderate scope and complexity. Works under general guidance while developing expertise within an assigned business domain. Able to analyze workflows and improve operational challenges by leveraging automation solutions to reduce manual effort and rework.


This role is Telecommuter.


What You’ll Do

Job Responsibilities

  • Represent the business within an Agile delivery team; develop and maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders; engage business partners to understand and develop expertise within the aligned business domain; and act as a liaison between business and IT for new system implementations, enhancements, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Collaborate with business partners, IT partners, and delivery team members to identify, refine, and document requirements in the form of epics, features, user stories, use cases, business requirements, functional requirements, UI specifications, and business rules.
  • Apply business process analysis and cost-benefit analysis techniques to evaluate solution options and support business decision-making.
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of Premera systems, applications, and business processes within the aligned domain.
  • Analyze and document current and future-state business processes to identify pain points, risks, and opportunities for operational efficiencies through technology solutions.
  • Use system tools and data sources to perform data analysis, validate requirements, troubleshoot issues, support root cause analysis, and provide solution recommendations.
  • Support the development of low-code and automation solutions to reduce repetitive manual work and improve process consistency.
  • Perform and assist with data analysis to define business, process, functional, and data requirements; identify and resolve conflicting requirements; conduct gap analyses; and support reporting and data-mapping activities.
  • Support end users in preparing, documenting, and executing test scenarios; create test scripts and test cases with guidance from team members; and assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Provide input on backlog priorities, dependencies, and sprint planning activities.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement through analysis of business processes and technology solutions; collaborate with the delivery team to improve both team effectiveness and solution quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Two (2) years of business systems analysis experience, including requirements gathering, business process analysis, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver technology solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a software development environment utilizing Agile delivery practices, including Scrum and SAFe.
  • Knowledge of project delivery methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall.
  • Experience using SQL for data analysis, data validation, troubleshooting, or reporting.
  • Knowledge of healthcare or health insurance industry processes and systems.
  • Experience with product development and collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, Confluence, and Product Plan.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Customer-focused with demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions to business needs, operational impact, and customer value.
  • Demonstrates accountability and delivers results within a self-organized team environment.
  • Ability to develop an understanding of business strategies, processes, and objectives within the aligned domain.
  • Hands-on exposure to at least one relational or cloud database platform, such as SQL Server, Snowflake, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar technology.
  • Experience using reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Interest in using AI, low-code, and workflow automation technologies to solve operational problems, improve processes, and reduce manual work.
  • Basic understanding of APIs, system integrations, and data exchange between applications.
  • Ability to build strong partnerships with business and IT stakeholders and maintain a high-quality stakeholder experience.
  • Understands and applies quality standards, incorporating both functional and non-functional requirements into solution design.
  • Collaborates effectively within a delivery team and is viewed as a trusted team member by peers and stakeholders.
  • Experience defining and documenting software requirements for low to moderately complex products, systems, or business processes.
  • Fundamental understanding of analytical tools, relational databases, software applications, and data structures.
  • Ability to elicit, analyze, organize, document, and trace business and system requirements throughout the solution lifecycle.
  • Ability to analyze data, business processes, and system interactions to identify issues and recommend solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Makes sound tactical decisions using analysis, experience, judgment, and business context.
  • Basic problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to facilitate small group discussions and workshops to achieve defined outcomes.
  • Comfortable working in environments with changing priorities and evolving business needs.

Premera total rewards

Our comprehensive total rewards package provides support, resources, and opportunities to help employees thrive and grow. Our total rewards are more than a collection of perks, they're a reflection of our commitment to your health and well-being. We offer a broad array of rewards including physical, financial, emotional, and community benefits, including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental coverage with low employee premiums.

  • Voluntary benefit offerings, including pet insurance for paw parents.

  • Life and disability insurance.

  • Retirement programs, including a 401K employer match and, believe it or not, a pension plan that is vested after 3 years of service.

  • Wellness incentives with a wide range of mental well-being resources for you and your dependents, including counseling services, stress management programs, and mindfulness programs, just to name a few.

  • Generous paid time off to reenergize.

  • Looking for continuing education? We have tuition assistance for both undergraduate and graduate degrees.

  • Employee recognition program to celebrate anniversaries, team accomplishments, and more.

For our hybrid employees, our on-campus model provides flexibility to create your own routine with access to on-site resources, networking opportunities, and team engagement.

  • Commuter perks make your trip to work less impactful on the environment and your wallet.

  • Free convenient on-site parking.

  • Subsidized on-campus cafes make lunchtime connections with colleagues fun and affordable.

  • Participate in engaging on-site activities such as health and wellness events, coffee connects, disaster preparedness fairs and more.

  • Our complementary fitness & well-being center offers both in-person and virtual workouts and nutritional counseling.

  • Need a brain break? Challenge someone to a game of shuffleboard or ping pong while on campus.

Equal employment opportunity/affirmative action:

Premera is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Premera seeks to attract and retain the most qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

If you need an accommodation to apply online for positions at Premera, please contact Premera Human Resources via email at or via phone at 425-918-4785.

The pay for this role will vary based on a range of factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographic location, market conditions, and specific skills and experience.

raw.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Lead Software Engineer, AI Email Apps, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Build & Release (CI/CD) Support Engineer

Location: Remote | Time Zone: (Canada, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico) (8AM–5PM Pacific)

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company delivering large-scale cloud, data, and engineering solutions across 130+ countries. We partner with some of the world’s largest organizations to help them build, operate, and scale internal platforms used by tens of thousands of engineers.

For this role, you will be supporting one of the most advanced internal developer platforms in the world, powering products used by hundreds of millions of people. The problems you will solve are deep, complex, and essential to keeping a global-scale organization moving.

About Virtasant

Freedom to Grow. Power to Deliver.At Virtasant, talented people do their best work in an environment built on trust, autonomy, and continuous learning. With team members in 130+ countries, we are a remote-first, proudly diverse organization focused on meaningful work and real impact.

Role Overview

The Build & Release Support Engineer provides high-impact technical support for the customer’s build, release, and CI/CD systems, which every developer depends on to ship software.

This role is deeply developer-facing and centers on build pipelines, software supply chain workflows, and release tooling. You will help engineers resolve blockers across tools like Maven, Java build systems, Docker, Spinnaker, Artifactory, and Jenkins.

Success depends on strong troubleshooting skills, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple threads and tickets in parallel. You will be the front line, ensuring developers can deliver reliably, safely, and at high velocity.

Business Outcome

Become a deep expert in the customer’s build and release ecosystem and deliver fast, accurate support across Slack and tickets. Your work will maintain high developer velocity and minimize disruption across global engineering teams.


Success Measures

  • Healthy volume of threads and tickets handled with high-quality outcomes

  • Consistent achievement of time-based SLAs

  • High customer satisfaction through surveys

  • Accurate classification of issue type, severity, and patterns

What Will Be True When You Succeed

  • Developers ship faster with fewer build and release blockers

  • CI/CD and software supply chain tooling become more reliable and more usable

  • Escalations decrease due to strong frontline troubleshooting


Core Work Units

1. Frontline Support for Build & Release Systems

  • Manage Slack threads and tickets (roughly 50/50)

  • Triage build failures, broken pipelines, dependency issues, and configuration errors

  • Provide fast, accurate context before escalating

  • Handle multiple interactions in parallel without losing track

2. Deep-Dive Troubleshooting & Incident Support

  • Diagnose complex build, packaging, or artifact problems independently

  • Investigate issues involving Maven builds, Java compilation, Docker images, Artifactory repos, Jenkins jobs, and Spinnaker pipelines

  • Provide structured guidance throughout incidents

3. Escalation Management

  • Complete a thorough analysis before escalating

  • Gather all required details upfront to reduce back-and-forth

  • Produce clean, high-quality escalation tickets that downstream teams can act on immediately

4. Documentation & Knowledge Development

  • Maintain and refine FAQs and internal documentation

  • Create problem–solution one-pagers for recurring issues

  • Document newly solved problems instinctively and thoroughly

High-Quality Work — what top performance looks like

Frontline Support

  • Quickly identifies whether the issue is build-related, config-related, or infra-related

  • Moves smoothly from triage to deeper analysis

  • Juggles multiple developer inquiries without missing follow-ups

Deep-Dive & Incident Support

  • Resolves complex pipeline or build issues without escalation

  • Coordinates multi-user incidents involving large build failures

  • Communicates clearly during investigation, root-cause analysis, and resolution

Escalations

  • Only escalates after a thorough investigation

  • Provides complete logs, reproduction steps, build metadata, and context

  • Saves downstream engineers time with clean, accurate handoffs

Documentation

  • Documentation is so clear that users avoid opening tickets

  • Proactively updates and refines materials for clarity and accuracy

  • Quickly turns real-world issues into reusable knowledge

Typical Day / Work Patterns

  • ~50% Slack support, ~50% ticket handling

  • Documentation and PRs during low ticket volume periods

  • Weekly team meeting to review escalated tickets

  • High rate of context switching and parallel issue management

Required Skills & Experience

Non-Negotiable Skills

  • Git proficiency and GitHub expertise

  • CI/CD tooling expertise (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.)

  • Build & Release engineering fundamentals

  • Maven and Java build tooling

  • Understanding of software supply chain lifecycle

  • Comfort supporting Artifact repositories (Artifactory, Nexus, etc.)

  • Experience with Spinnaker or similar deployment orchestration

  • Strong troubleshooting ability

  • Clear written and spoken communication

  • SDLC understanding

  • Unix command-line proficiency

  • Linux command-line proficiency

  • Scripting (Python/Bash)

  • Container knowledge (Docker/Kubernetes)

Nice-to-Haves

  • Monitoring tools (Prometheus/Grafana)

  • Prior SRE experience

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2–5 years in Build/Release Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or software development

  • Strong troubleshooting skills

  • Clear communication skills

  • Strong linux skills, scripting, Git, and containers

  • Solid Linux/Unix experience

  • Experience with build tools (Maven/Gradle), containers, and artifact management systems

  • Disqualifiers: no CI/CD experience, poor communication

What You’ll Love

  • Constant learning and rapid skill growth

  • Hands-on technical problem solving

  • Directly unblocking developers across a global organization

What May Be Challenging

  • High context switching

  • Repetitive problem patterns

  • Pressure from supporting high-visibility systems

Differentiation: Industry

  • Remote-first, trust-based culture

  • Global team across 130+ countries

  • High autonomy and respect for your time

  • Exposure across multiple clients and modern systems

  • Meaningful, impactful technical challenges

Differentiation: Internal

  • Supports the highest-visibility set of services at the customer

  • More direct developer-facing work than similar Virtasant roles
    • Deep specialization in CI/CD rather than broad platform coverage

About HLTH:
At HLTH, we're not just about healthcare; we're about sparking a health revolution. By connecting the healthcare ecosystem and fostering dynamic community interactions, we're setting the stage for the next decade of healthcare innovation.

We are seeking a Sales Director, Pharma & Biotech to join our team and grow one of HLTH’s most important and strategic categories. This role is focused on building, expanding and deepening relationships across the pharma and biotech sectors, with responsibility for driving new revenue across HLTH USA, HLTH Europe and HLTH Community products and services.

The ideal candidate will bring established relationships, category knowledge and sales experience within pharma, biotech and the broader life sciences ecosystem. This person should understand the business priorities of pharma and biotech companies and be able to translate HLTH’s event, content, thought leadership, community and partnership opportunities into meaningful commercial solutions.

Reporting to the Head of Growth in the US, the Sales Director will play a pivotal role in expanding HLTH’s pharma and biotech business by identifying new prospects, converting existing relationships and supporting strategic account efforts across the portfolio. This role will also work collaboratively with Strategic Account Directors who own large pharma accounts, helping to expand opportunities within those organizations and ensuring a coordinated, high-value approach to client growth. We are looking for candidates with a strong background in business development, sales, and client service, with a focus on the healthcare industry.

Primary Responsibilities:
• Meet and exceed new business sales targets across pharma, biotech and life sciences accounts, leveraging HLTH’s global event, content and thought leadership opportunities and introduce new-to-market offerings
• Develop and execute strategic sales plans to grow HLTH’s pharma and biotech category across HLTH USA, HLTH Europe and HLTH Community.
• Identify prospects and convert new pharma and biotech clients, including companies across multiple divisions, brands and business units.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with senior decision-makers across marketing, commercial, innovation, medical affairs, market access, digital health, corporate affairs and other relevant functions.
• Sell sponsorship, exhibit, content, thought leadership and community-based opportunities that align with each client’s goals.
• Work collaboratively with Key Account Directors who manage large pharma accounts, supporting account expansion, new product sales and coordinated growth strategies.
• Prepare compelling sales proposals, contracts, and presentations tailored to the needs of each client
• Stay current on pharma, biotech, life sciences and healthcare trends to inform sales strategy and identify new revenue opportunities.
• Provide excellent customer service and support for sponsors through a high level of responsiveness, professionalism and attention to detail
• Track and report daily on sales pipeline activity, from proposal to contract closure using CRM tools.
• Develop expertise in the business goals of each account and stay current on industry trends, competitors, and market developments to inform sales strategies
• Bring forward new ideas to grow revenue, strengthen HLTH’s value proposition and expand the pharma and biotech category
• Work cross functionally with teams at HLTH to ensure excellent client service
• Develop lasting and productive relationships with key decision makers across the portfolio of new and target accounts

Qualifications:
• Minimum 5-7 years of sales and account management experience in a fast-paced environment, preferably in healthcare and/or Event sales
• Direct experience selling to or working with pharma, biotech, life sciences or healthcare companies strongly preferred.
• Established relationships across the pharma and biotech ecosystem.
• Strong understanding of pharma and biotech business priorities, including innovation, commercial strategy, brand visibility, market access, digital transformation, partnerships and thought leadership.
• Experience selling sponsorships, events, media, content, research, advisory, community or partnership-based products preferred.
• Strong sales acumen with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets
• Ability to work with internal and external stakeholders in multiple countries
• Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and internal stakeholder

Personal Attributes:
• Tenacious, self-motivated and committed to exceeding sales targets
• Strategic thinker with a problem-solving mindset
• Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and accuracy
• Independent and comfortable with organizational change and delivering against time-based deadlines
• Excellent planning, communication and organization skills
• Team player with strong interpersonal skills and a positive outlook.
• Knowledge of the Healthcare and events industries preferred

HLTH Technology Stack:
• Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides) and Zoom Video Conferencing
• Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Zoom Info

Salary & Benefits:
• Competitive compensation of $100,000 - 120,0000, plus commission, and comprehensive benefits package
• Company paid health insurance
• Apple laptops provided to all employees
• Paid time off plus holidays

Join the movement at HLTH, where we're more than a company – we're a catalyst for change in healthcare. Be a part of a team that's not just following the healthcare narrative but writing it. Together, let's shape a healthier, more connected future.

Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence. What will I be doing in this role?
Certified Coding Spec Phys, Certified Coding Specialist, Certified Professional Coder, Registered Health Info Admin or Registered Health Info Tech required upon hire. In this role you work under the general direction of the Coding Supervisor. The Coding Auditor is responsible for reviewing encounters in either a prebill or retrospective workflow to validate a coding profile. This includes applicable code sets to encounter type, abstracted data elements, missed query opportunities, and other related encounter data collection points. Auditors evaluate compliance with all coding guidelines including but not limited to: Internal Coding policies/procedures/handbook, American Hospital Association (AHA) and American Medical Association (AMA) coding references, local, State, and Federal Coding Guidelines.

  • Performs quality coding reviews or audits within established departmental productivity and accuracy standards. Assists with processing re-bills post coding audit changes and assists with coding corrections needed from billing department.
  • Provides written summary reports of findings.
  • Coordinates and leads 1:1 or small group feedback sessions based on recommendations
  • Maintains appropriate open communication with internal and external stakeholders and peer departments such as Coding Operations, Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI), Payor Revenue Management (PRM) , and Compliance Revenue Integrity (CRI).
  • Assist peer departments with production coding of cases during shortage of staff.
  • Assist in improved data quality for reporting and research, accurate billing and reimbursement of services rendered which overall improves the quality of care for the patient.
  • Provide 1:1 and small group education sessions, facilitate round table discussions, contribute content to the coding newsletter, provide basic level trending or data review for opportunities.
  • Evaluate codes through data reports and trended opportunities, audit to validate findings, produce summary reports with recommendations of action plans.
  • Performs additional activities (e.g. Data quality reports, etc.) as assigned by the Coding Supervisor.

As a Litigation Paralegal at Rutter Mills, you will work closely with attorneys, clients, and medical providers to manage personal injury cases from litigation through resolution, including trial, settlement, and escrow. This position requires excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage deadlines independently while maintaining consistent communication with your team.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

CentralReach is a leading provider of autism and IDD care software for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), multidisciplinary therapy, and special education. Trusted by more than 200,000 users, we enable therapy providers, educators, and employers to scale the way they deliver ABA and related therapies with innovative technology, market-leading industry expertise, and world-class customer satisfaction.

The Outcomes-Based Care Manager is a customer-facing clinical expert who helps provider organizations shift from measuring care by hours delivered to measuring it by outcomes achieved. You will work directly with customer clinical and executive leaders to implement outcomes frameworks, interpret progress data, and build the evidence that supports value-based and outcomes-linked payer relationships. You will use CentralReach's platform and AI-enabled tools to make that work scalable, and you will bring what you learn from the field back to our Clinical and Product teams. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Payor Strategy and Network Development.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Advisory and Engagement

  • Serve as the clinical outcomes expert for assigned customers, advising clinical directors, operations leaders, and executives on adopting outcomes-based care models
  • Lead outcomes-focused onboarding, implementation, and optimization engagements, including discovery sessions, workshops, and recurring business reviews
  • Assess each customer's current data practices and outcomes maturity, then build a practical roadmap to close the gaps
  • Deliver training and best-practice guidance that helps clinical teams apply outcomes measurement in daily workflows

Outcomes Measurement and Clinical Insight

  • Apply standardized outcome measures and benchmarks across ABA and IDD service lines, adapting them to each customer's population and payer mix
  • Review customer treatment progress trends, flag at-risk caseloads, and recommend data-informed adjustments to care approaches
  • Help customers configure CentralReach reporting and dashboards so they reflect clinically sound outcomes methodology

Payer and Stakeholder Readiness

  • Help customers build outcomes reports and narratives for payers, funders, and families
  • Advise on preparing for value-based and outcomes-linked arrangements, including the quality metrics payers are likely to ask for

Core Competencies

  • Adaptability and a continuous-improvement mindset, including openness to AI-enabled ways of working

raw.description:
About Private Health Management

Private Health Management (PHM), a clinically sophisticated healthcare navigation firm, specializes in assisting clients to obtain the best care and outcomes when facing serious and complex medical conditions. Individuals and businesses who make health a priority rely on PHM to achieve the best of what's possible in medicine. We believe everyone should benefit from the latest science-backed insights, have access to the best diagnostics, specialists, and treatments, and receive independent guidance to make informed health decisions with confidence.

About the role:

For more than a decade, Private Health Management (PHM) has helped our clients navigate the fragmented healthcare system to achieve the best care and outcomes when it matters most. As a Associate Research Director at PHM you’ll join a team of compassionate and dedicated professionals focusing solely on the best interest of the patient and establishing a new standard of excellence in precision medicine. In the role, you’ll lead the research efforts on complex care cases. You’ll review client medical records and clinical history, identify and evaluate diagnostic and treatment options including clinical trials and innovative, evidence-based therapies around the world, and develop and prioritize treatment strategies based on data in the medical literature and input from world leading experts.

How You’ll Spend Your Days

  • Client-Facing Engagement:Participate in client calls alongside clinicians to communicate the latest research findings, support shared decision-making, and ensure understanding of available options.
  • Clinical History Analysis: Analyze patient medical records, including data extraction and tracking of lab values, symptoms, medication histories, or clinical outcomes.
  • Medical Literature Review: Identify, review, and analyze literature across a wide range of clinical and research topics. Summarize articles and compare findings of clinical studies and present that information in a patient-friendly manner.
  • Molecular Diagnostics Interpretation: Identify, analyze, and interpret molecular diagnostics and laboratory tests, ensuring accurate and insightful assessments. Provide insights to support patient care decisions.
  • Treatment Options Research: Research, evaluate, and prioritize treatment options for individual cases. This includes review, analysis, and interpretation of the accepted standard of care, the most recent professional guidelines, and the most current investigational approaches, as well as identifying and connecting with key opinion leaders and other experts in the field of interest, to help guide decision making.
  • Clinical Trials Identification: Identify and evaluate potential clinical trials. This includes spreadsheet creation, database searching, identification of supporting evidence, and calling trial sites to help find appropriate clinical trials for our clients.
  • Content Creation: Create patient education documents (written reports, presentations, spreadsheets, graphs, charts, etc.) that provide pertinent information related to clinical history, diagnosis, and treatment options.

What you bring to the table:

  • Academic & Professional Experience: A PhD in a science or healthcare field is required + early career professional experience in a complex medical disorder(s).
    • A strong preference for this opening will be given to candidates with a Doctorate of Physical Therapy combined with orthopedic/PT experience.
    • Experience in women's health a plus (ex. pelvic floor physical therapy)
  • Excellent Research Abilities: Knowledge of best practices and well-developed research capabilities exploring the medical literature (e.g., PubMed, Google Scholar)
  • Client Readiness: Exceptional interpersonal skills, service orientation, written and verbal communication abilities to serve as a trusted advisor to clients
  • Adaptable Doer Attitude: Efficient, resourceful, creative, and able to make rapid decisions in the face of ambiguity & deadlines.
  • Great Team Member: Equally comfortable delivering as an individual or collaborating across peers, co-workers, and external experts to deliver the best results for clients

Read what current Team Members say about working at PHM!

Compensation: The target base salary for this position is $110,000 - $120,000.

This base salary is only a part of a total compensation package that also includes: health/dental/vision benefits, annual cash incentive program, 401k with match, flexible PTO, PHM for PHM (our services for you and your dependents) and other benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range as a number of factors including market forces, experience, location, disparities in market data and other relevant business considerations may all factor into final compensation.

Location

This is a remote role requiring that you live in and physically perform all work in the United States.

Next Steps

Private Health Management is a remote company with employees around the United States. We’re committed to providing a thoughtful, transparent interview experience and meaningful opportunities to get to know our company, mission, and wonderful teammates through fully remote interviews. If your application is selected for interviews, you’ll hear from a member of our recruiting team to schedule next steps. Interviews will also include: the hiring manager, peers, and often an executive from the department. PHM uses AI-enabled tools at certain points in the recruiting process to help identify and evaluate top talent; however, all hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.

Have a quick question about the role? Email or simply apply here.

Anticipated Pay Range
$110,000—$120,000 USD

Remodel Program Manager

Department: Operations / Project Management

Company: SMF Companies Position Overview

SMF Companies is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Remodel Program Manager to coordinate and support high-volume remodel and renovation projects across multiple locations.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can manage multiple projects simultaneously, and excels at scheduling, material coordination, and project tracking.

Extensive construction experience is not required. We are looking for someone with strong organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and the confidence to manage numerous projects simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and manage schedules across a high volume of remodel and renovation projects.
  • Organize project timelines, track milestones, and ensure work stays on schedule.
  • Place and track material orders, coordinate deliveries, and follow up on outstanding items.
  • Communicate regularly with project managers, field teams, subcontractors, vendors, and clients.
  • Maintain accurate project trackers, schedules, reports, and documentation.
  • Utilize Microsoft Excel, Smartsheet, and other project management tools to monitor project progress and deadlines.
  • Identify scheduling conflicts, material delays, and potential project issues, proactively communicating solutions.
  • Coordinate work across multiple locations while managing changing priorities.
  • Provide regular project updates and status reports to internal teams and leadership.
  • Assist with project closeout documentation and outstanding items.

Required Qualifications

  • Exceptional organizational and time-management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, reporting, and project tracking.
  • Experience with Smartsheet or similar project management software.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, schedules, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage shifting priorities.
  • Experience in project coordination, operations, logistics, scheduling, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to read and interpret construction plans and drawings.
  • Willingness and ability to travel as needed.
  • Experience in commercial construction, retail remodels, restaurant renovations, or multi-location rollout programs.
  • Familiarity with construction terminology, material procurement, and delivery scheduling.
  • Experience coordinating subcontractors, vendors, and field operations.
  • Previous experience supporting high-volume project programs.
